readme: # Pantheon Version 0.1.0 [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/954660700142305290)](https://discord.gg/MJsFy4A4En) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-available-green)](https://pantheon.7kayoh.net) [![Wally](https://img.shields.io/badge/wally-available-blue)](https://wally.run/package/koterahq/pantheon) > [!IMPORTANT] > Pantheon is under active development and is subject to groundbreaking changes. We generally do not recommend using Pantheon in production yet unless you are comfortable with potential breaking changes and are willing to adapt your code accordingly... ## What is this? Pantheon is a modern and slick Fusion 0.3+ components library for Roblox, with a focus on accessibility, theming, and performance. It is a successor to Lydie. ## Installation Add Pantheon to your `wally.toml`, then run `wally install`: ```toml [dependencies] Pantheon = "koterahq/pantheon@0.1.0" ``` For more information, please refer to the documentation at [https://pantheon.7kayoh.net](https://pantheon.7kayoh.net) or [./docs](./docs/Tutorials/InstallingPantheon.md). ## License MIT License. ## Contributing Pull requests are welcome. For major changes, please open an issue first to discuss what you would like to change. For contributions, please make sure to follow the coding style and write tests for any new features or bug fixes. Create components in the `src/Components` folder and add example usage in the `stories` folder. Follow the existing structure, naming conventions, design styleguide for consistency. Always use the Iona-based system to create new instances for components, and avoid using Roblox's built-in instances directly. Ensure to add types for all new components and their properties in the `src/Types.luau` file. This will help with type checking and improve the developer experience. ## Use of AI Declarations This project uses AI-assisted tools to help with partial code generation and refactoring. While these tools can be helpful, they are not perfect and may introduce errors or inconsistencies. All code generated by AI tools are subject to review and testing by a human developer before being merged into the project. The authors of this project are not responsible for any issues that arise from the use of AI-generated code. ## Author - 7kayoh - kitsuu-ne

--!strict
--[[
	Public types for pantheon (Cadence/Tithe design system).
]]

export type Scope = any
export type UsedAs<T> = T | any

export type ThemeMode = "Light" | "Dark"

export type ThemeColors = {
	Primary: Color3,
	OnPrimary: Color3,
	PrimaryContainer: Color3,
	OnPrimaryContainer: Color3,
	Background: Color3,
	Surface: Color3,
	SurfaceDim: Color3,
	SurfaceBright: Color3,
	OnSurface: Color3,
	OnSurfaceVariant: Color3,
	SurfaceContainer: Color3,
	SurfaceContainerHigh: Color3,
	Outline: Color3,
	OutlineVariant: Color3,
	Error: Color3,
	OnError: Color3,
	Success: Color3,
	OnSuccess: Color3,
	Warning: Color3,
	OnWarning: Color3,
	Scrim: Color3,
	--- Contrasting surface for toasts / tips: dark in light mode, light in dark mode.
	InverseSurface: Color3,
	InverseOnSurface: Color3,
	InversePrimary: Color3,
	Info: Color3,
	OnInfo: Color3,
}

export type ThemeFonts = {
	Heading: Font,
	Body: Font,
	Mono: Font,
}

export type ThemeMetrics = {
	Space2xs: number,
	SpaceXs: number,
	SpaceSm: number,
	SpaceMd: number,
	SpaceLg: number,
	SpaceXl: number,
	--- Corner radius scale (px)
	RadiusNone: number,
	Radius2xs: number,
	RadiusXs: number,
	RadiusSm: number,
	RadiusMd: number,
	RadiusLg: number,
	RadiusXl: number,
	Radius2xl: number,
	Radius3xl: number,
	--- Semantic: cards / panels / sheets (typically = RadiusLg)
	RadiusPanel: number,
	--- Fully rounded (pills, avatars, switches)
	RadiusPill: number,
	AppBarHeight: number,
	DrawerWidth: number,
	RailWidth: number,
	ButtonPadX: number,
	ButtonPadY: number,
}

export type TypeScale = {
	Font: Font,
	Size: number,
	LineHeight: number,
}

export type ThemeTypography = {
	Display: TypeScale,
	Headline: TypeScale,
	Title: TypeScale,
	Button: TypeScale,
	Body: TypeScale,
	Label: TypeScale,
	Mono: TypeScale,
	[string]: TypeScale,
}

export type ThemeColorRole = {
	Base: Color3,
	OnBase: Color3,
	Container: Color3,
	OnContainer: Color3,
}

--- Extensible palette; defaults use Material-ish names (primary, secondary, …).
export type ThemePalette = { [string]: ThemeColorRole }

--- Color3 | hex | RGB {r,g,b} | palette name | Material swatch ("Blue 500") | { Blue = 500 } | role
export type ColorInput = Color3 | string | { number } | { [string]: number | string } | ThemeColorRole

export type ThemeMotion = {
	SpringSpeed: number,
	SpringDamping: number,
	PressScale: number,
}

export type PreferredTextSizeName = "Medium" | "Large" | "Larger" | "Largest"

export type AccessibilityPrefs = {
	ReduceMotion: boolean?,
	PreferredTransparency: number?,
	HighContrast: boolean?,
	PreferredTextSize: PreferredTextSizeName?,
}

--- Control chrome defaults (iOS-style switch I/O labels, etc.)
export type ThemeControls = {
	--- Show I / O glyphs on Switch tracks (iOS “Show On/Off Labels”).
	SwitchIcons: boolean?,
}

export type ThemeIcons = { [string]: string }
export type ThemeAudio = { [string]: string }

export type Theme = {
	Mode: ThemeMode,
	Colors: ThemeColors,
	--- Named colors for Color= props (primary, secondary, error, custom, …)
	Palette: ThemePalette,
	Fonts: ThemeFonts,
	Typography: ThemeTypography,
	Metrics: ThemeMetrics,
	Motion: ThemeMotion,
	Icons: ThemeIcons,
	Audio: ThemeAudio,
	Controls: ThemeControls,
	Accessibility: AccessibilityPrefs?,
}

export type ThemeRef = UsedAs<Theme>

--- Style only (Vuetify-like). Legacy names still accepted on Button.
export type ButtonVariant = "Filled" | "Tonal" | "Outlined" | "Text" | "Primary" | "Destructive"

export type TextVariant = string
export type AlertTone = "Info" | "Success" | "Warning" | "Error"
export type ProgressVariant = "Linear" | "Circular"
export type ProgressMode = "Determinate" | "Indeterminate" | "Buffering"
--- Determinate circular look: "Standard" = Material 3 (round caps, track gap); "Classic" = Material 2 (butt caps, full track).
export type ProgressStyle = "Standard" | "Classic"

-- Shared base
export type BaseProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	--- Top-level UI frame for overlays (dialogs, menus, toasts, drawers).
	--- Prefer providing this so overlays do not shift content layout.
	Layer: Instance?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type ButtonProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Text: UsedAs<string>?,
	--- Style: Filled | Tonal | Outlined | Text (legacy Primary/Destructive still work)
	Variant: (ButtonVariant | string)?,
	--- Palette name, Color3, hex, RGB table, or ThemeColorRole
	Color: UsedAs<ColorInput>?,
	OnClick: (() -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Icon: string?,
	--- Lucide icon before label
	LeadingIcon: string?,
	--- Lucide icon after label
	TrailingIcon: string?,
	HorizontalAlignment: Enum.HorizontalAlignment?,
	CornerRadius: number?,
	Padding: { number }?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type TextFieldResize = "None" | "Y" | "X" | "Both"

export type Validator = (value: any) -> (boolean, string?)

export type TextFieldProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Text: UsedAs<string>?,
	Placeholder: UsedAs<string>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	Helper: UsedAs<string>?,
	Error: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnChanged: ((string) -> ())?,
	Multiline: boolean?,
	MinLines: number?,
	MaxLines: number?,
	--- Corner grip resize (Material-style). Default `Y` when Multiline.
	Resize: TextFieldResize?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	LeadingIcon: string?,
	TrailingIcon: string?,
	Validators: { Validator }?,
	--- Validate on focus lost (default true when Validators set)
	ValidateOnBlur: boolean?,
	--- Small variant for in-widget fields: 28px tall, tighter padding, 13px text.
	Compact: boolean?,
	--- Input height in px (default 40, or 28 when `Compact`).
	Height: number?,
	--- Static text shown inside the left edge, e.g. "#".
	Prefix: string?,
	--- Called when the box loses focus (Enter or click away) with the text and the TextBox,
	--- so the caller can commit the value or restore the old text.
	OnSubmit: ((text: string, box: TextBox) -> ())?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type TextProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Text: UsedAs<string>,
	Variant: TextVariant?,
	Color: UsedAs<Color3>?,
	TextXAlignment: Enum.TextXAlignment?,
	TextWrapped: boolean?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type ListItemProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Title: UsedAs<string>,
	Subtitle: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnClick: (() -> ())?,
	Leading: Instance?,
	Trailing: Instance?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type ChipProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Text: UsedAs<string>,
	Selected: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	OnClick: (() -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	LeadingIcon: string?,
	TrailingIcon: string?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type DialogAction = {
	Text: string,
	Variant: (ButtonVariant | string)?,
	Color: ColorInput?,
	OnClick: (() -> ())?,
}

export type DialogProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Title: UsedAs<string>,
	Body: UsedAs<string>?,
	Actions: { DialogAction }?,
	OnClose: (() -> ())?,
	Open: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	--- Optional custom body content (forms, etc.)
	Children: any?,
	--- Optional Lucide icon above the title (alerts / confirms).
	Icon: string?,
	IconColor: UsedAs<Color3>?,
	IconSize: number?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type PromptProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Title: UsedAs<string>,
	Body: UsedAs<string>?,
	Actions: { DialogAction }?,
	OnClose: (() -> ())?,
	Open: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Children: any?,
	Icon: string?,
	IconColor: UsedAs<Color3>?,
	IconSize: number?,
	OnConfirm: (() -> ())?,
	ConfirmText: string?,
	CancelText: string?,
	Destructive: boolean?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type ConfirmDialogProps = PromptProps

export type SurfaceProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Name: string?,
	Elevated: boolean?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type OverlayProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	OnClick: (() -> ())?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type IconProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Name: string?, -- Lucide icon id
	Image: string?,
	Color: UsedAs<Color3>?,
	IconSize: number?,
	AssetSize: number?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type IconButtonProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Name: string?,
	Image: string?,
	OnClick: (() -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type CheckboxProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Checked: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnChanged: ((boolean) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type SwitchProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Checked: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnChanged: ((boolean) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	--- Override Theme.Controls.SwitchIcons for this switch.
	Icons: boolean?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type RadioOption = {
	Value: string,
	Label: string,
}

export type RadioProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Checked: UsedAs<boolean>,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnActivated: (() -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type RadioGroupProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Options: { RadioOption },
	Value: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnChanged: ((string) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type SelectOption = {
	Value: string,
	Label: string,
}

export type SelectProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Options: { SelectOption },
	Value: UsedAs<string>?,
	Placeholder: UsedAs<string>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnChanged: ((string) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Filterable: boolean?,
	Validators: { Validator }?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type MultiSelectProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Options: { SelectOption },
	Value: UsedAs<{ string }>?,
	Placeholder: UsedAs<string>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	OnChanged: (({ string }) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Validators: { Validator }?,
	--- `Chips` (default) shows a chip per selection; `Count` shows "N selected".
	Display: ("Chips" | "Count")?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type SpinnerProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	SizePx: number?,
	--- "Morph" (default) = shape-morphing LoadingIndicator; "Arc" = spinning ring arc.
	Style: ("Morph" | "Arc")?,
	--- Arc style only: colour the arc "erases" with. Match the surface behind the spinner.
	Background: Color3?,
	--- Draw the shape inside a round PrimaryContainer disc (Material 3 "contained").
	Contained: boolean?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type LoadingIndicatorProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	--- Container diameter in px (default 48).
	SizePx: number?,
	--- Draw the shape inside a round PrimaryContainer disc (Material 3 "contained").
	Contained: boolean?,
	--- Shape names to cycle through (see LoadingIndicator); default is the Material 3 sequence.
	Shapes: { string }?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type LoaderKind = "Beachball" | "Dots" | "Bars" | "Ripple" | "Orbit" | "Gnome" | "Icon"
export type LoaderMotion = "Spin" | "Pulse" | "Bounce" | "Flip" | "Wiggle"

export type LoaderProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	--- Which loader to draw (default "Dots").
	Kind: LoaderKind?,
	--- Square size in px (default 32).
	SizePx: number?,
	--- Static colour (default theme Primary). Ignored by Beachball, which is rainbow.
	Color: Color3?,
	--- Icon kind: Lucide icon name (default "loader").
	Icon: string?,
	--- Icon kind: motion preset (default "Spin").
	Motion: LoaderMotion?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type NumberSpinnerProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	--- The number to show; digits roll when it changes.
	Value: UsedAs<number>,
	--- Digits after the decimal point (default 0).
	Decimals: number?,
	--- Thousands separators (default true).
	Grouping: boolean?,
	Prefix: string?,
	Suffix: string?,
	TextSize: number?,
	FontFace: Font?,
	Color: Color3?,
	--- Width of one digit column in px (default ≈ 0.62 × TextSize).
	DigitWidth: number?,
	--- Integer digit slots to reserve so the box never resizes (default: initial digits + 1, min 4).
	Digits: number?,
	--- Fixed box width in px; overrides `Digits`.
	Width: number?,
	--- "Numeric" (default): iOS's numericText: a changed digit goes straight to its new value,
	--- sliding, scaling and blurring in and out, columns cascading left to right. "Roll": an
	--- odometer wheel through every digit in between.
	Style: ("Numeric" | "Roll")?,
	--- "Numeric" only: playback speed, 1 = default (< 1 slower, > 1 faster).
	Speed: number?,
	--- "Numeric" only: how much the landing overshoots, 0 = none to 1 = very bouncy
	--- (default 0.8, about a 25% overshoot; iOS itself is closer to 0.6).
	Bounce: number?,
	--- Padding in px around the digits for their travel and blur (default derived from the
	--- text size). The box clips to it.
	Padding: number?,
	--- "Roll" only: spring speed (default 11) and damping ratio (default 0.6, < 1 overshoots).
	SpringSpeed: number?,
	SpringDamping: number?,
	Align: Enum.HorizontalAlignment?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type CoachmarkProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	--- The element to point at.
	Target: Instance,
	--- Shown while true. Pass a Value so the card can close itself.
	Open: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Title: string?,
	Text: string?,
	--- Small caption above the title, e.g. "1 of 3".
	Step: string?,
	--- Action button label (default "Got it"); it also dismisses.
	ActionText: string?,
	OnAction: (() -> ())?,
	OnDismiss: (() -> ())?,
	Placement: TooltipPlacement?,
	--- Dim everything but the target (default true).
	Spotlight: boolean?,
	--- Scrim opacity 0–1 (default 0.55).
	Dim: number?,
	--- Tapping the dimmed area dismisses.
	DismissOnScrim: boolean?,
	--- px of breathing room around the target's cutout (default 6).
	TargetPadding: number?,
	--- px between target and card (default 16).
	Gap: number?,
	Width: number?,
	--- "Primary" (default, solid brand colour) or "Surface".
	Tone: ("Primary" | "Surface")?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type SliderProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Value: UsedAs<number>?,
	Min: number?,
	Max: number?,
	Step: number?,
	OnChanged: ((number) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type RangeSliderProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Value: UsedAs<NumberRange>?,
	Min: number?,
	Max: number?,
	--- Values snap to multiples of this (default 0.01).
	Step: number?,
	OnChanged: ((NumberRange) -> ())?,
	Disabled: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	Label: UsedAs<string>?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type AlertProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Title: UsedAs<string>?,
	Text: UsedAs<string>,
	Tone: AlertTone?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type SnackbarProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Message: UsedAs<string>,
	ActionText: string?,
	OnAction: (() -> ())?,
	--- Element before the message. Wins over `Icon`.
	Leading: Instance?,
	--- Lucide icon before the message.
	Icon: string?,
	--- Element after the action button.
	Trailing: Instance?,
	--- Show a close button at the end.
	Dismissible: boolean?,
	--- Called when the close button is pressed.
	OnDismiss: (() -> ())?,
	--- Let the message wrap and fill the width, for a fixed-width card (the host does this).
	Fill: boolean?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type SnackbarHostProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	--- Most toasts kept at once; the oldest is dismissed past this (default 5).
	MaxVisible: number?,
	--- Width of the stack in px (default 360).
	Width: number?,
	-- The host is driven by the table it returns; see Components.SnackbarHost
	[string]: any,
}

export type ProgressProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Value: UsedAs<number>?,
	Buffer: UsedAs<number>?,
	Variant: ProgressVariant?,
	Mode: ProgressMode?,
	--- Circular only. Outer diameter in px (default 40).
	SizePx: number?,
	--- Circular only.
	Style: ProgressStyle?,
	--- Circular only. Stroke thickness in px.
	Thickness: number?,
	--- Circular indeterminate only: "Morph" (default) or "Arc".
	Indicator: ("Morph" | "Arc")?,
	--- Circular "Arc" indeterminate only: colour the arc erases with (default Surface).
	Background: Color3?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type BadgeProps = {
	Theme: ThemeRef?,

local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)

local Children = Fusion.Children

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.AppBarProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local actions: { Instance } = props.Actions or {}

	-- Raise level, 0..1. With FadeAtTop it follows the scroll offset: at the top the fill is
	-- FadeTo and the divider and shadow are hidden. Without FadeAtTop it is always 1.
	local fadeTo: Color3 = props.FadeTo or theme.Colors.SurfaceContainerHigh
	-- Fill once raised. Defaults to Surface.
	local raisedColor: Color3 = props.RaisedColor or theme.Colors.Surface
	local ramp: number = props.FadeRamp or 24
	local raised: any = 1
	if props.FadeAtTop and props.ScrollOffset ~= nil then
		local target = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local offset = if typeof(props.ScrollOffset) == "table"
				then use(props.ScrollOffset)
				else props.ScrollOffset
			return math.clamp((offset :: number) / ramp, 0, 1)
		end)
		raised = scope:Spring(target, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	end
	local function level(use: any): number
		local v = if typeof(raised) == "table" then use(raised) else raised
		return math.clamp(v :: number, 0, 1)
	end

	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "AppBar",
		BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return Interaction.lerpColor(fadeTo, raisedColor, level(use), use)
		end),
		CornerRadius = props.Radius or { theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel, 0 },
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, theme.Metrics.AppBarHeight),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 10,
		Shadow = if props.Shadow == false
			then nil
			else {
				BlurRadius = 14,
				Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2),
				Transparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return 1 - 0.18 * level(use)
				end),
			},
		[Children] = {
			-- Bottom divider rather than an outline, so it doesn't double up with the Window's border.
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Divider",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
				BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return 1 - level(use)
				end),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
				ZIndex = 2,
			}),
			if props.Leading
				then scope:Apply(props.Leading)({
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40),
				})
				else nil,
			scope:TextLabel({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = theme.Fonts.Heading,
				TextSize = 18,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
				Text = props.Title or "",
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(if props.Leading then 56 else 16, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, 0),
			}),
			scope:Frame({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40),
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					Padding = 4,
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
				},
				[Children] = actions,
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame
end

--[[
	iOS-style bottom sheet: scrim + sliding panel mounted via Layer.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local CanvasFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.CanvasFade)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Corners = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Corners)
local Overlay = require(script.Parent.Overlay)
local IconButton = require(script.Parent.IconButton)

local Children = Fusion.Children

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.AppSheetProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local detent = props.Detent or 0.92
	local showGrabber = props.ShowGrabber ~= false
	local openRef = props.Open
	local open = scope:Computed(function(use)
		if openRef == nil then
			return true
		end
		return (if typeof(openRef) == "table" then use(openRef) else openRef) == true
	end)
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 0.85,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local headerKids: { any } = {
		scope:TextLabel({
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = theme.Typography.Title.Font,
			TextSize = theme.Typography.Title.Size,
			TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Text = props.Title or "",
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			LayoutOrder = 1,
		}),
		scope:Apply(IconButton(scope, {
			Theme = theme,
			Name = "x",
			OnClick = props.OnClose,
			Color = theme.Colors.Outline,
			Variant = "Tonal",
		}))({
			LayoutOrder = 2,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40),
		}),
	}
	local titleLabel = headerKids[1]
	if titleLabel and titleLabel:IsA("GuiObject") then
		local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
		flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
		flex.Parent = titleLabel
	end

	local panelKids: { any } = {}
	if showGrabber then
		table.insert(
			panelKids,
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Grabber",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
				LayoutOrder = 1,
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				},
				[Children] = {
					scope:Frame({
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 4),
						BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Outline,
						CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
					}),
				},
			})
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		panelKids,
		scope:Frame({
			Name = "Header",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48),
			LayoutOrder = 2,
			Padding = { 0, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd },
			Layout = {
				Kind = "List",
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Padding = theme.Metrics.SpaceXs,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			},
			[Children] = headerKids,
		})
	)
	table.insert(
		panelKids,
		scope:Frame({
			Name = "Body",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			LayoutOrder = 3,
			Padding = { 0, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd },
			[Children] = { props.Children },
		})
	)

	-- TextButton sinks Overlay Activated; Frame.Active alone does not.
	local panel = scope:TextButton({
		Name = "AppSheetPanel",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, detent, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = CanvasFade.surfaceTransparency(scope, openS, { Theme = theme }),
		ZIndex = 111,
		Active = true,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = panelKids,
	})

	-- Flush to the bottom edge: top corners round, bottom corners follow the enclosing Window
	-- (square when there is none).
	local sheetRadius: number = theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel
	table.insert(
		scope,
		Corners.followWindow(panel, function(windowRadius: number)
			Corners.apply(panel, sheetRadius, sheetRadius, windowRadius, windowRadius)
		end)
	)

	local host = CanvasFade.host(scope, panel, openS, { Theme = theme })
	scope:Apply(host)({
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, detent, 0),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
			-- openS 0 → fully below; 1 → flush to bottom
			return UDim2.new(0, 0, 1 + (1 - use(openS)) * detent, 0)
		end),
	})

	local root = scope:Frame({
		Name = "AppSheet",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return use(openS) > 0.02 and (props.Visible ~= false)
		end),
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 110,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Apply(Overlay(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				OnClick = props.OnClose,
				ZIndex = 110,
			}))({
				BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return 1 - (use(openS) :: number) * 0.55
				end),
			}),
			host,
		},
	}) :: Frame

	Layer.mount(scope, props, root)
	Focus.trap(scope, root, open)
	Focus.escape(scope, open, Focus.closer(props))
	return root
end

local function normalizeVariant(
	variant: string?,
	colorProp: Types.ColorInput?
): (string, Types.ColorInput?)
	local v = variant or "Filled"
	-- Legacy variants that encoded color
	if v == "Primary" then
		return "Filled", colorProp or "primary"
	end
	if v == "Destructive" then
		return "Filled", colorProp or "error"
	end
	if v == "Tonal" or v == "Outlined" or v == "Text" or v == "Filled" then
		return v, colorProp
	end
	return "Filled", colorProp
end

local function styleFromRole(
	style: string,
	role: Types.ThemeColorRole,
	theme: Types.Theme
): (Color3, Color3, number, boolean, Color3)
	if style == "Tonal" then
		return role.Container, role.OnContainer, 0, false, role.OnContainer
	end
	if style == "Outlined" then
		return theme.Colors.Surface, role.Base, 0, true, role.Base
	end
	if style == "Text" then
		return role.Base, role.Base, 1, false, role.Base
	end
	-- Filled
	return role.Base, role.OnBase, 0, false, role.OnBase
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.ButtonProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local style, colorInput =
		normalizeVariant(props.Variant, peek(props.Color) :: Types.ColorInput?)
	local role = Color.resolve(colorInput, theme, "primary")
	local bg, fg, transparency, outlined, stateColor = styleFromRole(style, role, theme)
	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true
	local padX = math.max(theme.Metrics.ButtonPadX, 8)
	local padY = math.max(theme.Metrics.ButtonPadY - 2, 2)
	local leading = props.LeadingIcon or props.Icon
	local trailing = props.TrailingIcon

	local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
		Disabled = disabled,
		StateColor = stateColor,
	})

	-- MD3 disabled: on-surface @ 12% container, label @ 38%
	local disabledBg = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return Interaction.lerpColor(
			use(theme.Colors.Surface),
			use(theme.Colors.OnSurface),
			0.12,
			use
		)
	end)
	local disabledFg = theme.Colors.OnSurface

	local kids = {}
	if leading then
		table.insert(
			kids,
			scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = leading,
				IconSize = 18,
				Color = if disabled then disabledFg else fg,
			}))({
				LayoutOrder = 1,
				ImageTransparency = if disabled then 0.62 else 0,
			})
		)
	end
	local typeScale = theme.Typography.Button or theme.Typography.Label or theme.Typography.Body
	table.insert(
		kids,
		scope:TextLabel({
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = typeScale.Font,
			TextSize = typeScale.Size,
			Text = props.Text or "Button",
			TextColor3 = if disabled then disabledFg else fg,
			TextTransparency = if disabled then 0.62 else 0,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
			LayoutOrder = 2,
		})
	)
	if trailing then
		table.insert(
			kids,
			scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = trailing,
				IconSize = 18,
				Color = if disabled then disabledFg else fg,
			}))({
				LayoutOrder = 3,
				ImageTransparency = if disabled then 0.62 else 0,
			})
		)
	end

	local button = scope:TextButton(P({
		Name = "Button",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Active = not disabled,
		BackgroundColor3 = if disabled
			then disabledBg
			else (if transparency >= 1 then stateColor else ix.fill(bg)),
		BackgroundTransparency = if disabled
			then 0
			else (if transparency >= 1 then ix.fillTransparency(1) else transparency),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		-- Clipping cuts UIStroke; only clip filled variants.
		ClipsDescendants = not outlined,
		CornerRadius = if props.CornerRadius then props.CornerRadius else theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
		Padding = if props.Padding then props.Padding else { padY, padX },
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			HorizontalAlignment = if props.HorizontalAlignment
				then props.HorizontalAlignment
				else Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			Padding = 6,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		Outline = if outlined and not disabled
			then {
				Color = role.Base,
				Thickness = 1,
				Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
			}
			else nil,
		[OnEvent("Activated")] = if disabled then nil else props.OnClick,
		[Children] = kids,
	})) :: TextButton

	if not disabled then
		ix.wire(button)
	end
	return button
end

--!strict
--[[
	Coachmark: "feature discovery" card that points the user at something new.

	A dimmed spotlight (the target stays bright and clickable), a pulsing ring around
	the target, and a card with an arrow that points at it:

		C.Coachmark(scope, {
			Target = saveButton,
			Open = showTip,                 -- Value<boolean> (set false when dismissed)
			Title = "Save your work",
			Text = "Changes sync automatically, but you can save a snapshot here.",
			Step = "1 of 3",                -- optional
			ActionText = "Got it",
			OnDismiss = function() ... end,
		})

	Mounts on `Layer` (or the ambient overlay layer) so it floats above the layout.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local CanvasFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.CanvasFade)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Follow = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Follow)
local place = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Placement)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

local ARROW = 14 -- px, side of the rotated square
local PULSE_PERIOD = 1.6

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.CoachmarkProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local spotlight = props.Spotlight ~= false
	local dim = props.Dim or 0.55
	local pad = props.TargetPadding or 6
	local gap = props.Gap or 16
	local placement: Types.TooltipPlacement = props.Placement or "Auto"
	local tone = props.Tone or "Primary"

	local cardColor = if tone == "Surface"
		then theme.Colors.SurfaceContainerHigh
		else theme.Colors.Primary
	local onCard = if tone == "Surface" then theme.Colors.OnSurface else theme.Colors.OnPrimary
	local accent = if tone == "Surface" then theme.Colors.Primary else theme.Colors.OnPrimary

	-- Open can be a plain boolean or a state we're allowed to close.
	local open: any = props.Open
	if typeof(open) ~= "table" then
		open = scope:Value(open ~= false)
	end
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local function dismiss()
		if open.set then
			open:set(false)
		end
		if props.OnDismiss then
			props.OnDismiss()
		end
	end

	-- Scrim: four rects around a hole, so the target stays visible and clickable
	local function scrimRect(name: string)
		return scope:New("TextButton")({
			Name = name,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - (1 - dim) * math.clamp(use(openS) :: number, 0, 1)
			end),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Active = true,
			Visible = spotlight,
			ZIndex = 1,
			[Fusion.OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
				if props.DismissOnScrim then
					dismiss()
				end
			end,
		}) :: TextButton
	end
	local scrimTop, scrimBottom = scrimRect("ScrimTop"), scrimRect("ScrimBottom")
	local scrimLeft, scrimRight = scrimRect("ScrimLeft"), scrimRect("ScrimRight")

	-- Pulsing ring around the target
	local ringStroke = scope:New("UIStroke")({
		Color = if tone == "Surface" then theme.Colors.Primary else Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Thickness = 2,
		Transparency = 1,
	}) :: UIStroke
	local ring = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Pulse",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = 2,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.RadiusSm) }),
			ringStroke,
		},
	}) :: Frame

	-- Card
	local function label(
		text: string,
		size: number,
		font: Font,
		transparency: number,
		order: number
	)
		return scope:New("TextLabel")({
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			FontFace = font,
			TextSize = size,
			TextColor3 = onCard,
			TextTransparency = transparency,
			Text = text,
			LayoutOrder = order,
		})
	end

	local content: { any } = {}
	if props.Step then
		table.insert(content, label(props.Step, 12, theme.Typography.Label.Font, 0.25, 1))
	end
	if props.Title then
		table.insert(content, label(props.Title, 17, theme.Typography.Label.Font, 0, 2))
	end
	if props.Text then
		table.insert(content, label(props.Text, 14, theme.Fonts.Body, 0.1, 3))
	end
	table.insert(
		content,
		scope:New("TextButton")({
			Name = "Action",
			LayoutOrder = 4,
			AutoButtonColor = true,
			BackgroundColor3 = accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
			FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
			TextSize = 14,
			TextColor3 = onCard,
			Text = props.ActionText or "Got it",
			[Fusion.OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
				if props.OnAction then
					props.OnAction()
				end
				dismiss()
			end,
			[Children] = {
				scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				scope:New("UIPadding")({
					PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6),
					PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6),
					PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14),
					PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14),
				}),
			} :: any,
		})
	)

	local arrow = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Arrow",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		BackgroundColor3 = cardColor,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Rotation = 45,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ARROW, ARROW),
		ZIndex = 3,
		[Children] = { scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3) }) },
	}) :: Frame

	local card = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Card",
		BackgroundColor3 = cardColor,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(props.Width or 280, 0),
		ZIndex = 4,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel) }),
			scope:New("UIPadding")({
				PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd),
				PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd),
				PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd),
				PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd),
			}),
			scope:New("UIListLayout")({
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceSm),
			}),
			content,
		},
	}) :: Frame

	-- Card fades and rises in; the arrow stays attached to the card edge.
	local cardHost = CanvasFade.host(scope, card, openS, { Theme = theme })
	cardHost.ZIndex = 4

	local root = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Coachmark",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 150,
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return (use(openS) :: number) > 0.01
		end),
		[Children] = {
			scrimTop,
			scrimBottom,
			scrimLeft,
			scrimRight,
			ring :: any,
			arrow :: any,
			cardHost :: any,
		},
	}) :: Frame

	local mounted = Layer.mount(scope, props, root)
	if not mounted then
		warn(
			"[Pantheon.Coachmark] no overlay Layer found; pass `Layer` or call inside Layer.Provide"
		)
	end

	local clock = 0

	local function update(dt: number)
		local target = Layer.asGui(props.Target)
		local layer = Layer.resolve(props)
		if target == nil or layer == nil then
			return
		end
		clock += dt
		local origin = layer.AbsolutePosition
		local W, H = layer.AbsoluteSize.X, layer.AbsoluteSize.Y

		-- Target bounds in layer space, padded.
		local tp = target.AbsolutePosition - origin - Vector2.new(pad, pad)
		local ts = target.AbsoluteSize + Vector2.new(pad * 2, pad * 2)
		local tx, ty = math.max(tp.X, 0), math.max(tp.Y, 0)
		local tw, th = math.min(ts.X, W - tx), math.min(ts.Y, H - ty)

		scrimTop.Position, scrimTop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(W, ty)
		scrimBottom.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, ty + th)
		scrimBottom.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, math.max(H - (ty + th), 0))
		scrimLeft.Position, scrimLeft.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, ty), UDim2.fromOffset(tx, th)
		scrimRight.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tx + tw, ty)
		scrimRight.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(W - (tx + tw), 0), th)

		-- Pulse: ring grows outward from the target and fades.
		local u = (clock / PULSE_PERIOD) % 1
		local grow = u * 14
		ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tx - grow, ty - grow)
		ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tw + grow * 2, th + grow * 2)
		ringStroke.Transparency = 1 - (1 - u) * 0.9 * math.clamp(peek(openS) :: number, 0, 1)

		-- Card + arrow. Placed and clamped in the layer's own space, so inside a Window the
		-- card stays within the window (not just within the screen).
		local pos, side = place(placement, tp, ts, cardHost.AbsoluteSize, gap, layer.AbsoluteSize)
		local cx, cy = pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Offset
		local rise = (1 - math.clamp(peek(openS) :: number, 0, 1)) * 10
		cardHost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy + rise)

		-- Arrow sits on the card edge facing the target, aimed at the target's centre.
		local cs = cardHost.AbsoluteSize
		local centreX = math.clamp(tp.X + ts.X / 2 - cx, 18, math.max(cs.X - 18, 18))
		local centreY = math.clamp(tp.Y + ts.Y / 2 - cy, 18, math.max(cs.Y - 18, 18))
		if side == "Bottom" then
			arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + centreX, cy + rise)
		elseif side == "Top" then
			arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + centreX, cy + cs.Y + rise)
		elseif side == "Right" then
			arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy + centreY + rise)
		else
			arrow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + cs.X, cy + centreY + rise)
		end
		arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(peek(openS) :: number, 0, 1)
	end

	Follow(scope, openS, function(v)
		return v > 0.01
	end, update)

	return root
end

--[[
	Sortable / filterable data table with virtualized body.
	CanvasGroup clips children to rounded corners (UICorner alone cannot).
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local VirtualList = require(script.Parent.VirtualList)
local P = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.props)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.DataTableProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local rowHeight = props.RowHeight or 48
	local sortCol = scope:Value(peek(props.SortColumn) or "")
	local sortAsc =
		scope:Value(if props.SortAscending == nil then true else peek(props.SortAscending))

	local processed = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local rows = table.clone(use(props.Rows) :: { { [string]: any } })
		local filter = string.lower(tostring(use(props.Filter) or ""))
		if filter ~= "" then
			local filtered = {}
			for _, row in rows do
				local parts = {}
				for _, col in props.Columns do
					table.insert(parts, tostring(row[col.Id] or ""))
				end
				local hay = string.lower(table.concat(parts, " "))
				if string.find(hay, filter, 1, true) then
					table.insert(filtered, row)
				end
			end
			rows = filtered
		end
		local col = use(sortCol)
		if col ~= "" then
			local asc = use(sortAsc)
			table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
				local av, bv = tostring(a[col] or ""), tostring(b[col] or "")
				if asc then
					return av < bv
				end
				return av > bv
			end)
		end
		return rows
	end)

	local headers = {}
	for i, col in props.Columns do
		local w = col.Width or 120
		table.insert(
			headers,
			scope:TextButton({
				Text = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local title = col.Title
					if use(sortCol) == col.Id then
						return title .. (if use(sortAsc) then " ↑" else " ↓")
					end
					return title
				end),
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
				TextSize = theme.Typography.Label.Size,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0),
				LayoutOrder = i,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Padding = { 0, theme.Metrics.SpaceSm },
				[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
					if col.Sortable == false then
						return
					end
					if peek(sortCol) == col.Id then
						sortAsc:set(not peek(sortAsc))
					else
						sortCol:set(col.Id)
						sortAsc:set(true)
					end
					if props.OnSort then
						props.OnSort(peek(sortCol), peek(sortAsc))
					end
				end,
			})
		)
	end

	local body = VirtualList(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		ItemCount = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return #use(processed)
		end),
		ItemHeight = rowHeight,
		Padding = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -45),
		RenderItem = function(rowScope, index)
			local cells = {}
			for i, col in props.Columns do
				table.insert(
					cells,
					rowScope:TextLabel({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
						TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
						TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						Text = rowScope:Computed(function(use)
							local rows = use(processed) :: { { [string]: any } }
							local row = rows[index]
							if row == nil then
								return ""
							end
							return tostring(row[col.Id] or "")
						end),
						Size = UDim2.new(0, col.Width or 120, 1, 0),
						LayoutOrder = i,
						Padding = { 0, theme.Metrics.SpaceSm },
					})
				)
			end
			return rowScope:TextButton(P({
				Text = "",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
				BackgroundTransparency = if index % 2 == 0 then 0 else 0.03,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight),
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				ClipsDescendants = true,
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
					Padding = 0,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				},
				[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
					if props.OnSelect then
						props.OnSelect(index, true)
					end
				end,
				[Children] = {
					rowScope:Frame(P({
						Name = "Content",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -1),
						LayoutOrder = 1,
						Layout = {
							Kind = "List",
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							Padding = 0,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
						},
						[Children] = cells,
					})),
					rowScope:Frame(P({
						Name = "Divider",
						BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
						LayoutOrder = 2,
					})),
				},
			}))
		end,
	})

	-- CanvasGroup clips to UICorner (Frame.ClipsDescendants does not)
	return scope:New("CanvasGroup")({
		Name = "DataTable",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({
				CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel),
			}),
			scope:New("UIStroke")({
				Color = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
				Thickness = 1,
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
			}),
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Header",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					Padding = 0,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				},
				Padding = { 0, theme.Metrics.SpaceXs },
				[Children] = headers,
			}),
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Hairline",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 44),
			}),
			scope:Apply(body)({
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 45),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -45),
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
--[[
	Cadence dialog: scrim + centered surface.
	Actions: 2 → full-width horizontal; 3+ → stacked vertical.
	Pass Layer (top UI frame) so the modal does not shift content layout.
	Optional Icon appears above the title (alerts / confirms).
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local CanvasFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.CanvasFade)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Overlay = require(script.Parent.Overlay)
local Button = require(script.Parent.Button)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.DialogProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local openRef = props.Open
	local open = scope:Computed(function(use)
		if openRef == nil then
			return true
		end
		return (if typeof(openRef) == "table" then use(openRef) else openRef) ~= false
	end)
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local actions: { Types.DialogAction } = props.Actions or {}
	if props.OnClose and #actions == 0 then
		actions = {
			{
				Text = "Close",
				Variant = "Text" :: Types.ButtonVariant,
				OnClick = props.OnClose,
			},
		}
	end

	local actionCount = #actions
	local horizontal = actionCount > 0 and actionCount <= 2
	local actionRow = {}
	for i, action in actions do
		local variant = action.Variant
			or (if i == actionCount then "Filled" else (if horizontal then "Tonal" else "Text"))
		local btn = Button(scope, {
			Theme = theme,
			Text = action.Text,
			Variant = variant,
			Color = action.Color,
			OnClick = action.OnClick,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = if horizontal then UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40) else UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		})
		if horizontal then
			local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
			flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
			flex.Parent = btn
		end
		table.insert(actionRow, btn)
	end

	local hasIcon = props.Icon ~= nil and props.Icon ~= ""
	local iconSize = props.IconSize or 28
	local titleAlign = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	-- TextButton sinks Overlay Activated; Frame.Active alone does not.
	local panel = scope:TextButton({
		Name = "DialogPanel",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(320, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Active = true,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel,
		Outline = {
			Color = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
			Thickness = 1,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		Shadow = {
			BlurRadius = 12,
			Transparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - (use(openS) :: number) * 0.15
			end),
		},
		Padding = { theme.Metrics.SpaceLg },
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = {
			if hasIcon
				then scope:Frame({
					Name = "IconWell",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, iconSize + 12),
					LayoutOrder = 0,
					Layout = {
						Kind = "List",
						FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
						HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
						VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
					},
					[Children] = {
						Icon(scope, {
							Theme = theme,
							Name = props.Icon,
							IconSize = iconSize,
							Color = props.IconColor or theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
						}),
					},
				})
				else nil,
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Labels",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				LayoutOrder = 1,
				Padding = { theme.Metrics.SpaceXs, 0, 0, 0 },
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					Padding = theme.Metrics.Space2xs,
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
				},
				[Children] = {
					scope:TextLabel({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						FontFace = theme.Typography.Title.Font,
						TextSize = theme.Typography.Title.Size,
						TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
						TextXAlignment = titleAlign,
						Text = props.Title,
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
						LayoutOrder = 1,
					}),
					if props.Body
						then scope:TextLabel({
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
							TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
							TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
							TextWrapped = true,
							TextXAlignment = titleAlign,
							Text = props.Body,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							LayoutOrder = 2,
						})
						else nil,
				},
			}),
			if props.Children then props.Children else nil,
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Actions",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				LayoutOrder = 10,
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					FillDirection = if horizontal
						then Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
						else Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
					HorizontalFlex = if horizontal then Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill else nil,
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					Padding = theme.Metrics.SpaceXs,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				},
				Padding = { theme.Metrics.SpaceMd, 0, 0, 0 },
				[Children] = actionRow,
			}),
		},
	})

	local baseZ = props.ZIndex or 100
	local outlineStroke = scope:New("UIStroke")({
		Name = "DialogOutlineFlash",
		Parent = panel,
		Color = theme.Colors.Outline,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		Thickness = 2,
		Transparency = 1,
	})

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = panel
	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(openS):onBind(function()
			local t = peek(openS)
			if peek(open) then
				scale.Scale = 1.1 - 0.1 * t
			else
				scale.Scale = 0.9 + 0.1 * t
			end

			-- Pulse around t ~= 0.5 (as openS springs from 0 -> 1).
			local pulse = math.clamp(1 - math.abs(2 * t - 1), 0, 1)
			outlineStroke.Transparency = 1 - pulse * 0.85
			outlineStroke.Thickness = 1 + pulse * 2
		end)
	)

	local panelHost = CanvasFade.host(scope, panel, openS, { Theme = theme })

	local root = scope:Frame({
		Name = "Dialog",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return use(openS) > 0.02 and (props.Visible ~= false)
		end),
		ZIndex = baseZ,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Apply(Overlay(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				OnClick = props.OnClose,
				ZIndex = baseZ,
			}))({
				BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return 1 - (use(openS) :: number) * 0.55
				end),
			}),
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "DialogCenter",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
				ZIndex = baseZ + 1,
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				},
				[Children] = { panelHost },
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame

	Layer.mount(scope, props, root)
	Focus.trap(scope, root, open)
	Focus.escape(scope, open, Focus.closer(props))
	return root
end
