--!strict
--[[
	A panel with a header: a title or a strip of tabs, header actions, and content below.
	It can collapse to its header. See docs/Components/Layout/DockPanel.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Persist = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Persist)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local GroupFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.GroupFade)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local HEADER_HEIGHT = 32

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.DockPanelProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local tabs = props.Tabs
	local hasTabs = tabs ~= nil and #tabs > 0

	local persistKey = Persist.key("DockPanel", props.Id, false)
	local open = Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "open", peek(props.Open) ~= false)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Open, open)
	local selected = Persist.value(
		scope,
		persistKey,
		"selected",
		peek(props.Selected) or (if hasTabs then (tabs :: { Types.DockTab })[1].Id else "")
	)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Selected, selected)

	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed,
		1
	)

	-- header
	local headerKids: { any } = {
		scope:New("UIListLayout")({
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
		}),
		scope:New("UIPadding")({ PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
	}

	if props.Collapsible then
		local arrow = scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
			Theme = theme,
			Name = "chevron-down",
			IconSize = 16,
			Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
		}))({
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			Rotation = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return -90 * (1 - (use(openS) :: number))
			end),
		})
		local toggle = scope:New("TextButton")({
			Name = "Toggle",
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
				open:set(not peek(open))
			end,
			[Children] = { arrow } :: any,
		}) :: TextButton
		Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {}).wire(toggle)
		table.insert(headerKids, toggle)
	end

	-- The tab strip, with an underline that slides to the selected tab.
	local strip: Frame? = nil
	if hasTabs then
		local indicatorX = scope:Value(0)
		local indicatorW = scope:Value(0)
		local xS = scope:Spring(indicatorX, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, 1)
		local wS = scope:Spring(indicatorW, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, 1)
		local buttons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}
		local stripFrame = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Tabs",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			LayoutOrder = 2,
		}) :: Frame
		strip = stripFrame
		local function place()
			local button = buttons[peek(selected) :: string]
			if button and stripFrame.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
				indicatorX:set(button.AbsolutePosition.X - stripFrame.AbsolutePosition.X)
				indicatorW:set(button.AbsoluteSize.X)
			end
		end
		local row = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Row",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			Parent = stripFrame,
		}) :: Frame
		scope:New("UIListLayout")({
			Parent = row,
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
		})
		for index, tab in tabs :: { Types.DockTab } do
			local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {})
			local label = scope:New("TextButton")({
				Name = tab.Id,
				Text = tab.Title,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
				LayoutOrder = index,
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local on = if use(selected) == tab.Id then 1 else 0
					return Interaction.lerpColor(
						use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant),
						use(theme.Colors.OnSurface),
						math.max(on, (use(ix.Hover) :: number) * 0.6),
						use
					)
				end),
				[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
					selected:set(tab.Id)
					if props.OnTabChanged then
						props.OnTabChanged(tab.Id)
					end
				end,
				[Children] = scope:New("UIPadding")({
					PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8),
					PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8),
				}),
			}) :: TextButton
			ix.wire(label)
			buttons[tab.Id] = label
			label.Parent = row
			table.insert(scope, label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(place))
		end
		table.insert(
			scope,
			scope:Observer(selected):onChange(function()
				task.defer(place)
			end)
		)
		table.insert(scope, stripFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(place))
		task.defer(place)
		scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Underline",
			Parent = stripFrame,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
			Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return UDim2.new(0, use(xS) :: number, 1, 0)
			end),
			Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(use(wS) :: number, 0), 2)
			end),
			BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Primary,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
		})
		table.insert(headerKids, stripFrame)
	else
		table.insert(
			headerKids,
			scope:New("TextLabel")({
				Name = "Title",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
				LayoutOrder = 2,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
				Text = props.Title or "",
				[Children] = scope:New("UIFlexItem")({ FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill }),
			})
		)
	end
	if strip then
		local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
		flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
		flex.Parent = strip
	end

	local actions: { Instance } = props.Actions or {}
	for index, action in actions do
		table.insert(headerKids, scope:Apply(action)({ LayoutOrder = 10 + index }))
	end
	if props.OnClose then
		local close = scope:New("TextButton")({
			Name = "Close",
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
			LayoutOrder = 99,
			[OnEvent("Activated")] = props.OnClose,
			[Children] = {
				scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
					Theme = theme,
					Name = "x",
					IconSize = 14,
					Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
				}))({
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				}),
			} :: any,
		}) :: TextButton
		Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {}).wire(close)
		table.insert(headerKids, close)
	end

	local header = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Header",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEADER_HEIGHT),
		[Children] = headerKids,
	}) :: Frame

	-- content
	local content = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Content",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEADER_HEIGHT),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -HEADER_HEIGHT),
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return (use(openS) :: number) > 0.02
		end),
	}) :: Frame
	GroupFade.bind(scope, content, openS)

	if hasTabs then
		for _, tab in tabs :: { Types.DockTab } do
			local page = scope:Apply(tab.Content)({
				Parent = content,
				Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return use(selected) == tab.Id
				end),
			})
			if page:IsA("GuiObject") then
				local gui = page :: GuiObject
				gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				gui.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
			end
		end
	elseif props.Children then
		scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Body",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			Parent = content,
			[Children] = props.Children,
		})
	end

	-- Collapsing shrinks the panel to its header: the height is the full height at 1 and the
	-- header at 0, whatever mix of scale and offset the full size is made of.
	local full = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "DockPanel",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		Size = if props.Collapsible
			then scope:Computed(function(use)
				local t = use(openS) :: number
				return UDim2.new(
					full.X.Scale,
					full.X.Offset,
					full.Y.Scale * t,
					full.Y.Offset * t + HEADER_HEIGHT * (1 - t)
				)
			end)
			else full,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusSm,
		Outline = {
			Color = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
			Thickness = 1,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		[Children] = { header, content },
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
--[[
	A tree of Instances, like the Explorer of Studio: expand, filter, select several, rename,
	and drag to reparent. See docs/Components/Layout/Explorer.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local VirtualList = require(script.Parent.VirtualList)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6
local DOUBLE_CLICK = 0.35

type Row = { instance: Instance, depth: number, expandable: boolean, open: boolean }

--- Icon for a class, by the most specific class that has one.
local ICONS: { [string]: string } = {
	Workspace = "globe",
	Terrain = "mountain",
	Camera = "camera",
	Players = "users",
	Player = "user",
	Humanoid = "person-standing",
	Tool = "wrench",
	Model = "package",
	Folder = "folder",
	Script = "file-code",
	LocalScript = "file-code",
	ModuleScript = "file-code",
	Sound = "volume-2",
	Light = "lightbulb",
	ScreenGui = "monitor",
	SurfaceGui = "monitor",
	BillboardGui = "monitor",
	Frame = "square",
	ScrollingFrame = "square",
	TextLabel = "type",
	TextButton = "mouse-pointer",
	TextBox = "type",
	ImageLabel = "image",
	ImageButton = "image",
	BasePart = "box",
	Attachment = "crosshair",
	ParticleEmitter = "sparkles",
	Sky = "sun",
	Fire = "flame",
}
local CLASS_ORDER = {
	"Workspace",
	"Terrain",
	"Camera",
	"Players",
	"Player",
	"Humanoid",
	"Tool",
	"Model",
	"Folder",
	"Script",
	"LocalScript",
	"ModuleScript",
	"Sound",
	"Light",
	"ScreenGui",
	"SurfaceGui",
	"BillboardGui",
	"ScrollingFrame",
	"Frame",
	"TextLabel",
	"TextButton",
	"TextBox",
	"ImageLabel",
	"ImageButton",
	"BasePart",
	"Attachment",
	"ParticleEmitter",
	"Sky",
	"Fire",
}

local function defaultIcon(instance: Instance): string
	for _, class in CLASS_ORDER do
		if instance:IsA(class) then
			return ICONS[class]
		end
	end
	return "box"
end

local function sameSet(a: { [Instance]: boolean }, b: { [Instance]: boolean }): boolean
	for key in a do
		if not b[key] then
			return false
		end
	end
	for key in b do
		if not a[key] then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.ExplorerProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local rowHeight = props.RowHeight or 24
	local indent = props.Indent or 14
	local iconFor: (Instance) -> string = props.Icon or defaultIcon
	local roots = props.Roots

	local expanded = scope:Value({} :: { [Instance]: boolean })
	local selected = scope:Value({} :: { [Instance]: boolean })
	local anchor: Instance? = nil
	local renaming = scope:Value(nil :: Instance?)
	local version = scope:Value(0) -- bumped when the tree or a name changes
	local scrollOffset = scope:Value(0)
	local scrolled = 0
	local viewHeight = 240

	if props.DefaultExpanded ~= false then
		local first = {}
		for _, root in roots do
			first[root] = true
		end
		expanded:set(first)
	end

	-- what changes the list
	local pending = false
	local function bump()
		if pending then
			return
		end
		pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			pending = false
			version:set(peek(version) + 1)
		end)
	end
	for _, root in roots do
		table.insert(scope, root.DescendantAdded:Connect(bump))
		table.insert(scope, root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(bump))
	end
	local nameWatch: { [Instance]: RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	table.insert(scope, function()
		for _, connection in nameWatch do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(nameWatch)
	end)

	-- the flat list of rows
	local function matches(instance: Instance, text: string): boolean
		return string.find(string.lower(instance.Name), text, 1, true) ~= nil
			or (props.Match ~= nil and props.Match(instance, text) == true)
	end

	local rows = scope:Computed(function(use)
		use(version)
		local open = use(expanded) :: { [Instance]: boolean }
		local filter =
			string.lower(tostring(if props.Filter ~= nil then use(props.Filter) else "") or "")
		local include = props.Include
		local list: { Row } = {}

		--- Adds `instance` and what is under it. With a filter, only branches that hold a match.
		--- Returns whether anything was added.
		local function visit(instance: Instance, depth: number): boolean
			if include and not include(instance) then
				return false
			end
			local kids = instance:GetChildren()
			local start = #list + 1
			local hereMatches = filter == "" or matches(instance, filter)
			table.insert(
				list,
				{ instance = instance, depth = depth, expandable = #kids > 0, open = false }
			)
			local anyChild = false
			if filter ~= "" or open[instance] then
				for _, child in kids do
					if visit(child, depth + 1) then
						anyChild = true
					end
				end
			end
			if filter ~= "" then
				if not hereMatches and not anyChild then
					-- Nothing here matches: take this branch back out.
					for at = #list, start, -1 do
						table.remove(list, at)
					end
					return false
				end
				list[start].open = anyChild
			else
				list[start].open = open[instance] == true
			end
			return true
		end
		for _, root in roots do
			visit(root, 0)
		end

		-- Watch the names of what is listed.
		local present: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
		for _, row in list do
			present[row.instance] = true
			if not nameWatch[row.instance] then
				nameWatch[row.instance] =
					row.instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"):Connect(bump)
			end
		end
		for instance, connection in nameWatch do
			if not present[instance] then
				connection:Disconnect()
				nameWatch[instance] = nil
			end
		end
		return list
	end)

	-- selection
	local function selectedList(): { Instance }
		local ordered: { Instance } = {}
		local set = peek(selected) :: { [Instance]: boolean }
		for _, row in peek(rows) :: { Row } do
			if set[row.instance] then
				table.insert(ordered, row.instance)
			end
		end
		return ordered
	end
	local function setSelected(set: { [Instance]: boolean })
		if sameSet(set, peek(selected)) then
			return
		end
		selected:set(set)
		if props.OnSelect then
			props.OnSelect(selectedList())
		end
	end
	Bind.link(scope, props.Selected, selected, {
		toInternal = function(list: { Instance })
			local set = {}
			for _, instance in list do
				set[instance] = true
			end
			return set
		end,
		toProp = function(set: { [Instance]: boolean })
			local list = {}
			for _, row in peek(rows) :: { Row } do
				if set[row.instance] then
					table.insert(list, row.instance)
				end
			end
			return list
		end,
		equals = function(a: any, b: any): boolean
			-- Compare as sets whichever form each is in.
			local function asSet(value: any): { [Instance]: boolean }
				local set = {}
				if typeof(value) == "table" then
					for key, item in value do
						if typeof(key) == "Instance" then
							set[key] = true
						elseif typeof(item) == "Instance" then
							set[item] = true
						end
					end
				end
				return set
			end
			return sameSet(asSet(a), asSet(b))
		end,
	})

	local function indexOfRow(instance: Instance): number?
		for index, row in peek(rows) :: { Row } do
			if row.instance == instance then
				return index
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function revealRow(index: number)
		local top = (index - 1) * rowHeight
		if top < scrolled then
			scrollOffset:set(top)
		elseif top + rowHeight > scrolled + viewHeight then
			scrollOffset:set(top + rowHeight - viewHeight)
		end
	end

	local function toggle(instance: Instance)
		local copy = table.clone(peek(expanded)) :: { [Instance]: boolean? }
		copy[instance] = if copy[instance] then nil else true
		expanded:set(copy)
	end

	local function press(row: Row)
		local ctrl = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
			or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftMeta)
		local shift = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
		local set = table.clone(peek(selected)) :: { [Instance]: boolean? }
		if shift and anchor then
			local a, b = indexOfRow(anchor), indexOfRow(row.instance)
			if a and b then
				set = if ctrl then set else {}
				for index = math.min(a, b), math.max(a, b) do
					set[(peek(rows) :: { Row })[index].instance] = true
				end
			end
		elseif ctrl then
			set[row.instance] = if set[row.instance] then nil else true
			anchor = row.instance
		else
			set = { [row.instance] = true }
			anchor = row.instance
		end
		setSelected(set :: { [Instance]: boolean })
	end

	-- Open the branches above an instance and scroll to it, when `Reveal` is set to one.
	if props.Reveal ~= nil and Bind.isState(props.Reveal) then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			scope:Observer(props.Reveal :: any):onChange(function()
				local target = peek(props.Reveal :: any) :: Instance?
				if target == nil then
					return
				end
				local open = table.clone(peek(expanded)) :: { [Instance]: boolean? }
				local above: Instance? = target.Parent
				while above do
					open[above] = true
					above = above.Parent
				end
				expanded:set(open :: { [Instance]: boolean })
				task.defer(function()
					local at = indexOfRow(target)
					if at then
						revealRow(at)
					end
				end)
			end)
		)
	end

	-- renaming
	local function finishRename(instance: Instance, text: string, apply: boolean)
		renaming:set(nil)
		if apply and text ~= "" and text ~= instance.Name then
			if props.OnRename then
				props.OnRename(instance, text)
			else
				pcall(function()
					instance.Name = text
				end)
			end
			bump()
		end
	end

	-- dragging to reparent
	local rowButtons: { [number]: GuiObject } = {}
	local dropTarget = scope:Value(nil :: Instance?)
	local function rowUnder(point: Vector3): Row?
		local list = peek(rows) :: { Row }
		for index, button in rowButtons do
			local at, size = button.AbsolutePosition, button.AbsoluteSize
			if
				button.Parent
				and point.X >= at.X
				and point.X <= at.X + size.X
				and point.Y >= at.Y
				and point.Y <= at.Y + size.Y
			then
				return list[index]
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function reparent(instance: Instance, parent: Instance)
		if instance == parent or parent:IsDescendantOf(instance) or instance.Parent == parent then
			return
		end
		if props.OnReparent then
			props.OnReparent(instance, parent)
		else
			pcall(function()
				instance.Parent = parent
			end)
		end
		local copy = table.clone(peek(expanded)) :: { [Instance]: boolean? }
		copy[parent] = true
		expanded:set(copy)
		bump()
	end

	-- a row
	local function renderRow(sc: any, index: number): Instance
		local row = sc:Computed(function(use)
			return (use(rows) :: { Row })[index]
		end)
		local ix = Interaction.bind(sc, theme, {})
		local isSelected = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local current = use(row) :: Row?
			return current ~= nil
				and (use(selected) :: { [Instance]: boolean })[current.instance] == true
		end)
		local isTarget = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local current = use(row) :: Row?
			return current ~= nil and (use(dropTarget) :: Instance?) == current.instance
		end)

		local arrow = sc:New("TextButton")({
			Name = "Arrow",
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, rowHeight),
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
				local current = peek(row) :: Row?
				if current then
					toggle(current.instance)
				end
			end,
			[Children] = sc:Apply(Icon(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = "chevron-right",
				IconSize = 14,
				Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
			}))({
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
					local current = use(row) :: Row?
					return current ~= nil and current.expandable == true
				end),
				Rotation = sc:Computed(function(use)
					local current = use(row) :: Row?
					return if current and current.open then 90 else 0
				end),
			}),
		}) :: TextButton

		local label = sc:New("TextLabel")({
			Name = "Label",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			LayoutOrder = 3,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			FontFace = theme.Fonts.Body,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(isSelected)
					then use(theme.Colors.OnPrimaryContainer)
					else use(theme.Colors.OnSurface)
			end),
			Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
				local current = use(row) :: Row?
				return not (current ~= nil and (use(renaming) :: Instance?) == current.instance)
			end),
			Text = sc:Computed(function(use)
				local current = use(row) :: Row?
				return if current then current.instance.Name else ""
			end),
			[Children] = sc:New("UIFlexItem")({ FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill }),
		}) :: TextLabel

		local editor = sc:New("TextBox")({
			Name = "Rename",
			BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -4),
			LayoutOrder = 3,
			ClearTextOnFocus = false,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			FontFace = theme.Fonts.Body,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
			Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
				local current = use(row) :: Row?
				return current ~= nil and (use(renaming) :: Instance?) == current.instance
			end),
			[Children] = {
				sc:New("UIFlexItem")({ FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill }),
				sc:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) }),
				sc:New("UIStroke")({ Color = theme.Colors.Primary, Thickness = 1 }),
			},
		}) :: TextBox
		table.insert(
			sc,
			sc:Observer(renaming):onChange(function()
				local current = peek(row) :: Row?
				if current and peek(renaming) == current.instance then
					editor.Text = current.instance.Name
					editor:CaptureFocus()
					editor.CursorPosition = #editor.Text + 1
					editor.SelectionStart = 1
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			sc,
			editor.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter: boolean)
				local current = peek(row) :: Row?
				if current and peek(renaming) == current.instance then
					finishRename(current.instance, editor.Text, enter)
				end
			end)
		)

		local iconName = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local current = use(row) :: Row?
			return if current then iconFor(current.instance) else "box"
		end)
		-- Icons are looked up by name, so a changing row swaps them through a computed child.
		local iconHost = sc:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Icon",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, rowHeight),
			LayoutOrder = 2,
			[Children] = sc:Computed(function(use, inner: any)
				return inner:Apply(Icon(inner, {
					Theme = theme,
					Name = use(iconName),
					IconSize = 16,
					Color = use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant),
				}))({
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				})
			end),
		}) :: Frame

		local button = sc:New("TextButton")({
			Name = `Row{index}`,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = sc:Computed(function(use)
				if use(isTarget) then
					return Interaction.lerpColor(
						use(theme.Colors.Surface),
						use(theme.Colors.Primary),
						0.25,
						use
					)
				end
				local base = if use(isSelected)
					then use(theme.Colors.PrimaryContainer)
					else use(theme.Colors.Surface)
				return Interaction.lerpColor(base, use(theme.Colors.OnSurface), ix.alpha(use), use)
			end),
			BackgroundTransparency = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(isSelected) or use(isTarget)
					then 0
					else 1 - math.clamp(ix.alpha(use) * 6, 0, 1)
			end),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
			[Children] = {
				sc:New("UIListLayout")({
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				}),
				sc:New("UIPadding")({
					PaddingLeft = sc:Computed(function(use)
						local current = use(row) :: Row?
						return UDim.new(0, 4 + (if current then current.depth * indent else 0))
					end),
					PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6),
				}),
				arrow,
				iconHost,
				label,
				editor,
			} :: any,
		}) :: TextButton
		ix.wire(button)
		-- Tell the caller which instance the pointer is over.
		if props.OnHover then
			table.insert(
				sc,
				button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					local current = peek(row) :: Row?
					if current and props.OnHover then
						props.OnHover(current.instance)
					end
				end)
			)
			table.insert(
				sc,
				button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					if props.OnHover then
						props.OnHover(nil)
					end
				end)
			)
		end
		rowButtons[index] = button
		table.insert(sc, function()
			if rowButtons[index] == button then
				rowButtons[index] = nil
			end
		end)

		-- Press selects. A second quick press activates. Moving past the threshold drags.
		local lastPress = 0
		table.insert(
			sc,
			button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
					return
				end
				local current = peek(row) :: Row?
				if not current then
					return
				end
				local now = os.clock()
				if now - lastPress < DOUBLE_CLICK then
					lastPress = 0
					if props.OnActivate then
						props.OnActivate(current.instance)
					end
					return
				end
				lastPress = now
				press(current)
				if props.AllowReparent ~= true then
					return
				end
				local start = input.Position
				local dragging = false
				ScrollInput.capture(button, function(changed: InputObject)
					return changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				end, function(ended: InputObject)
					return ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				end, function(position: Vector3)
					if not dragging and (position - start).Magnitude > DRAG_THRESHOLD then
						dragging = true
					end
					if dragging then
						local under = rowUnder(position)
						dropTarget:set(
							if under and under.instance ~= current.instance
								then under.instance
								else nil
						)
					end
				end, function()
					local target = peek(dropTarget)
					dropTarget:set(nil)
					if dragging and target then
						reparent(current.instance, target)
					end
				end)
			end)
		)
		return button
	end

	-- the list and its keyboard
	local list = VirtualList(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		ItemCount = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return #(use(rows) :: { Row })
		end),
		ItemHeight = rowHeight,
		ScrollOffset = scrollOffset,
		OnScroll = function(y: number)
			scrolled = y
		end,
		RenderItem = renderRow,
	}) :: GuiObject
	table.insert(
		scope,
		list:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			viewHeight = list.AbsoluteSize.Y
		end)
	)

	local root = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Explorer",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Selectable = true,
		[Children] = list,
	}) :: Frame
	Focus.manage(root, theme)

	-- Arrow keys move the selection, Left and Right close and open, Enter activates, F2 renames.
	Focus.onKey(root, function(input: InputObject): boolean
		local items = peek(rows) :: { Row }
		local current = (selectedList())[1]
		local at = if current then indexOfRow(current) else nil
		local code = input.KeyCode
		local function choose(index: number)
			index = math.clamp(index, 1, #items)
			local row = items[index]
			if row then
				anchor = row.instance
				setSelected({ [row.instance] = true })
				revealRow(index)
			end
		end
		if code == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			choose((at or 0) + 1)
		elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			choose((at or 2) - 1)
		elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Right and at then
			local row = items[at]
			if row.expandable and not row.open then
				toggle(row.instance)
			else
				choose(at + 1)
			end
		elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Left and at then
			local row = items[at]
			if row.open then
				toggle(row.instance)
			elseif row.instance.Parent then
				local parentAt = indexOfRow(row.instance.Parent :: Instance)
				if parentAt then
					choose(parentAt)
				end
			end
		elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.Return and current and props.OnActivate then
			props.OnActivate(current)
		elseif code == Enum.KeyCode.F2 and current and props.AllowRename ~= false then
			renaming:set(current)
		else
			return false
		end
		return true
	end)

	return root
end

--!strict
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme

local Children = Fusion.Children

export type FormProps = {
	Theme: Types.ThemeRef?,
	LayoutOrder: Types.UsedAs<number>?,
	Size: Types.UsedAs<UDim2>?,
	Visible: Types.UsedAs<boolean>?,
	ZIndex: Types.UsedAs<number>?,
	Layer: Instance?,
	Children: any?,
	Title: Types.UsedAs<string>?,
	[string]: any,
}

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: FormProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "Form",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = theme.Metrics.SpaceMd,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = {
			if props.Title
				then scope:TextLabel({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = theme.Fonts.Heading,
					TextSize = 16,
					TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,

local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local Color = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Color)
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local P = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.props)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent

local function normalizeVariant(
	variant: string?,
	colorProp: Types.ColorInput?
): (string, Types.ColorInput?)
	local v = variant or "Text"
	-- Legacy variants that encoded color
	if v == "Primary" then
		return "Filled", colorProp or "primary"
	end
	if v == "Destructive" then
		return "Filled", colorProp or "error"
	end
	if v == "Tonal" or v == "Outlined" or v == "Text" or v == "Filled" then
		return v, colorProp
	end

	return "Text", colorProp
end

local function styleFromRole(
	style: string,
	role: Types.ThemeColorRole,
	theme: Types.Theme
): (Color3, Color3, number, boolean, Color3)
	if style == "Tonal" then
		return role.Container, role.OnContainer, 0, false, role.OnContainer
	end
	if style == "Outlined" then
		return theme.Colors.Surface, role.Base, 0, true, role.Base
	end
	if style == "Filled" then
		return role.Base, role.OnBase, 0, false, role.OnBase
	end

	-- Text
	return theme.Colors.OnSurface, theme.Colors.OnSurface, 1, false, theme.Colors.OnSurface
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.IconButtonProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local style, colorInput =
		normalizeVariant(props.Variant, peek(props.Color) :: Types.ColorInput?)
	local role = Color.resolve(colorInput, theme, "primary")
	local bg, fg, transparency, _outlined, stateColor = styleFromRole(style, role, theme)
	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true
	local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
		Disabled = disabled,
		StateColor = stateColor,
	})

	-- MD3 disabled: on-surface @ 12% container, label @ 38%
	local disabledBg = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return Interaction.lerpColor(
			use(theme.Colors.Surface),
			use(theme.Colors.OnSurface),
			0.12,
			use
		)
	end)
	local disabledFg = theme.Colors.OnSurface

	local button = scope:TextButton(P({
		Name = "IconButton",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Active = not disabled,
		BackgroundColor3 = if disabled
			then disabledBg
			else (if transparency >= 1 then stateColor else ix.fill(bg)),
		BackgroundTransparency = if disabled
			then 0
			else (if transparency >= 1 then ix.fillTransparency(1) else transparency),
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
		[OnEvent("Activated")] = if disabled then nil else props.OnClick,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = props.Name,
				Image = props.Image,
				IconSize = 20,
				Color = if disabled then disabledFg else fg,
				Transparency = if disabled then 0.62 else 0,
			}))({
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			}),

	return button

--!strict
--[[
	Loader: a family of indeterminate loading indicators behind one `Kind`.

	  Beachball  macOS-style spinning rainbow pinwheel
	  Dots       three bouncing dots (typing / "thinking")
	  Bars       equalizer bars
	  Ripple     rings expanding from a centre dot
	  Orbit      dots chasing each other round a circle
	  Gnome      thin ring with a small dot (and fading trail) circling it
	  Icon       any Lucide icon with a motion preset (Spin, Pulse, Bounce, Flip, Wiggle)

	For the shape-morphing Material indicator use LoadingIndicator / Spinner.
	All kinds are square (`SizePx`, default 32) so they drop into the same layouts.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Arc = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Arc)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local Features = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Features)
local Flags = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Flags)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local TAU = math.pi * 2

local BEACHBALL_COLORS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 59, 48), -- red
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 149, 0), -- orange
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0), -- yellow
	Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89), -- green
	Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 250), -- cyan
	Color3.fromRGB(0, 122, 255), -- blue
	Color3.fromRGB(175, 82, 222), -- purple
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 85), -- pink
}

local function fract(x: number): number
	return x - math.floor(x)
end

local function circleDot(scope: Types.Scope, name: string, color: Color3, size: number): Frame
	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = name,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		[Children] = { scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) },
	}) :: Frame
end

local function onCircle(radius: number, angle: number): UDim2
	return UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + radius * math.sin(angle), 0.5 - radius * math.cos(angle))
end

-- Each builder returns (children, update(t)); `update` writes properties directly,
-- which is cheaper than a computed per property for a handful of frames.
type Built = { children: { any }, update: ((t: number) -> ())? }

local function dots(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, color: Color3): Built
	local items: { Frame } = {}
	local d = px * 0.2
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local f = circleDot(scope, `Dot{i}`, color, d)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (i - 2) * 0.3, 0.5)
		items[i] = f
	end
	return {
		children = items,
		update = function(t)
			for i, f in items do
				local wave = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(TAU * fract(t / 0.9 - (i - 1) * 0.16))
				local size = d * (0.8 + 0.3 * wave)
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
				f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 + (i - 2) * 0.3, 0, 0.5, -wave * px * 0.2)
				f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 * (1 - wave)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local function bars(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, color: Color3): Built
	local items: { Frame } = {}
	local speeds = { 1.1, 1.7, 1.3, 1.9, 1.5 }
	local offsets = { 0, 1.2, 2.1, 0.6, 1.8 }
	for i = 1, 5 do
		items[i] = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = `Bar{i}`,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (i - 3) * 0.17, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(px * 0.1, 2), 0.3, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			[Children] = { scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) },
		}) :: Frame
	end
	return {
		children = items,
		update = function(t)
			for i, f in items do
				local wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(TAU * speeds[i] * t * 0.6 + offsets[i] * 2)
				f.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(px * 0.1, 2), 0.25 + 0.7 * wave, 0)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local function ripple(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, color: Color3): Built
	local rings: { Frame } = {}
	local strokes: { UIStroke } = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local stroke = scope:New("UIStroke")({
			Color = color,
			Thickness = math.max(px * 0.06, 1.5),
			Transparency = 1,
		}) :: UIStroke
		strokes[i] = stroke
		rings[i] = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = `Ring{i}`,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.15),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			[Children] = { scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }), stroke },
		}) :: Frame
	end
	local center = circleDot(scope, "Center", color, px * 0.14)
	local kids: { any } = { center }
	for _, r in rings do
		table.insert(kids, r)
	end
	return {
		children = kids,
		update = function(t)
			for i, ring in rings do
				local u = fract(t / 1.6 + (i - 1) / 2)
				local eased = 1 - (1 - u) ^ 2
				local s = 0.15 + 0.8 * eased
				ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(s, s)
				strokes[i].Transparency = u ^ 0.8
			end
		end,
	}
end

local function orbit(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, color: Color3): Built
	local items: { Frame } = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		items[i] = circleDot(scope, `Dot{i}`, color, px * 0.2 * (1 - 0.2 * (i - 1)))
	end
	return {
		children = items,
		update = function(t)
			local u = fract(t / 1.3)
			-- Ease so the leader surges and the others catch up each lap.
			local lead = u + 0.14 * math.sin(TAU * u)
			for i, f in items do
				f.Position = onCircle(0.36, TAU * lead - (i - 1) * 0.5)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local function gnome(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, color: Color3): Built
	local thickness = math.max(px * 0.07, 1.5)
	local ring = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Track",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.86, 0, 0.86, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			scope:New("UIStroke")({ Color = color, Thickness = thickness, Transparency = 0.8 }),
		},
	}) :: Frame
	local trail: { Frame } = {}
	local kids: { any } = { ring }
	for i = 1, 6 do
		local f = circleDot(scope, `Dot{i}`, color, px * (0.2 - 0.022 * (i - 1)))
		trail[i] = f
		table.insert(kids, f)
	end
	return {
		children = kids,
		update = function(t)
			local lead = TAU * fract(t / 1.0)
			for i, f in trail do
				f.Position = onCircle(0.46, lead - (i - 1) * 0.22)
				f.BackgroundTransparency = (i - 1) / 7
			end
		end,
	}
end

local function iconLoader(
	scope: Types.Scope,
	px: number,
	color: Color3,
	props: Types.LoaderProps
): Built
	local icon = Icon(scope, {
		Theme = props.Theme,
		Name = props.Icon or "loader",
		IconSize = px,
		Color = color,
	}) :: ImageLabel
	icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	icon.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	local motion = props.Motion or "Spin"
	return {
		children = { icon },
		update = function(t)
			if motion == "Spin" then
				icon.Rotation = (t * 360 / 1.0) % 360
			elseif motion == "Pulse" then
				local wave = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(TAU * t / 1.2)
				icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px * (0.8 + 0.2 * wave), px * (0.8 + 0.2 * wave))
				icon.ImageTransparency = 0.55 * (1 - wave)
			elseif motion == "Bounce" then
				local u = fract(t / 0.8)
				icon.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -math.sin(u * math.pi) * px * 0.25)
			elseif motion == "Flip" then
				-- Half-turn with a hold, like an hourglass flipping over.
				local u = fract(t / 1.6)
				local turn = math.clamp((u - 0.1) / 0.5, 0, 1)
				local eased = turn * turn * (3 - 2 * turn)
				icon.Rotation = (math.floor(t / 1.6) * 180 + eased * 180) % 360
			else -- Wiggle
				local u = fract(t / 1.4)
				local envelope = math.max(0, 1 - u * 1.6)
				icon.Rotation = 18 * envelope * math.sin(TAU * 3 * u)
			end
		end,
	}
end

--- Conical gradient: the whole ball is one disc whose Rotation spins the 8 wedges.
local function conicalBeachball(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, clock: any): Built
	local keys: { ColorSequenceKeypoint } = {}
	local count = #BEACHBALL_COLORS
	local eps = 1e-4
	for i, c in BEACHBALL_COLORS do
		local a, b = (i - 1) / count, i / count
		table.insert(keys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(if i == 1 then 0 else a + eps, c))
		table.insert(keys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(if i == count then 1 else b, c))
	end
	local disc = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Ball",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			scope:New("UIGradient")({
				Type = "Conical",
				Color = ColorSequence.new(keys),
				Rotation = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return Flags.ConicalRotation
						+ (if Flags.ConicalClockwise then 1 else -1)
							* (((use(clock) :: number) * 360 / 1.1) % 360)
				end),
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame
	return { children = { disc }, update = nil }
end

local function beachball(scope: Types.Scope, px: number, clock: any): Built
	if Features.gradientTypes() then
		return conicalBeachball(scope, px, clock)
	end
	-- Wedge i spans [theta + 45i, theta + 45(i+1)). Painting "fill from angle to 12
	-- o'clock" discs in ascending order, each over the last, leaves exactly those
	-- wedges. theta splits into a whole-wedge colour shift and a 0..45° offset, so
	-- paint order stays fixed while the ball spins.
	local degrees = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return ((use(clock) :: number) * 360 / 1.1) % 360
	end)
	local offset = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return (use(degrees) :: number) % 45
	end)
	local shift = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return math.floor((use(degrees) :: number) / 45) % 8
	end)
	local radius = px / 2 - 1

	local function disc(name: string, color: any, angle: any, z: number)
		return Arc(scope, {
			Name = name,
			Mode = "Tail" :: "Tail",
			Diameter = px,
			Thickness = radius,
			Color = color,
			Angle = angle,
			ZIndex = z,
		})
	end

	local layers: { any } = {
		disc(
			"Base",
			scope:Computed(function(use)
				return BEACHBALL_COLORS[(-1 - (use(shift) :: number)) % 8 + 1]
			end),
			0,
			1
		),
	}
	for j = 0, 7 do
		table.insert(
			layers,
			disc(
				`Wedge{j}`,
				scope:Computed(function(use)
					return BEACHBALL_COLORS[(j - (use(shift) :: number)) % 8 + 1]
				end),
				scope:Computed(function(use)
					return (use(offset) :: number) + 45 * j
				end),
				j + 2
			)
		)
	end
	return { children = layers, update = nil }
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.LoaderProps): Frame
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local px = props.SizePx or 32
	local kind = props.Kind or "Dots"
	local color = props.Color or theme.Colors.Primary

	local clock = scope:Value(0)
	local built: Built
	if kind == "Beachball" then
		built = beachball(scope, px, clock)
	elseif kind == "Bars" then
		built = bars(scope, px, color)
	elseif kind == "Ripple" then
		built = ripple(scope, px, color)
	elseif kind == "Orbit" then
		built = orbit(scope, px, color)
	elseif kind == "Gnome" then
		built = gnome(scope, px, color)
	elseif kind == "Icon" then
		built = iconLoader(scope, px, color, props)
	else
		built = dots(scope, px, color)
	end

	local update = built.update
	table.insert(
		scope,
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
			local t = peek(clock) + dt
			clock:set(t)
			if update then
				update(t)
			end
		end)
	)
	if update then
		update(0)
	end

	local content: any = built.children
	if kind == "Beachball" then
		-- Arc layers are fixed-pixel squares; centre them in the (possibly larger) box.
		content = {
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Center",
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				[Children] = built.children,
			}),
		}
	end

	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = `Loader{kind}`,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(px, px),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		[Children] = content,
	}) :: Frame
end

local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)

local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local CanvasFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.CanvasFade)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local MenuNav = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.MenuNav)
local ScrollArea = require(script.Parent.ScrollArea)
local MenuSection = require(script.Parent.MenuSection)
local Button = require(script.Parent.Button)
local Divider = require(script.Parent.Divider)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

local PAGE_ID = "PantheonMenuPageId"
local PAGE_TITLE = "PantheonMenuPageTitle"

local function resolveSections(props: Types.MenuProps): { Types.MenuSectionProps }
	if props.Sections ~= nil and #props.Sections > 0 then
		return props.Sections
	end
	return { { Items = props.Items or {} } }
end

local function collectInstances(value: any, out: { Instance })
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" then
		table.insert(out, value)
	elseif typeof(value) == "table" then
		for _, child in value do
			collectInstances(child, out)
		end
	end
end

local function copyStack(stack: { string }): { string }
	local nextStack = table.create(#stack)
	for i, id in stack do
		nextStack[i] = id
	end
	return nextStack
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.MenuProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local open = if props.Open == nil then true else props.Open
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			local o = open
			local isOpen = if typeof(o) == "table" then use(o) else o
			return if isOpen then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local hasHeader = props.Header ~= nil
	local fill = props.Fill == true
	local maxHeight = props.MaxHeight
	local pad = props.Padding or 4
	local compact = not hasHeader
	local radius = props.CornerRadius or theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel

	local composed: { Instance } = {}
	collectInstances(props.Children, composed)

	local pageInsts: { Instance } = {}
	local restKids: { any } = {}
	for _, inst in composed do
		local id = inst:GetAttribute(PAGE_ID)
		if typeof(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then
			table.insert(pageInsts, inst)
		else
			table.insert(restKids, inst)
		end
	end

	local listKids: { any } = {}
	local hasData = (props.Sections ~= nil and #props.Sections > 0)
		or (props.Items ~= nil and #(props.Items :: { Types.MenuItemProps }) > 0)

	if hasData then
		for sectionIndex, section in resolveSections(props) do
			table.insert(
				listKids,
				MenuSection(scope, {
					Theme = theme,
					Title = section.Title,
					Icon = section.Icon,
					Items = section.Items,
					Children = section.Children,
					Collapsible = section.Collapsible == true,
					DefaultExpanded = section.DefaultExpanded,
					Expanded = section.Expanded,
					OnExpandedChanged = section.OnExpandedChanged,
					Compact = if section.Compact ~= nil then section.Compact else compact,
					OnClose = props.OnClose,
					LayoutOrder = sectionIndex,
				})
			)
		end
	end

	for _, inst in restKids do
		table.insert(listKids, inst)
	end

	if fill then
		table.insert(
			listKids,
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "CornerClearance",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(radius - pad, 8)),
				LayoutOrder = 10_000,
			})
		)
	end

	local function makeScroll(kids: any, order: number, stretch: boolean): Instance
		local useScroll = stretch or fill or (maxHeight ~= nil and maxHeight > 0) or #pageInsts > 0
		if not useScroll then
			return scope:Frame({
				Name = "MenuList",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				LayoutOrder = order,
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					Padding = 1,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				},
				[Children] = kids,
			})
		end
		local body = ScrollArea(scope, {
			Theme = theme,
			Size = if stretch or fill
				then UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
				else UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, maxHeight :: number),
			LayoutOrder = order,
			ContentLayout = "List" :: "List",
			ContentPadding = 0,
			ListPadding = 6,
			ScrollBarThickness = 4,
			ScrollBarPadding = 4,
			ScrollBarRailBackground = false,
			ScrollButtons = false,
			AutoHideScrollBar = true,
			Children = kids,
		})
		body.Name = "MenuScroll"
		if stretch or fill then
			local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
			flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
			flex.Parent = body
		end
		return body
	end

	local listBody: Instance
	if #pageInsts > 0 then
		local pageById: { [string]: Instance } = {}
		local pageOrder: { string } = {}
		for _, inst in pageInsts do
			local id = inst:GetAttribute(PAGE_ID) :: string
			pageById[id] = inst
			table.insert(pageOrder, id)
		end

		if #listKids > 0 then
			local rootId = props.InitialPage or pageOrder[1] or "root"
			if not pageById[rootId] then
				local implicit = scope:Frame({
					Name = "MenuPage",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
					Layout = {
						Kind = "List",
						Padding = 1,
						SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					},
					[Children] = listKids,
				})
				implicit:SetAttribute(PAGE_ID, rootId)
				pageById[rootId] = implicit
				table.insert(pageOrder, 1, rootId)
			else
				-- Data/rest content lives on the root page: parent into it.
				for _, kid in listKids do
					if typeof(kid) == "Instance" then
						kid.Parent = pageById[rootId]
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local initial = props.InitialPage or pageOrder[1]
		local stack = scope:Value({ initial } :: { string })
		local depth = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return #use(stack)
		end)
		local depthS = scope:Spring(depth, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
		local lastIndex: { [string]: number } = {}
		lastIndex[initial] = 1

		local function remember(s: { string })
			for n, id in s do
				lastIndex[id] = n
			end
		end

		local function currentId(): string?
			local s = peek(stack)
			return s[#s]
		end

		local function emitPage()
			if props.OnPageChanged then
				local id = currentId()
				if id then
					props.OnPageChanged(id)
				end
			end
		end

		local function push(id: string)
			if not pageById[id] then
				return
			end
			local s = copyStack(peek(stack))
			if s[#s] == id then
				return
			end
			table.insert(s, id)
			remember(s)
			stack:set(s)
			emitPage()
		end

		local function pop()
			local s = copyStack(peek(stack))
			if #s <= 1 then
				return
			end
			table.remove(s)
			remember(s)
			stack:set(s)
			emitPage()
		end

		if props.Page ~= nil then
			table.insert(
				scope,
				scope
					:Observer(scope:Computed(function(use)
						local p = props.Page
						return if typeof(p) == "table" then use(p) else p
					end))
					:onBind(function()
						local want = peek(props.Page)
						if typeof(want) ~= "string" or want == "" then
							return
						end
						local s = peek(stack)
						for i = #s, 1, -1 do
							if s[i] == want then
								if i == #s then
									return
								end
								local nextStack = table.create(i)
								for j = 1, i do
									nextStack[j] = s[j]
								end
								stack:set(nextStack)
								remember(nextStack)
								emitPage()
								return
							end
						end
						push(want)
					end)
			)
		end

		local slides: { any } = {}
		for _, pageId in pageOrder do
			local pageInst = pageById[pageId]
			local titleAttr = pageInst:GetAttribute(PAGE_TITLE)
			local hasTitle = typeof(titleAttr) == "string" and titleAttr ~= ""

			local backBar = nil
			if hasTitle then
				backBar = scope:Frame({
					Name = "BackBar",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
					LayoutOrder = 1,
					Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
						return #use(stack) > 1
					end),
					Layout = {
						Kind = "List",
						Padding = theme.Metrics.Space2xs,
						SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					},
					Padding = { 0, 0, theme.Metrics.Space2xs, 0 },
					[Children] = {
						scope:Apply(Button(scope, {
							Theme = theme,
							Variant = "Text" :: "Text",
							Text = titleAttr :: string,
							LeadingIcon = "chevron-left",
							OnClick = pop,
							CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel - 4,
							Padding = { 0, theme.Metrics.SpaceSm },
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
							HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
						}))({
							LayoutOrder = 1,
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
						}),
						-- Bleed past Menu chrome padding so the rule hits the panel edge.
						scope:Frame({
							Name = "BackBarDivider",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
							LayoutOrder = 2,
							ClipsDescendants = false,
							[Children] = {
								scope:Apply(Divider(scope, {
									Theme = theme,
								}))({
									Size = UDim2.new(1, pad * 2, 0, 1),
									Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-pad, 0),
								}),
							},
						}),
					},
				})
			end

			local scrollKids: { any } = { pageInst }
			if fill then
				table.insert(
					scrollKids,
					scope:Frame({
						Name = "CornerClearance",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(radius - pad, 8)),
						LayoutOrder = 10_000,
					})
				)
			end

			local function slotOf(s: { string }): number
				for n, id in s do
					if id == pageId then
						return n
					end
				end
				return lastIndex[pageId] or (#s + 1)
			end

			table.insert(
				slides,
				scope:Frame({
					Name = "PageSlide_" .. pageId,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
						local s = use(stack) :: { string }
						local t = use(depthS) :: number
						return UDim2.fromScale(slotOf(s) - t, 0)
					end),
					Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
						local s = use(stack) :: { string }
						for _, id in s do
							if id == pageId then
								return true
							end
						end
						return false
					end),
					ClipsDescendants = true,
					Layout = {
						Kind = "List",
						Padding = 0,
						SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					},
					[Children] = { backBar, makeScroll(scrollKids, 2, true) },
				})
			)
		end

		local hostHeight = if fill
			then UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
			else UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, maxHeight or 280)
		listBody = scope:Frame({
			Name = "PageHost",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = hostHeight,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			LayoutOrder = 10,
			[Children] = slides,
		})
		if fill then
			local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
			flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
			flex.Parent = listBody
		end

		-- Bind after instance exists; menu is created below so we bind on listBody's parent later.
		(scope :: any)._pantheonMenuNav = { push = push, pop = pop, page = currentId }
	else
		listBody = makeScroll(listKids, 10, false)
	end

	local kids: { any } = {}
	if props.Header then
		local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
		flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.None
		flex.Parent = props.Header
		table.insert(kids, props.Header)
	end
	table.insert(kids, listBody)

	local menu = scope:TextButton({
		Name = "Menu",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		Shadow = {
			BlurRadius = 8,
			Transparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - (use(openS) :: number) * 0.1
			end),
		},
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(220, 0),
		AutomaticSize = if fill then Enum.AutomaticSize.None else Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Visible = CanvasFade.shown(scope, openS, nil, { Theme = theme }),
		BackgroundTransparency = CanvasFade.surfaceTransparency(scope, openS, { Theme = theme }),
		Active = true,
		ClipsDescendants = fill or #pageInsts > 0,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 80,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		-- `Corners` lets docked panels round only some corners ({tl, tr, bl, br}).
		CornerRadius = props.Corners or radius,
		Outline = {
			Color = if hasHeader then theme.Colors.OutlineVariant else theme.Colors.Outline,
			Thickness = 1,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		Padding = pad,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = if hasHeader then theme.Metrics.SpaceSm else 1,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			VerticalFlex = if fill then Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill else nil,
		},
		[Children] = kids,
	}) :: TextButton

	local nav = (scope :: any)._pantheonMenuNav
	if nav then
		MenuNav.bind(menu, nav);
		(scope :: any)._pantheonMenuNav = nil
	end

	local host = CanvasFade.host(scope, menu, openS, { Theme = theme })
	if props.Embedded ~= true then
		Layer.mount(scope, props, host)
	end
	return host
end

--!strict
--[[
	A named page inside Menu. Sibling pages slide on push/pop.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.MenuPageProps): Instance
	local page = scope:Frame({
		Name = "MenuPage",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = 1,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = props.Children,
	}) :: Frame
	page:SetAttribute("PantheonMenuPageId", props.Id)
	local function writeTitle()
		local title = if props.Title == nil then nil else peek(props.Title)
		if typeof(title) == "string" then
			page:SetAttribute("PantheonMenuPageTitle", title)
		else
			page:SetAttribute("PantheonMenuPageTitle", nil)
		end
	end
	writeTitle()
	if typeof(props.Title) == "table" then
		table.insert(scope, scope:Observer(props.Title):onChange(writeTitle))
	end
	return page
end

--!strict
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Corners = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Corners)

local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.OverlayProps?): Instance
	local p: Types.OverlayProps = props or {}
	local theme = resolveTheme(p)
	-- Full-screen TextButton scrim. Panels above must also be GuiButtons
	-- (or otherwise sink input); Frame.Active alone does not block Activated.
	local scrim = scope:TextButton({
		Name = "Overlay",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Scrim,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = p.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		ZIndex = p.ZIndex or 50,
		Visible = p.Visible,
		Active = true,
		CornerRadius = p.CornerRadius or 0,
		[OnEvent("Activated")] = p.OnClick,
	}) :: TextButton

	-- Inside a Window the scrim covers the window, so it takes on the window's rounding
	-- (unless a radius was given explicitly).
	if p.CornerRadius == nil then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			Corners.followWindow(scrim, function(radius: number)
				Corners.apply(scrim, radius, radius, radius, radius)
			end)
		)
	end

	return scrim
end

--!strict
--[[
	Anchored popover: Overlay + positioned Menu (Embedded).
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Follow = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Follow)
local Overlay = require(script.Parent.Overlay)
local Menu = require(script.Parent.Menu)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.PopoverProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local openRef = props.Open
	local open = scope:Computed(function(use)
		if openRef == nil then
			return true
		end
		return (if typeof(openRef) == "table" then use(openRef) else openRef) == true
	end)
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local width = props.Width or 240
	local placement = props.Placement or "Bottom"
	local pos = scope:Value(UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0))

	local menu = Menu(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Embedded = true,
		Open = open,
		OnClose = props.OnClose,
		Items = props.Items,
		Sections = props.Sections,
		MaxHeight = props.MaxHeight,
		Children = props.Children,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 0),
		Padding = 6,
		ZIndex = (props.ZIndex or 90) + 1,
	})

	scope:Apply(menu)({
		Name = "PopoverPanel",
		Position = pos,
	})

	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = menu
	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(openS):onBind(function()
			local t = peek(openS)
			scale.Scale = 0.92 + 0.08 * t
		end)
	)

	local function updatePosition()
		local target = Layer.asGui(props.Target)
		local layer = Layer.resolve(props)
		if target == nil or layer == nil then
			return
		end
		local gap = 8
		local tp = target.AbsolutePosition
		local ts = target.AbsoluteSize
		local lp = layer.AbsolutePosition
		local x = tp.X - lp.X
		local y = tp.Y - lp.Y
		if placement == "Bottom" then
			x = x + ts.X * 0.5 - width * 0.5
			y = y + ts.Y + gap
		elseif placement == "Top" then
			x = x + ts.X * 0.5 - width * 0.5
			y = y - gap - 8
		elseif placement == "Right" then
			x = x + ts.X + gap
			y = y
		else
			x = x - width - gap
			y = y
		end
		pos:set(UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(8, x), math.max(8, y)))
	end

	Follow(scope, open, function(v)
		return v == true
	end, updatePosition)

	local root = scope:Frame({
		Name = "Popover",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return use(openS) > 0.02
		end),
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 90,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Apply(Overlay(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				OnClick = props.OnClose,
				ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 90,
			}))({
				BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					-- Light dismiss scrim
					return 1 - (use(openS) :: number) * 0.25
				end),
			}),
			menu,
		},
	}) :: Frame

	Layer.mount(scope, props, root)
	Focus.trap(scope, root, open)
	Focus.escape(scope, open, Focus.closer(props))
	return root
end

--!strict
--[[
	Linear / circular progress.
	Indeterminate linear: ping-pong bounce with mid-travel stretch.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Arc = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Arc)
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local LoadingIndicator = require(script.Parent.LoadingIndicator)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function clamp01(x: number): number
	return math.clamp(x, 0, 1)
end

local function smooth(t: number): number
	t = clamp01(t)
	return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10)
end

--[[
	macOS-style bounce, timed from a frame-by-frame measurement of the real thing.
	One pass (left→right, then right→left) takes HALF seconds and moves like a snake:
	the head sprints across first, the tail starts a beat later and catches up
	(both ease out), then the pill rests collapsed at the end before turning back.
	Returns (left, right, rightward) as fractions of the track.
]]
local HALF = 0.77
local HEAD_DUR = 0.66
local TAIL_DELAY = 0.144
local TAIL_DUR = 0.516 -- tail lands exactly as the head does, so the pill collapses on arrival
local FADE = 0.25 -- trailing fade length, as a fraction of the track
local DEFAULT_BAR_HEIGHT = 4

-- Head: fast start with a strong ease-out.
local function easeHead(u: number): number
	return 1 - (1 - clamp01(u)) ^ 3
end

-- Tail: lags behind, then eases in-out. Together the pill stretches and then snaps shut.
local function easeTail(u: number): number
	u = clamp01(u)
	if u < 0.5 then
		return 4 * u * u * u
	end
	return 1 - (-2 * u + 2) ^ 3 / 2
end

--- (a, b) are the pill's edges in 0..1 "travel space"; a == b means collapsed. The pill is
--- always at least one bar-height wide (a circle), so travel space is the track minus that.
local function bounceGeometry(phase: number): (number, number, boolean)
	local cycle = phase * 2 -- 0..2
	local rightward = cycle % 2 < 1
	local tau = (cycle % 1) * HALF
	local head = easeHead(tau / HEAD_DUR)
	local tail = easeTail((tau - TAIL_DELAY) / TAIL_DUR)
	if rightward then
		return tail, head, true
	end
	return 1 - head, 1 - tail, false
end

--- Trailing fade, in the pill's own 0..1 space; short pills stay solid so the
--- direction change at each end is seamless.
local function bounceFade(left: number, right: number, rightward: boolean): NumberSequence
	local w = math.max(right - left, 0) + 0.03
	local strength = 0.92 * clamp01((w - 0.03) / 0.2)
	local fade = math.clamp(FADE / w, 0.05, 0.999)
	if rightward then
		return NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, strength),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(fade, 0),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
	end
	return NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1 - fade, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, strength),
	})
end

--[[
	Indeterminate arc spinner. The head runs ahead for the first half of each cycle,
	then the tail catches up, so the arc grows ~10° → ~280° and shrinks back while the
	ring spins. Returns (from, to) in degrees.
]]
local CYCLE = 1.333
local SPIN = 360 / 1.568
local MIN_SWEEP = 10
local STEP = 270

local function indeterminateArc(t: number): (number, number)
	local k = math.floor(t / CYCLE)
	local u = t / CYCLE - k
	local head = smooth(math.min(1, u / 0.5))
	local tail = smooth(math.max(0, (u - 0.5) / 0.5))
	local spin = t * SPIN
	return k * STEP + STEP * tail + spin, k * STEP + STEP * head + MIN_SWEEP + spin
end

--[[
	A radial cut only exists for fills from 12 o'clock, so a free arc [a, b] is drawn as:
	  no wrap (b <= 360): fill to b, then erase [0, a] in the background colour;
	  wrap    (b >  360): fill to b - 360 plus fill from a to 360 (nothing to erase).
	The erase layer needs `props.Background` to match whatever is behind the spinner.
]]
local function arcSpinner(
	scope: Types.Scope,
	props: Types.ProgressProps,
	theme: Types.Theme
): Instance
	local diameter = props.SizePx or 40
	local thickness = props.Thickness or 3
	-- Erase colour: explicit, else follows the nearest opaque ancestor (see below).
	-- A plain Color3: it is compared and copied, so a theme state is read once here.
	local background = scope:Value(props.Background or peek(theme.Colors.Surface))

	local clock = scope:Value(0)
	table.insert(
		scope,
		RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
			clock:set(peek(clock) + dt)
		end)
	)
	if Arc.supportsFreeArc() then
		-- Conical gradient available: one exact arc with round caps, nothing to erase.
		local fromAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return (indeterminateArc(use(clock)))
		end)
		local toAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local _, head = indeterminateArc(use(clock))
			return head
		end)
		return scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "ProgressCircular",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
			LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
			[Children] = {
				scope:New("Frame")({
					Name = "Center",
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					[Children] = {
						Arc(scope, {
							Name = "Arc",
							Diameter = diameter,
							Thickness = thickness,
							Color = theme.Colors.Primary,
							From = fromAngle,
							To = toAngle,
							Caps = true,
						}),
					},
				}),
			},
		}) :: Frame
	end

	-- (a, b) with a wrapped into 0..360 and b = a + sweep.
	local span = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local from, to = indeterminateArc(use(clock))
		local a = from % 360
		return { a = a, b = a + (to - from) }
	end)
	local fillAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local sp = use(span)
		return if sp.b <= 360 then sp.b else sp.b - 360
	end)
	local eraseAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local sp = use(span)
		return if sp.b <= 360 then sp.a else 0
	end)
	local wrapAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local sp = use(span)
		return if sp.b <= 360 then 360 else sp.a
	end)

	local function layer(name: string, mode: "Head" | "Tail", color: any, angle: any, z: number)
		return Arc(scope, {
			Name = name,
			Mode = mode,
			Diameter = diameter,
			Thickness = thickness,
			Color = color,
			Angle = angle,
			ZIndex = z,
		})
	end

	local root = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "ProgressCircular",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Center",
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				[Children] = {
					layer("Fill", "Head", theme.Colors.Primary, fillAngle, 1),
					layer("Erase", "Head", background, eraseAngle, 2),
					layer("Wrap", "Tail", theme.Colors.Primary, wrapAngle, 3),
				},
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame

	if props.Background == nil then
		local watching: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
		local function follow()
			if watching then
				watching:Disconnect()
				watching = nil
			end
			local inst = root.Parent
			while inst do
				if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and inst.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5 then
					local source = inst
					background:set(source.BackgroundColor3)
					watching = source
						:GetPropertyChangedSignal("BackgroundColor3")
						:Connect(function()
							background:set(source.BackgroundColor3)
						end)
					return
				end
				inst = inst.Parent
			end
		end
		table.insert(scope, root.AncestryChanged:Connect(follow))
		table.insert(scope, function()
			if watching then
				watching:Disconnect()
			end
		end)
		task.defer(follow)
	end
	return root
end

local function circular(
	scope: Types.Scope,
	props: Types.ProgressProps,
	theme: Types.Theme,
	mode: Types.ProgressMode
): Instance
	if mode == "Indeterminate" or mode == "Buffering" then
		if props.Indicator == "Arc" then
			return arcSpinner(scope, props, theme)
		end
		-- Default: the shape-morphing loading indicator.
		return LoadingIndicator(scope, {
			Theme = props.Theme,
			SizePx = props.SizePx,
			Size = props.Size,
			LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder,
			Visible = props.Visible,
			ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		})
	end

	local style: Types.ProgressStyle = props.Style or "Standard"
	local classic = style == "Classic"
	local diameter = props.SizePx or 40
	local thickness = props.Thickness or if classic then 3 else 4
	local midR = (diameter - thickness) / 2
	-- Visual gap (degrees) between the active arc and its track so round caps don't touch.
	local gap = if classic then 0 else math.deg((thickness * 1.6) / math.max(midR, 1))

	local target = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local v = props.Value
		if v == nil then
			return 0
		end
		return math.clamp((if typeof(v) == "table" then use(v) else v) :: number, 0, 1)
	end)
	local value = scope:Spring(target, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 0.5, 1)

	local headAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local v = use(value) :: number
		if v <= 0.001 then
			return 0
		end
		return if v >= 0.999 then 360 else math.max(v * 360 - gap * 0.5, 0)
	end)
	local tailAngle = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local v = use(value) :: number
		return if v >= 0.999 then 360 else v * 360 + gap * 0.5
	end)

	local trackColor = Interaction.trackColor(theme)
	local kids: { any } = {
		Arc(scope, {
			Name = "Track",
			Mode = "Tail" :: "Tail",
			Diameter = diameter,
			Thickness = thickness,
			Color = trackColor,
			Angle = tailAngle,
			Caps = not classic,
		}),
		Arc(scope, {
			Name = "Indicator",
			Mode = "Head" :: "Head",
			Diameter = diameter,
			Thickness = thickness,
			Color = theme.Colors.Primary,
			Angle = headAngle,
			Caps = not classic,
			ZIndex = 2,
		}),
	}

	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "ProgressCircular",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Center",
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				[Children] = kids,
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.ProgressProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local variant: Types.ProgressVariant = props.Variant or "Linear"
	local mode: Types.ProgressMode = props.Mode
		or (if props.Value == nil then "Indeterminate" else "Determinate")
	local phase = scope:Value(0)

	if variant ~= "Circular" and (mode == "Indeterminate" or mode == "Buffering") then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
				-- ~1.4s per full bounce round-trip
				phase:set((peek(phase) + dt / (2 * HALF)) % 1)
			end)
		)
	end

	if variant == "Circular" then
		return circular(scope, props, theme, mode)
	end

	local kids: { any } = {
		scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
	}

	if mode == "Buffering" or mode == "Determinate" then
		local bufferW = scope:Computed(function(use)
			if mode ~= "Buffering" then
				return 0
			end
			local b = props.Buffer
			if b == nil then
				return 0.7
			end
			return math.clamp((if typeof(b) == "table" then use(b) else b) :: number, 0, 1)
		end)
		table.insert(
			kids,
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Buffer",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.PrimaryContainer,
				Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return UDim2.new(use(bufferW), 0, 1, 0)
				end),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				[Children] = {
					scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				},
			})
		)
	end

	local barHeight = DEFAULT_BAR_HEIGHT
	if typeof(props.Size) == "UDim2" and (props.Size :: UDim2).Y.Offset > 0 then
		barHeight = (props.Size :: UDim2).Y.Offset
	end

	if mode == "Indeterminate" then
		table.insert(
			kids,
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Indeterminate",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Primary,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local a = bounceGeometry(use(phase))
					return UDim2.new(a, -a * barHeight, 0, 0)
				end),
				Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local a, b = bounceGeometry(use(phase))
					local len = b - a
					-- Width = len of the (track - bar height) travel space + bar height,
					-- so a collapsed pill is exactly a circle as wide as the bar is tall.
					return UDim2.new(len, barHeight * (1 - len), 1, 0)
				end),
				[Children] = {
					scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
					-- Solid head, long trailing fade (as macOS does).
					scope:New("UIGradient")({
						Transparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return bounceFade(bounceGeometry(use(phase)))
						end),
					}),
				},
			})
		)
	else
		local fill = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local v = props.Value
			if v == nil then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp((if typeof(v) == "table" then use(v) else v) :: number, 0, 1)
		end)
		table.insert(
			kids,
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Fill",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Primary,
				Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return UDim2.new(use(fill), 0, 1, 0)
				end),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				[Children] = {
					scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				},
			})
		)
	end

	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "ProgressLinear",
		BackgroundColor3 = Interaction.trackColor(theme),
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DEFAULT_BAR_HEIGHT),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		[Children] = kids,
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
--[[
	Material alert / confirm prompt — full-screen modal Dialog.
]]
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local Dialog = require(script.Parent.Dialog)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.PromptProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local actions = props.Actions
		or {
			{
				Text = props.CancelText or "Cancel",

	if iconColor == nil and props.Icon and props.Destructive then
