end

--!strict
--[[
	A ring of choices around the pointer. Point at one and release (or click) to pick it.
	See docs/Components/Overlays/RadialMenu.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Persist = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Persist)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DEAD_ZONE = 0.32 -- fraction of the radius around the centre where nothing is chosen
local STICK_THRESHOLD = 0.5

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.RadialMenuProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local items = props.Items
	local count = #items
	local radius = props.Radius or 96
	local itemSize = props.ItemSize or 52
	local persistKey = Persist.key("RadialMenu", props.Id, true)
	local open = Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "open", peek(props.Open) == true)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Open, open)

	local hovered = scope:Value(0) -- index of the choice the pointer is over, or 0
	local origin = scope:Value(Vector2.zero) -- centre of the ring, in the space of the layer
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.2,
		0.65
	)

	local layer = scope:New("TextButton")({
		Name = "RadialMenu",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Scrim,
		BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return 1 - 0.35 * math.clamp(use(openS) :: number, 0, 1)
		end),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 80,
		Active = true,
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return (use(openS) :: number) > 0.01
		end),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
	}) :: TextButton
	local mounted = Layer.mount(scope, props, layer)

	local function choose(index: number)
		local item = items[index]
		if item == nil or peek(item.Disabled) == true then
			return
		end
		open:set(false)
		if item.OnSelect then
			item.OnSelect()
		end
		if props.OnSelect then
			props.OnSelect(item.Id)
		end
	end

	-- the ring
	local ring = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Ring",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return 1 - 0.85 * math.clamp(use(openS) :: number, 0, 1)
		end),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local at = use(origin) :: Vector2
			return UDim2.fromOffset(at.X, at.Y)
		end),
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local reach = (radius + itemSize / 2 + 10) * 2 * math.max(use(openS) :: number, 0)
			return UDim2.fromOffset(reach, reach)
		end),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = layer,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			scope:New("UIStroke")({
				Color = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
				Thickness = 1,
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame

	-- The name of the choice under the pointer, in the middle.
	scope:New("TextLabel")({
		Name = "Center",
		Parent = layer,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = ring.Position,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * DEAD_ZONE * 2, 40),
		FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
		TextTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return 1 - math.clamp(use(openS) :: number, 0, 1)
		end),
		Text = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local item = items[use(hovered) :: number]
			return if item then (item.Text or item.Id) else (props.Title or "")
		end),
	})

	local buttons: { GuiObject } = {}
	for index, item in items do
		local angle = math.rad((index - 1) * 360 / count - 90)
		local disabled = peek(item.Disabled) == true
		local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, { Disabled = disabled })
		local isHovered = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return use(hovered) == index
		end)
		-- Each choice springs out from the middle, a little later than the one before it.
		local reach = scope:Spring(
			scope:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(open) then 1 else 0
			end),
			theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * (1.1 - 0.04 * index),
			0.62
		)
		local lift = scope:Spring(
			scope:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(isHovered) and not disabled then 1 else 0
			end),
			theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.4,
			0.7
		)
		local button = scope:New("TextButton")({
			Name = item.Id,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Active = not disabled,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local at = use(origin) :: Vector2
				local r = radius * (use(reach) :: number)
				return UDim2.fromOffset(at.X + math.cos(angle) * r, at.Y + math.sin(angle) * r)
			end),
			Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local size = itemSize
					* (0.55 + 0.45 * math.clamp(use(reach) :: number, 0, 1.15))
					* (1 + 0.14 * (use(lift) :: number))
				return UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
			end),
			BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local base = use(theme.Colors.SurfaceContainerHigh)
				return Interaction.lerpColor(
					base,
					use(theme.Colors.Primary),
					math.clamp(use(lift) :: number, 0, 1),
					use
				)
			end),
			BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - math.clamp(use(reach) :: number, 0, 1) * (if disabled then 0.5 else 1)
			end),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 2,
			Parent = layer,
			[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
				choose(index)
			end,
			[OnEvent("MouseEnter")] = function()
				hovered:set(index)
			end,
			[Children] = {
				scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				if item.Icon
					then scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
						Theme = theme,
						Name = item.Icon,
						IconSize = 22,
						Color = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return Interaction.lerpColor(
								use(theme.Colors.OnSurface),
								use(theme.Colors.OnPrimary),
								math.clamp(use(lift) :: number, 0, 1),
								use
							)
						end),
					}))({
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					})
					else scope:New("TextLabel")({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
						TextSize = 13,
						TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
						Text = item.Text or item.Id,
					}),
			} :: any,
		}) :: TextButton
		ix.wire(button)
		buttons[index] = button
	end

	-- choosing by direction
	--- Which choice lies in the direction of `offset` from the centre: 0 for none.
	local function choiceAt(offset: Vector2): number
		if offset.Magnitude < radius * DEAD_ZONE then
			return 0
		end
		-- 0 at 12 o'clock, clockwise.
		local angle = math.atan2(offset.X, -offset.Y)
		if angle < 0 then
			angle += 2 * math.pi
		end
		local step = 2 * math.pi / count
		return (math.floor((angle + step / 2) / step) % count) + 1
	end

	local following: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local function stopFollowing()
		if following then
			following:Disconnect()
			following = nil
		end
	end
	local function startFollowing()
		stopFollowing()
		following = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			-- A thumbstick, when one is pushed, wins over the pointer.
			local stick = Vector2.zero
			for _, input in UserInputService:GetGamepadState(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1) do
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
					stick = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, -input.Position.Y)
				end
			end
			if stick.Magnitude > STICK_THRESHOLD then
				hovered:set(choiceAt(stick.Unit * radius))
				return
			end
			if UserInputService.MouseEnabled or UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
				local parent = layer.Parent
				local base = if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject")
					then (parent :: GuiObject).AbsolutePosition
					else Vector2.zero
				local pointer = ScrollInput.mouseLocation() - base
				hovered:set(choiceAt(pointer - peek(origin)))
			end
		end)
	end

	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(open):onChange(function()
			if peek(open) then
				-- Open where the pointer is, kept far enough from the edges to show the whole ring.
				local parent = layer.Parent
				local box = if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject")
					then (parent :: GuiObject).AbsoluteSize
					else Vector2.new(800, 600)
				local base = if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject")
					then (parent :: GuiObject).AbsolutePosition
					else Vector2.zero
				local at = props.Origin or (ScrollInput.mouseLocation() - base)
				local margin = radius + itemSize / 2 + 12
				origin:set(
					Vector2.new(
						math.clamp(at.X, margin, math.max(box.X - margin, margin)),
						math.clamp(at.Y, margin, math.max(box.Y - margin, margin))
					)
				)
				hovered:set(0)
				startFollowing()
			else
				stopFollowing()
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(scope, stopFollowing)

	-- A press outside the choices closes the ring, or picks the one under the pointer when it
	-- was opened by a held key.
	table.insert(
		scope,
		layer.Activated:Connect(function()
			if props.Hotkey == nil then
				open:set(false)
				if props.OnClose then
					props.OnClose()
				end
			end
		end)
	)

	if props.Hotkey then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
				if not processed and input.KeyCode == props.Hotkey and not peek(open) then
					open:set(true)
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			scope,
			UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
				if input.KeyCode == props.Hotkey and peek(open) then
					local index = peek(hovered) :: number
					if index > 0 then
						choose(index)
					else
						open:set(false)
						if props.OnClose then
							props.OnClose()
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	-- Gamepad: A picks the highlighted choice.
	table.insert(
		scope,
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if peek(open) and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
				local index = peek(hovered) :: number
				if index > 0 then
					choose(index)
				end
			end
		end)
	)
	Focus.escape(scope, open, function()
		open:set(false)
		if props.OnClose then
			props.OnClose()
		end
	end)

	if not mounted then
		warn(
			"[Pantheon.RadialMenu] no overlay Layer found; pass `Layer` or call inside Layer.Provide"
		)
	end
	return layer
end

--!strict
--[[
	Radio button (single option).

	Animation: when becoming selected, the dot expands to the outer ring size,
	then settles to regular size while fading in.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local P = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.props)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.RadioProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true

	local checked = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return use(props.Checked) == true
	end)

	-- Ring reacts immediately; dot uses a 2-stage sequence.
	local checkedN = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return if use(checked) then 1 else 0
	end)

	local selectedRingS =
		scope:Spring(checkedN, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
		Disabled = disabled,
		StateColor = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
	})

	local dotBurstV = scope:Value(0)
	local dotBurstS =
		scope:Spring(dotBurstV, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.3, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)

	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(checked):onChange(function(isOn)
			if isOn then
				-- Temporary "full-size" burst to outer ring, then settle.
				dotBurstV:set(1)
				task.delay(0.075, function()
					if peek(checked) then
						dotBurstV:set(0)
					end
				end)
			else
				dotBurstV:set(0)
			end
		end)
	)

	local outer = scope:Frame({
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
		BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local base = use(theme.Colors.Surface)
			return Interaction.lerpColor(base, use(theme.Colors.OnSurface), ix.alpha(use), use)
		end),
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Outline = {
			Color = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return Interaction.lerpColor(
					use(theme.Colors.Outline),
					use(theme.Colors.Primary),
					use(selectedRingS),
					use
				)
			end),
			Thickness = 2,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		[Children] = {
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Dot",
				Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
					-- Base: 10px when selected. Burst adds up to +10px (total 20px).
					local base = use(selectedRingS) :: number
					local burst = (use(dotBurstS) :: number) * base
					local s = 10 * math.clamp(base + burst, 0, 2)
					return UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
				end),
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Primary,
				BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return 1 - use(selectedRingS)
				end),
				CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
			}),
		},
	})

	local row = scope:TextButton(P({
		Name = "Radio",
		Text = "",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
		BackgroundTransparency = ix.fillTransparency(1),
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Active = not disabled,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusSm,
		Padding = { theme.Metrics.Space2xs, theme.Metrics.SpaceXs },
		[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
			if disabled then
				return
			end
			if props.OnActivated then
				props.OnActivated()
			end
		end,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			Padding = theme.Metrics.SpaceSm,
		},
		[Children] = {
			outer,
			scope:TextLabel({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
				TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
				Text = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return use(props.Label) or ""
				end),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
				LayoutOrder = 2,
			}),
		},
	}))

	ix.wire(row)
	return row
end

--!strict
--[[
	Custom scroll surface with chrome (vertical or horizontal).

	Vertical:                 Horizontal:
		^    
		|                    < ====[]==== >
		|
	   | |
	   | |
		|
		|
		V
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local whileActive = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Follow)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local Spinner = require(script.Parent.Spinner)
local P = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.props)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.ScrollAreaProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local horizontal = props.Orientation == "Horizontal"
	local smooth = props.Smooth ~= false
	local inertia = props.Inertia ~= false
	local keyboard = props.Keyboard ~= false
	local autoCanvas = props.AutoCanvas ~= false
	local railClick = props.ScrollBarRail ~= false
	local showRail = if props.ScrollBarRailBackground == nil
		then true
		else props.ScrollBarRailBackground
	local autoHide = props.AutoHideScrollBar ~= false
	local hideDelay = props.AutoHideDelay or 0.85
	local showButtons = props.ScrollButtons == true
	local buttonStep = props.ScrollButtonStep or 64
	local thumbThickness = props.ScrollBarThickness or 8
	local railThickness = props.ScrollBarRailThickness or 2
	local padX = props.ScrollBarPadding or 6
	local buttonSize = if showButtons then 20 else 0
	local chromeInner = math.max(thumbThickness, railThickness, if showButtons then 16 else 0)
	local chromeCross = chromeInner + padX * 2
	local contentLayout = props.ContentLayout or "List"
	local contentPad = if props.ContentPadding ~= nil
		then props.ContentPadding
		else theme.Metrics.SpaceMd
	local listPad = if props.ListPadding ~= nil then props.ListPadding else theme.Metrics.SpaceLg
	local useListLayout = contentLayout ~= "None"
	-- Extra inset so UIStroke near full-bleed children isn't sheared by root clip.
	local padInset = if useListLayout then contentPad + 2 else contentPad

	local idleColor = props.ScrollBarColor or theme.Colors.Outline
	local railIdleColor = props.ScrollBarRailColor or theme.Colors.OutlineVariant
	local activeColor = props.ScrollBarActiveColor or theme.Colors.Primary

	local contentSize = scope:Value(Vector2.new(0, 0))
	local viewSize = scope:Value(Vector2.new(0, 200))
	-- False until the content has been measured once. Before that maxScroll() is 0, so an
	-- initial ScrollOffset (e.g. restored after a rebuild) would look like an overscroll and
	-- the edge-settling loop would snap it back to 0.
	local measured = scope:Value(false)
	local offset = scope:Value(peek(props.ScrollOffset) or 0)
	local velocity = scope:Value(0)
	local target = scope:Value(peek(props.ScrollOffset) or 0)
	local scrollSpring = scope:Spring(
		target,
		if smooth then theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1 else theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 2,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local barVisible = scope:Value(1)
	local barVisibleS =
		scope:Spring(barVisible, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 0.05, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local hoveringBar = scope:Value(0)
	local hoveringBarS =
		scope:Spring(hoveringBar, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local draggingBar = scope:Value(0)
	local draggingBarS =
		scope:Spring(draggingBar, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.2, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local railPressed = scope:Value(0)
	local railPressedS =
		scope:Spring(railPressed, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.4, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local stretch = scope:Value(0)
	local stretchS =
		scope:Spring(stretch, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 0.06, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local lastActivity = scope:Value(os.clock())

	local function axisOf(v: Vector2): number
		return if horizontal then v.X else v.Y
	end

	local function maxScroll(): number
		return math.max(0, axisOf(peek(contentSize)) - axisOf(peek(viewSize)))
	end

	local function bumpActivity()
		lastActivity:set(os.clock())
		if maxScroll() > 0.5 then
			barVisible:set(1)
		else
			barVisible:set(0)
		end
	end

	local needsScroll = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return axisOf(use(contentSize)) - axisOf(use(viewSize)) > 0.5
	end)
	local chromeHeld = scope:Value(false)
	local chromeGutter = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return if use(chromeHeld) then chromeCross else 0
	end)

	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(needsScroll):onBind(function()
			if not peek(needsScroll) then
				barVisible:set(0)
				target:set(0)
				offset:set(0)
				velocity:set(0)
			end
		end)
	)

	local overscrollEnabled = if props.Overscroll ~= nil
		then props.Overscroll
		else (inertia or props.OnRefresh ~= nil)
	-- Drag-to-scroll: touch by default; also mouse when pull-action is enabled (desktop).
	local touchDevice = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
	local dragToScroll = if props.DragToScroll == nil
		then (touchDevice or props.OnRefresh ~= nil)
		else props.DragToScroll == true
	local refreshThreshold = props.RefreshThreshold or 72
	local showPullIndicator = if props.PullIndicator ~= nil
		then props.PullIndicator
		else props.OnRefresh ~= nil
	local pullHint = props.PullHint or "Keep scrolling to continue"
	local releaseHint = props.ReleaseHint or "Release to continue"
	local refreshingHint = props.RefreshingHint or "Refreshing…"
	local contentDragging = scope:Value(false)
	local pullDepth = scope:Value(0) -- positive px pulled past top while interacting
	-- While `Refreshing` is true the content rests at the threshold with a spinner (iOS / Android
	-- style) instead of springing straight back.
	local holding = false
	local settlingBack = false -- easing home after a hold; must not re-arm the refresh
	local holdingState = scope:Value(false)
	local function refreshingNow(): boolean
		return props.Refreshing ~= nil and peek(props.Refreshing) == true
	end
	local didPull = false

	-- Wheel / trackpad pull-to-refresh: scrolling up from the very top pulls the content down
	-- (rubber-band); releasing past the threshold refreshes, like a touch drag.
	local wheelGestureAtTop = false -- the current wheel burst began at the very top
	local lastWheelAt = 0
	local wheelPullTravel = 0 -- scroll-up px accumulated at the top this gesture
	local wheelPeak = 0 -- largest delta this gesture, to spot momentum tails
	local wheelRefreshTravel = 32 -- scroll-up travel that reaches the refresh threshold
	local wheelPulling = false
	local wheelReleaseToken = 0
	-- Assigned once settleIfNeeded exists (it is defined after scrollBy).
	local releaseWheelPull: (() -> ())? = nil

	local function emitScroll(y: number)
		if not props.OnScroll then
			return
		end
		local last = (scope :: any)._pantheonLastScroll
		if typeof(last) == "number" and math.abs(y - last) < 0.5 then
			return
		end
		(scope :: any)._pantheonLastScroll = y
		props.OnScroll(y)
	end

	local function resist(y: number): number
		local max = maxScroll()
		-- Top: exponential rubber-band that eases toward a limit (never a hard stop).
		if y < 0 then
			local limit = refreshThreshold * 3
			return -limit * (1 - math.exp(y / limit))
		end
		local shownLimit = math.max(refreshThreshold * 1.15, 88)
		if y > max then
			return math.min(max + (y - max) * 0.28, max + shownLimit)
		end
		return y
	end

	local function clampScroll(y: number): number
		return math.clamp(y, 0, maxScroll())
	end

	local overscrollLimit = math.max(refreshThreshold * 2.5, 180)
	local function clampOverscrollTarget(y: number): number
		local max = maxScroll()
		return math.clamp(y, -overscrollLimit, max + overscrollLimit)
	end

	-- Top-edge pull only (for OnRefresh). Bottom stays hard-clamped on wheel.
	local function clampTopPullTarget(y: number): number
		local max = maxScroll()
		return math.clamp(y, -overscrollLimit, max)
	end

	local function scrollBy(delta: number, raw: boolean?)
		-- No overflow: don't scroll or show chrome (pull-to-refresh may still drag).
		if maxScroll() <= 0.5 and props.OnRefresh == nil then
			return
		end
		if maxScroll() <= 0.5 and not (raw or peek(contentDragging)) then
			return
		end
		bumpActivity()
		local current = peek(target)
		if current >= 0 then
			settlingBack = false
		end
		local max = maxScroll()
		local nextY = current + delta
		if raw or peek(contentDragging) then
			-- Touch / mouse drag: allow capped overscroll for pull-to-refresh.
			if overscrollEnabled then
				nextY = clampOverscrollTarget(nextY)
			else
				nextY = clampScroll(nextY)
			end
			target:set(nextY)
			if not smooth then
				offset:set(if overscrollEnabled then resist(nextY) else nextY)
				emitScroll(peek(offset))
			end
		else
			-- Wheel / trackpad: hard-clamp mid-list + bottom; allow top pull when OnRefresh.
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastWheelAt > 0.15 then
				-- A new burst of wheel events: only a burst that *starts* at the top may pull.
				-- (Momentum from a fast scroll up the page must not trigger a refresh.)
				wheelGestureAtTop = current <= 0.5
				wheelPullTravel = 0
				wheelPeak = 0
			end
			lastWheelAt = now

			local canPull = overscrollEnabled
				and not horizontal
				and props.OnRefresh ~= nil
				and not holding
				and not settlingBack
			local topPull = canPull and (wheelGestureAtTop and current <= 0.5 and delta < 0)

			if topPull then
				wheelPulling = true
				contentDragging:set(true)
				velocity:set(0)

				-- Deltas fading well below their peak are the OS momentum tail (fingers already
				-- lifted): stop deepening the pull and let it release.
				local magnitude = math.abs(delta)
				wheelPeak = math.max(wheelPeak, magnitude)
				local tail = magnitude < wheelPeak * 0.45
				if not tail then
					-- Pull follows the scroll-up travel; wheelRefreshTravel of it reaches the
					-- refresh threshold.
					wheelPullTravel = math.max(wheelPullTravel - delta, 0)
					nextY = clampTopPullTarget(
						-wheelPullTravel * (refreshThreshold / wheelRefreshTravel)
					)
					target:set(nextY)
					if nextY < -10 then
						didPull = true
					end
					if not smooth then
						offset:set(if nextY < 0 then resist(nextY) else nextY)
						emitScroll(peek(offset))
					end
					-- Scrolled back down to the top: the pull is over.
					if nextY >= 0 then
						wheelPulling = false
						contentDragging:set(false)
						didPull = false
						return
					end
				end

				-- Like lifting a finger: release (refresh if past the threshold) once the wheel
				-- goes quiet, sooner when it is only momentum.
				wheelReleaseToken += 1
				local mine = wheelReleaseToken
				task.delay(if tail then 0.06 else 0.14, function()
					if mine == wheelReleaseToken and wheelPulling and releaseWheelPull then
						releaseWheelPull()
					end
				end)
				return
			else
				nextY = clampScroll(nextY)
				target:set(nextY)
				if not smooth then
					offset:set(nextY)
					emitScroll(nextY)
				end
				if inertia then
					-- Mild acceleration for precise wheel / trackpad input, with a soft cap.
					local v = peek(velocity)
					local boost = delta * 9 * (1 / (1 + math.abs(v) / 180))
					v = v + boost
					if nextY <= 0 then
						velocity:set(math.max(0, v))
					elseif nextY >= max then
						velocity:set(math.min(0, v))
					else
						velocity:set(math.clamp(v, -280, 280))
					end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		if inertia and not peek(contentDragging) then
			velocity:set(peek(velocity) + delta * 22)
		end
	end

	local function scrollTo(y: number)
		bumpActivity()
		local nextY = clampScroll(y)
		target:set(nextY)
		velocity:set(0)
		contentDragging:set(false)
		if not smooth then
			offset:set(nextY)
			emitScroll(nextY)
		end
	end

	local function endHold()
		if not holding then
			return
		end
		holding = false
		holdingState:set(false)
		settlingBack = true
	end

	if props.Refreshing ~= nil and typeof(props.Refreshing) == "table" then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			scope:Observer(props.Refreshing :: any):onChange(function()
				if not refreshingNow() then
					endHold()
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	local function settleIfNeeded()
		local max = maxScroll()
		local y = peek(target)
		if y < 0 and holding then
			-- Released while refreshing: stay parked at the threshold.
			target:set(-refreshThreshold)
			velocity:set(0)
			return
		end
		if y < 0 then
			local armed = not horizontal and props.OnRefresh ~= nil and y <= -refreshThreshold
			if armed and not settlingBack then
				local onRefresh = props.OnRefresh
				local holdsRefresh = props.Refreshing ~= nil
				if holdsRefresh then
					holding = true
					holdingState:set(true)
				end
				if onRefresh then
					task.defer(function()
						onRefresh()
						-- Never started refreshing: don't leave the content parked.
						if holding and not refreshingNow() then
							endHold()
						end
					end)
				end
				if holdsRefresh then
					didPull = false
					target:set(-refreshThreshold)
					velocity:set(0)
					return
				end
			elseif didPull then
				local onPullCancel = props.OnPullCancel
				if onPullCancel then
					task.defer(onPullCancel)
				end
			end
			didPull = false
			pullDepth:set(0)
			target:set(0)
			velocity:set(0)
		elseif y > max then
			didPull = false
			pullDepth:set(0)
			target:set(max)
			velocity:set(0)
		else
			didPull = false
			pullDepth:set(0)
		end
	end

	-- End of a wheel / trackpad pull: same as lifting a finger after a drag.
	releaseWheelPull = function()
		wheelPulling = false
		wheelPeak = 0
		contentDragging:set(false)
		settleIfNeeded()
	end

	local function activeAmount(use: any): number
		return math.clamp(
			use(draggingBarS) + use(railPressedS) * 0.85 + use(hoveringBarS) * 0.35,
			0,
			1
		)
	end

	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(scrollSpring):onBind(function()
			local raw = peek(scrollSpring)
			local y = if overscrollEnabled and peek(contentDragging)
				then resist(raw)
				else clampScroll(raw)
			-- While free-springing past edges, show resisted position then settle
			if overscrollEnabled and not peek(contentDragging) then
				if raw < 0 or raw > maxScroll() then
					y = resist(raw)
					if math.abs(raw - clampScroll(raw)) < 0.5 then
						y = clampScroll(raw)
					end
				end
			end
			offset:set(y)
			emitScroll(y)

			if not horizontal and showPullIndicator then
				local depth = if y < 0 then -y else 0
				if peek(contentDragging) or depth > 1 then
					pullDepth:set(depth)
					if depth > 10 then
						didPull = true
					end
				elseif depth <= 1 then
					pullDepth:set(0)
				end
			end
		end)
	)

	if props.ScrollOffset ~= nil and typeof(props.ScrollOffset) == "table" then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			scope:Observer(props.ScrollOffset :: any):onChange(function()
				local y = peek(props.ScrollOffset)
				if typeof(y) == "number" and math.abs(y - peek(target)) > 0.5 then
					scrollTo(y)
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	-- Step only while something is moving, overscrolled, or the bar is waiting to hide.
	local function scrollStep(dt: number)
		if peek(contentDragging) or holding then
			return
		end
		local v = peek(velocity)
		local y = peek(target)
		local max = maxScroll()
		-- Rubber-band settle when past edges (after coasting stops).
		if overscrollEnabled and (y < 0 or y > max) and math.abs(v) < 0.35 then
			if y < 0 then
				local armed = not horizontal
					and props.OnRefresh ~= nil
					and y <= -refreshThreshold
					and not settlingBack
				if armed then
					settleIfNeeded()
				else
					if didPull and props.OnPullCancel then
						didPull = false
						task.defer(props.OnPullCancel)
					end
					didPull = false
					local nextY = y + (0 - y) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
					if math.abs(nextY) < 0.5 then
						nextY = 0
						velocity:set(0)
						pullDepth:set(0)
						settlingBack = false
					end
					target:set(nextY)
				end
			else
				local nextY = y + (max - y) * math.min(1, dt * 10)
				if math.abs(nextY - max) < 0.5 then

					velocity:set(0)

			local nextY = y + v * dt
			-- Inertia may finish a touch rubber-band, but wheel momentum hard-stops at edges
			-- (except top pull). Decelerate gently so coast stays controllable.
			local decay = math.max(0, 1 - dt * 3.2)
			if overscrollEnabled and (y < -0.5 or y > max + 0.5) then
				target:set(clampOverscrollTarget(nextY))
				velocity:set(v * decay)
			else
				local clamped = clampScroll(nextY)
				target:set(clamped)
				if clamped ~= nextY then
					velocity:set(0)
				else
					velocity:set(v * decay)
				end
			end
		else
			velocity:set(0)
			if overscrollEnabled and (y < 0 or y > max) then
				settleIfNeeded()
			end
		end

			if os.clock() - peek(lastActivity) > hideDelay then
				barVisible:set(0)
			end
		end

			if layout then
				local along = if horizontal
					then layout.AbsoluteContentSize.X
					else layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y

			local along = measureAlong()

				then Vector2.new(along, math.max(vs.Y, 1))
				else Vector2.new(math.max(vs.X, 1), along)

		-- re-entrancy cap.
		local function scheduleCanvasSync()
			if syncQueued then
				return
			end
			syncQueued = true
			task.defer(function()
				syncQueued = false
				if content.Parent then
					applyCanvasSize()
				end
			end)
		end
		local function bindChild(child: Instance)
			if not child:IsA("GuiObject") or child:IsA("UIBase") then

			end
			-- Layout already reports AbsoluteContentSize; child AbsoluteSize
			-- would recurse when the gutter reflows the row.
			if layout then
				table.insert(
					childConns,
					child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(scheduleCanvasSync)
				)
				return
			end
			table.insert(
				childConns,
				child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(scheduleCanvasSync)
			)
			table.insert(
				childConns,
				child:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(scheduleCanvasSync)
			)
		end
		local function rebindChildren()
			for _, conn in childConns do
				conn:Disconnect()
			end
			table.clear(childConns)
			for _, child in content:GetChildren() do
				bindChild(child)
			end
			scheduleCanvasSync()
		end
		if layout then
			table.insert(
				scope,
				layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(scheduleCanvasSync)
			)
		end
		table.insert(scope, content.ChildAdded:Connect(rebindChildren))
		table.insert(scope, content.ChildRemoved:Connect(rebindChildren))
		table.insert(scope, function()
			for _, conn in childConns do

			end
		end)
		task.defer(rebindChildren)
		requestCanvasSync = scheduleCanvasSync

	local function thumbMetrics(use: any): (number, number, number, number)
		local vs = use(viewSize) :: Vector2
		local cs = use(contentSize) :: Vector2
		local off = use(offset) :: number
		local trackLen = math.max(axisOf(vs) - buttonSize * 2, 1)
		local contentLen = math.max(axisOf(cs), 1)
		local max = math.max(0, contentLen - axisOf(vs))
		local ratio = math.clamp(axisOf(vs) / contentLen, 0.12, 1)
		local t = if max <= 0 then 0 else math.clamp(off / max, 0, 1)
		local baseLen = trackLen * ratio
		local drag = use(draggingBarS) :: number
		local velSx = math.min(math.abs(use(stretchS) :: number), baseLen * 0.7)
		local sx = drag * baseLen * 0.1 + velSx
		local len = math.min(baseLen + sx, trackLen)
		local travel = math.max(trackLen - baseLen, 0)
		local pos = math.clamp(t * travel - (len - baseLen) * 0.5, 0, math.max(trackLen - len, 0))
		local thin = math.max(thumbThickness - drag * 2.5, railThickness + 1)
		return pos, len, thin, trackLen
	end

		chrome.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if peek(draggingBar) < 0.5 then
				hoveringBar:set(0)
				railPressed:set(0)
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		scope,
		track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if
				input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				return
			end
			bumpActivity()
			local trackLen = if horizontal then track.AbsoluteSize.X else track.AbsoluteSize.Y
			local contentLen = math.max(axisOf(peek(contentSize)), 1)
			local view = axisOf(peek(viewSize))
			local max = math.max(0, contentLen - view)
			if max <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local thumbRatio = math.clamp(view / contentLen, 0.12, 1)
			local thumbPx = thumbRatio * trackLen
			local localPos = if horizontal
				then input.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X
				else input.Position.Y - track.AbsolutePosition.Y
			local thumbStart = (peek(offset) / max) * (trackLen - thumbPx)
			local onThumb = localPos >= thumbStart - 2 and localPos <= thumbStart + thumbPx + 2

			if onThumb then
				draggingBar:set(1)
				hoveringBar:set(1)
				local grabOffset = localPos - thumbStart
				local lastAxis = if horizontal then input.Position.X else input.Position.Y
				local lastT = os.clock()
				local travel = math.max(trackLen - thumbPx, 1)

				local stopCapture = ScrollInput.capture(root, function(changed)
					return changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						or changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end, function(endedInput)
					return endedInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or endedInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end, function(pos)
					local now = os.clock()
					local dt = math.max(now - lastT, 1 / 240)
					local cur = if horizontal then pos.X else pos.Y
					local vel = (cur - lastAxis) / dt
					lastAxis = cur
					lastT = now
					stretch:set(math.clamp(vel * 0.055, -36, 36))

					local p = cur
						- (if horizontal then track.AbsolutePosition.X else track.AbsolutePosition.Y)
						- grabOffset
					local t = math.clamp(p / travel, 0, 1)
					scrollTo(t * max)
				end, function()
					draggingBar:set(0)
					stretch:set(0)
				end)
				table.insert(scope, stopCapture)
			elseif railClick then
				railPressed:set(1)
				local t =
					math.clamp((localPos - thumbPx * 0.5) / math.max(trackLen - thumbPx, 1), 0, 1)
				scrollTo(t * max)
				task.delay(0.12, function()
					railPressed:set(0)
				end)
			end
		end)
	)

	if keyboard then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
				if processed then
					return
				end
				onKey(input)
			end)
		)
	end

	bumpActivity()
	return root
end

		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)
	local selected = Persist.value(
		scope,
		Persist.key("Select", props.Id, typeof(props.Value) == "table"),
		"value",
		(peek(props.Value) or "") :: string

	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true

		for _, opt in props.Options do

		end

	end

	local menuChildren = scope:Computed(function(use)
		if use(openS) < 0.05 then
			return {}

		local q = string.lower(tostring(use(filter)))
		local nodes = {}
		local order = 1
		for _, opt in props.Options do
			local hay = string.lower(opt.Label .. " " .. opt.Value)
			if q == "" or string.find(hay, q, 1, true) then
				local optValue = opt.Value
				local isSelected = tostring(use(selected)) == optValue
				local hover = scope:Value(0)
				local press = scope:Value(0)
				local hoverS =
					scope:Spring(hover, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
				local pressS =
					scope:Spring(press, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)

					then use(theme.Colors.PrimaryContainer)
					else use(theme.Colors.Surface)
				local item = scope:TextButton({
					Text = opt.Label,
					FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
					TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
					TextColor3 = use(theme.Colors.OnSurface),
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(u)
						local alpha = math.clamp(
							(u(hoverS) :: number) * 0.08 + (u(pressS) :: number) * 0.12,
							0,

						press:set(1)
					end,
					[OnEvent("MouseButton1Up")] = function()
						press:set(0)

			end

	local triggerIx = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
		Disabled = disabled,
		StateColor = theme.Colors.OnSurface,

	local fieldKids: { any } = {}
	if hasLabel then
		table.insert(
			fieldKids,
			scope:TextLabel({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
				TextSize = theme.Typography.Label.Size,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				Text = props.Label,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
				LayoutOrder = 1,
			})
		)
	end

	local trigger = scope:TextButton({
		Name = "Trigger",
		Text = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local v = use(selected)
			return if v ~= "" then labelFor(v) else (peek(props.Placeholder) or "Select…")
		end),
		FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
		TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
		TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		BackgroundColor3 = triggerIx.fill(theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Active = not disabled,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusSm,
		Padding = { theme.Metrics.SpaceSm, theme.Metrics.SpaceMd },
		Outline = {
			Color = theme.Colors.Outline,
			Thickness = 1,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()

	triggerIx.wire(trigger)
	table.insert(fieldKids, trigger)

	-- Popover mounts to Layer when provided (does not push layout)
	local popover = scope:Frame({
		Name = "SelectPopover",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		Visible = CanvasFade.shown(scope, openS, nil, { Theme = theme }),
		BackgroundTransparency = CanvasFade.surfaceTransparency(scope, openS, { Theme = theme }),
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusSm,
		Outline = {
			Color = theme.Colors.Outline,
			Thickness = 1,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		Padding = { theme.Metrics.Space2xs },
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = 2,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		SizeConstraint = {
			MinSize = Vector2.new(160, 0),
		},
		Shadow = {
			BlurRadius = 8,
			Transparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - (use(openS) :: number) * 0.1
			end),
		},
		ZIndex = 200,
		[Children] = {
			menuChildren,
		},
	})

	local field = scope:Frame({
		Name = "Select",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = false,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, closedHeight),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		ZIndex = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local base = props.ZIndex
			local n = if typeof(base) == "number" then base else 1
			return if use(open) then math.max(n, 200) else n
		end),
		[Children] = {
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "Field",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",

				},

		popover.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
		popover.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	end

	if not mounted then
		chrome.Parent = field

		chrome.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, closedHeight + 4)
	else
		whileActive(scope, open, function(isOpen)
			return isOpen == true
		end, function()
			local layer = Layer.resolve(props)

				return
			end

			local ts = trigger.AbsoluteSize
			local lp = layer.AbsolutePosition
			chrome.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tp.X - lp.X, tp.Y - lp.Y + ts.Y + 4)
			chrome.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(ts.X, 160), 0)
		end)
	end

	Focus.escape(scope, open, function()
		open:set(false)
	end)
	return field

--!strict
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Persist = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Persist)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

local THUMB = 16
local STRETCH_MAX = 10 -- hard limit on velocity stretch (px)
-- Keep thumb (incl. hover/press grow) inside the control bounds.
local EDGE = math.ceil(THUMB * 0.85)

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.SliderProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local minV = props.Min or 0
	local maxV = props.Max or 1
	local step = props.Step or 0.01
	local value = Persist.value(
		scope,
		Persist.key("Slider", props.Id, typeof(props.Value) == "table"),
		"value",
		peek(props.Value) or minV
	)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Value, value)
	local dragging = scope:Value(0)
	local draggingS = scope:Spring(dragging, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local stretch = scope:Value(0)
	local stretchS =
		scope:Spring(stretch, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.6, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true
	local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
		Disabled = disabled,
		StateColor = theme.Colors.OnPrimary,
	})

	local range = math.max(maxV - minV, 1e-6)
	local stepCount = math.floor(range / step + 0.5)
	local showSteps = stepCount >= 1 and stepCount <= 24

	local function fraction(use: any): number
		return math.clamp((use(value) - minV) / range, 0, 1)
	end

	local ticks = {}
	if showSteps then
		for i = 0, stepCount do
			-- A tick appears as the thumb is picked up, and the ones the thumb has passed fill with
			-- the accent colour and grow a little.
			local passed = scope:Spring(
				scope:Computed(function(use)
					return if i / stepCount <= fraction(use) + 1e-6 then 1 else 0
				end),
				theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.4,
				theme.Motion.SpringDamping
			)
			table.insert(
				ticks,
				scope:Frame({
					Name = "Tick",
					Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
						local lift = use(passed) :: number
						return UDim2.fromOffset(2 + lift * 0.6, 6 + lift * 3)
					end),
					BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
						return Interaction.lerpColor(
							use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant),
							use(theme.Colors.Primary),
							math.clamp(use(passed) :: number, 0, 1),
							use
						)
					end),
					BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
						return 1 - math.clamp(use(draggingS) :: number, 0, 1) * 0.8
					end),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					LayoutOrder = i + 1,
				})
			)
		end
	end

	local thumbSize = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local hoverN = use(ix.Hover) :: number
		local pressN = use(ix.Press) :: number
		local dragN = use(draggingS) :: number
		local grow = 1 + hoverN * 0.12 + pressN * 0.18 + dragN * 0.15
		local base = THUMB * grow
		local sx = use(stretchS) :: number
		return UDim2.fromOffset(base + sx, math.max(base - sx * 0.35, base * 0.7))
	end)

	local bar = scope:TextButton({
		Name = "Track",
		Text = "",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Active = not disabled,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Frame({
				Name = "TrackInner",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -EDGE * 2, 1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(EDGE, 0),
				[Children] = {
					scope:Frame({
						Name = "Rail",
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4),
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = Interaction.trackColor(theme),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
					}),
					scope:Frame({
						Name = "Fill",
						Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return UDim2.new(fraction(use), 0, 0, 4)
						end),
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
						BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Primary,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
					}),
					if showSteps
						then scope:Frame({
							Name = "Ticks",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8),
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
							Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 14),
							[Children] = {
								scope:New("UIListLayout")({
									FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
									HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.SpaceBetween,
									VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
									SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
								}),
								ticks,
							},
						})
						else nil,
					scope:Frame({
						Name = "Thumb",
						Size = thumbSize,
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return UDim2.new(fraction(use), 0, 0.5, 0)
						end),
						BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return Interaction.lerpColor(
								use(theme.Colors.Primary),
								use(theme.Colors.OnPrimary),
								ix.alpha(use),
								use
							)
						end),
						CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
						ZIndex = 2,
					}),
				},
			}),
		},
	}) :: TextButton
	ix.wire(bar)
	-- Arrow keys move the focused slider by one step; Home and End jump to the ends.
	Focus.onKey(bar, function(input: InputObject): boolean
		local current = peek(value) :: number
		local target: number
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Left or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			target = current - step
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Right or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			target = current + step
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Home then
			target = minV
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.End then
			target = maxV
		else
			return false
		end
		target = math.clamp(math.floor(target / step + 0.5) * step, minV, maxV)
		value:set(target)
		if props.OnChanged then
			props.OnChanged(target)
		end
		return true
	end)

	local trackInner = bar:FindFirstChild("TrackInner") :: Frame

	table.insert(
		scope,
		bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if disabled then
				return
			end
			if
				input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				return
			end
			dragging:set(1)
			local lastX = input.Position.X
			local lastT = os.clock()

			local function apply(pos: Vector3)
				local now = os.clock()
				local dt = math.max(now - lastT, 1 / 240)
				local vel = (pos.X - lastX) / dt
				lastX = pos.X
				lastT = now
				stretch:set(math.clamp(math.abs(vel) * 0.01, 0, STRETCH_MAX))

				local target = trackInner
				local rel = math.clamp(
					(pos.X - target.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(target.AbsoluteSize.X, 1),
					0,
					1
				)
				local raw = minV + rel * range
				local stepped = math.floor(raw / step + 0.5) * step
				stepped = math.clamp(stepped, minV, maxV)
				value:set(stepped)
				if props.OnChanged then
					props.OnChanged(stepped)
				end
			end
			apply(input.Position)
			local stopCapture = ScrollInput.capture(
				bar,
				function(changed)
					return changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						or changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end,
				function(endedInput)
					return endedInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or endedInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end,
				apply,
				function()
					dragging:set(0)
					stretch:set(0)
				end
			)
			table.insert(scope, stopCapture)
		end)
	)

	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "Slider",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = theme.Metrics.Space2xs,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = {
			if props.Label
				then scope:TextLabel({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
					TextSize = theme.Typography.Label.Size,
					TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					Text = scope:Computed(function(use)
						return `{peek(props.Label) or ""} ({string.format("%.2f", use(value))})`
					end),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
					LayoutOrder = 1,
				})
				else nil,
			bar,
		},
	}) :: Frame
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.SnackbarProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)

	local leading: any = nil
	if props.Leading then
		leading = scope:Apply(props.Leading)({ LayoutOrder = 1 })

		leading = scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
			Theme = theme,

		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		FontFace = theme.Fonts.Body,
		TextSize = 14,
		TextColor3 = theme.Colors.InverseOnSurface,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextWrapped = fill,

		AutomaticSize = if fill then Enum.AutomaticSize.Y else Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,

--[[
	Panes separated by draggable dividers. See docs/Components/Layout/SplitPane.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Persist = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Persist)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

local KEY_STEP = 0.02 -- fraction a divider moves per arrow key press
local DOUBLE_CLICK = 0.35 -- seconds between presses that reset the divider

local function normalised(ratios: { number }?, count: number): { number }
	local out: { number } = {}
	local sum = 0
	for index = 1, count do
		local value = if ratios and ratios[index] and ratios[index] > 0 then ratios[index] else 1
		out[index] = value
		sum += value
	end
	for index = 1, count do
		out[index] /= sum
	end
	return out
end

local function sameRatios(a: { number }, b: { number }): boolean
	if #a ~= #b then
		return false
	end
	for index, value in a do
		if math.abs(value - b[index]) > 1e-6 then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.SplitPaneProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local panes = props.Panes
	local count = #panes
	local horizontal = props.Orientation ~= "Vertical" -- panes side by side
	local dividerSize = props.DividerSize or 8
	local minPanel = props.MinSize or 80

	local initial = normalised(peek(props.Ratios), count)
	local persistKey = Persist.key("SplitPane", props.Id, typeof(props.Ratios) == "table")
	local ratios = Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "ratios", initial)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Ratios, ratios, {
		toInternal = function(value: { number })
			return normalised(value, count)
		end,
		equals = sameRatios,
	})

	local holders: { Frame } = {}
	local dividers: { TextButton } = {}
	local lines: { Frame } = {}
	local active = scope:Value(0) -- index of the divider being dragged, or 0

	local container = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "SplitPane",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
	}) :: Frame

	local function along(size: Vector2): number
		return if horizontal then size.X else size.Y
	end

	--- Place the panes and dividers for the current size and ratios.
	local function layout()
		local size = container.AbsoluteSize
		local total = math.max(along(size) - dividerSize * (count - 1), 1)
		local list = peek(ratios) :: { number }
		local cursor = 0
		for index = 1, count do
			local extent = list[index] * total
			local holder = holders[index]
			if horizontal then
				holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cursor, 0)
				holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, extent, 1, 0)
			else
				holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, cursor)
				holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, extent)
			end
			cursor += extent
			local divider = dividers[index]
			if divider then
				if horizontal then
					divider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cursor, 0)
					divider.Size = UDim2.new(0, dividerSize, 1, 0)
				else
					divider.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, cursor)
					divider.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, dividerSize)
				end
				cursor += dividerSize
			end
		end
	end

	local function setRatios(list: { number })
		if sameRatios(list, peek(ratios)) then
			return
		end
		ratios:set(list)
		layout()
		if props.OnResized then
			props.OnResized(list)
		end
	end

	--- Move divider `index` by `delta` as a fraction of the room for panes, keeping both
	--- neighbours at least `MinSize` px.
	local function nudge(index: number, from: { number }, delta: number)
		local total = math.max(along(container.AbsoluteSize) - dividerSize * (count - 1), 1)
		local floor = math.min(minPanel / total, 0.45)
		local moved = math.clamp(delta, floor - from[index], from[index + 1] - floor)
		local list = table.clone(from)
		list[index] = from[index] + moved
		list[index + 1] = from[index + 1] - moved
		setRatios(list)
	end

	for index = 1, count do
		local holder = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = `Pane{index}`,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
		}) :: Frame
		holders[index] = holder
		local pane = scope:Apply(panes[index])({ Parent = holder })
		if pane:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local gui = pane :: GuiObject
			gui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			gui.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
		end
		holder.Parent = container
	end

	for index = 1, count - 1 do
		local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {})
		local line = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Line",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = if horizontal then UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0) else UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local pulled =
					math.max(use(ix.Hover) :: number, if use(active) == index then 1 else 0)
				return Interaction.lerpColor(
					use(theme.Colors.OutlineVariant),
					use(theme.Colors.Primary),
					pulled,
					use
				)
			end),
		}) :: Frame
		lines[index] = line
		local lastPress = 0
		local divider = scope:New("TextButton")({
			Name = `Divider{index}`,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 5,
			[Children] = line,
		}) :: TextButton
		ix.wire(divider)
		divider.Parent = container
		dividers[index] = divider

		table.insert(
			scope,
			divider.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				-- A quick second press puts the panes back to their starting sizes.
				local now = os.clock()
				if now - lastPress < DOUBLE_CLICK then
					lastPress = 0
					setRatios(initial)
					return
				end
				lastPress = now
				local origin = peek(ratios) :: { number }
				local startAt = if horizontal then input.Position.X else input.Position.Y
				active:set(index)
				ScrollInput.capture(divider, function(changed: InputObject)
					return changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						or changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end, function(ended: InputObject)
					return ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end, function(position: Vector3)
					local at = if horizontal then position.X else position.Y
					local total =
						math.max(along(container.AbsoluteSize) - dividerSize * (count - 1), 1)
					nudge(index, origin, (at - startAt) / total)
				end, function()
					active:set(0)
				end)
			end)
		)

		-- Arrow keys move a focused divider.
		Focus.onKey(divider, function(input: InputObject): boolean
			local back = if horizontal then Enum.KeyCode.Left else Enum.KeyCode.Up
			local forward = if horizontal then Enum.KeyCode.Right else Enum.KeyCode.Down
			if input.KeyCode == back then
				nudge(index, peek(ratios), -KEY_STEP)
				return true
			elseif input.KeyCode == forward then
				nudge(index, peek(ratios), KEY_STEP)
				return true
			end
			return false
		end)
	end

	table.insert(scope, container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(layout))
	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(ratios):onChange(function()
			layout()
		end)
	)
	task.defer(layout)
	return container
end

local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme

local Spinner = require(script.Parent.Spinner)
local Tooltip = require(script.Parent.Tooltip)

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.StatusBarProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)

	local function toneColor(tone: string?): Color3
		if tone == "Error" then
			return theme.Colors.Error
		elseif tone == "Warning" then
			return theme.Colors.Warning
		elseif tone == "Success" then
			return theme.Colors.Success
		end
		return theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant
	end

	local function build(item: Types.StatusItem, order: number): Instance
		local color = toneColor(item.Tone)
		local kids: { any } = {
			scope:New("UIListLayout")({
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
			}),
			scope:New("UIPadding")({ PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
		}
		if item.Busy then
			table.insert(
				kids,
				scope:Apply(Spinner(scope, { Theme = theme, SizePx = 14 }))({ LayoutOrder = 1 })
			)
		elseif item.Icon then
			table.insert(
				kids,
				scope:Apply(
					Icon(scope, { Theme = theme, Name = item.Icon, IconSize = 13, Color = color })
				)({
					LayoutOrder = 1,
				})
			)
		end
		if item.Text ~= nil then
			table.insert(
				kids,
				scope:New("TextLabel")({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEIGHT),
					LayoutOrder = 2,
					FontFace = theme.Fonts.Body,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextColor3 = color,
					Text = item.Text,
				})
			)
		end
		if item.Progress ~= nil then
			local fraction = item.Progress
			table.insert(
				kids,
				scope:Frame({
					Name = "Progress",
					LayoutOrder = 3,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 4),
					BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					CornerRadius = 2,
					[Children] = scope:New("Frame")({
						BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Primary,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
							local value = if typeof(fraction) == "table"
								then use(fraction)
								else fraction
							return UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp((value :: number) or 0, 0, 1), 1)
						end),
						[Children] = scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) }),
					}),
				})
			)
		end

		local clickable = item.OnClick ~= nil
		local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, { Disabled = not clickable })
		local node = scope:New(if clickable then "TextButton" else "Frame")({
			Name = item.Id or `Item{order}`,
			BackgroundColor3 = if clickable
				then ix.fill(theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer)
				else theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer,
			BackgroundTransparency = if clickable then ix.fillTransparency(1) else 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, HEIGHT),
			LayoutOrder = order,
			[Children] = kids :: any,
		}) :: GuiObject
		if clickable then
			local button = node :: TextButton
			button.Text = ""
			button.AutoButtonColor = false
			table.insert(
				scope,
				button.Activated:Connect(function()
					(item.OnClick :: () -> ())()
				end)
			)
			ix.wire(button)
		end
		if item.Tooltip and Layer.resolve(props) then
			Tooltip(
				scope,
				{ Theme = theme, Layer = props.Layer, Target = node, Text = item.Tooltip }
			)
		end
		return node
	end

	local function side(items: { Types.StatusItem }?, anchor: number, order: number): Instance
		local kids: { any } = {
			scope:New("UIListLayout")({
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				HorizontalAlignment = if anchor == 1
					then Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
					elseif anchor == 0.5 then Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
					else Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
			}),
		}
		local list: { Types.StatusItem } = items or {}
		for index, item in list do
			table.insert(kids, build(item, index))
		end
		return scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = if anchor == 0 then "Start" elseif anchor == 1 then "End" else "Middle",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(anchor, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(anchor, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0),
			LayoutOrder = order,
			[Children] = kids,
		})
	end

	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "StatusBar",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEIGHT),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Divider",
				BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
			}),
			side(props.Start, 0, 1),
			side(props.Middle, 0.5, 2),
			side(props.End, 1, 3),
		} :: any,
	}) :: Frame
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.SwitchProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local persistKey = Persist.key("Switch", props.Id, typeof(props.Checked) == "table")
	local checked = Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "checked", peek(props.Checked) == true)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Checked, checked)
	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true
	local showIcons = if props.Icons ~= nil
		then props.Icons == true
		else (theme.Controls and theme.Controls.SwitchIcons) ~= false

	local checkedS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(checked) then 1 else 0
		end),
		theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 0.95,
		theme.Motion.SpringDamping
	)

	local stretch = scope:Value(0)
	local stretchS =
		scope:Spring(stretch, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 1.4, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)

	local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
		Disabled = disabled,
		StateColor = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
	})

	local function commit(nextValue: boolean)
		if peek(checked) == nextValue then
			return
		end
		stretch:set(8)
		checked:set(nextValue)
		task.delay(0.06, function()
			stretch:set(0)
		end)
		if props.OnChanged then
			props.OnChanged(nextValue)
		end
	end

	local trackColor = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local t = use(checkedS)
		-- Off state: clearer outline track (not washed into surface)
		local off = use(theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer)
		local on = use(theme.Colors.Primary)
		local base = Interaction.lerpColor(off, on, t, use)
		if disabled then
			return Interaction.lerpColor(base, use(theme.Colors.SurfaceDim), 0.45, use)
		end
		local state = if t > 0.5 then use(theme.Colors.OnPrimary) else use(theme.Colors.OnSurface)
		return Interaction.lerpColor(base, state, ix.alpha(use), use)
	end)

	local thumbColor = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local t = use(checkedS)
		-- Off thumb: solid OnSurface for contrast against track
		local base = Interaction.lerpColor(
			use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant),
			use(theme.Colors.OnPrimary),
			t,
			use
		)
		if disabled then
			return Interaction.lerpColor(base, use(theme.Colors.Outline), 0.35, use)
		end
		return base
	end)

	-- Same diameter on/off; only brief squash/stretch on press & toggle.
	local thumbSize = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local pressN = use(ix.Press) :: number
		local extra = (use(stretchS) :: number) + pressN * 2.5
		local w = THUMB + extra
		local h = THUMB - math.clamp(extra * 0.15, 0, 2.5)
		return UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	end)

	local thumbPos = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local w = THUMB + (use(stretchS) :: number)
		local travel = TRACK_W - INSET * 2 - w
		return UDim2.new(0, INSET + (use(checkedS) :: number) * travel, 0.5, 0)
	end)

	local trackChildren: { any } = {}
	if showIcons then
		-- iOS “Show On/Off Labels”: I on the left (on), O on the right (off)
		table.insert(
			trackChildren,
			scope:TextLabel({
				Name = "IconOn",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "I",
				FontFace = theme.Fonts.Heading,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnPrimary,
				TextTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local t = use(checkedS)
					local base = 1 - t
					return if disabled then math.min(base + 0.35, 1) else base
				end),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, INSET + 10, 0.5, 0),
				ZIndex = 1,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
				TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
			})
		)
		table.insert(
			trackChildren,
			scope:TextLabel({
				Name = "IconOff",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "O",
				FontFace = theme.Fonts.Heading,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
				TextTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local t = use(checkedS) :: number
					local base = t
					return if disabled then math.min(base + 0.35, 1) else base
				end),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -(INSET + 10), 0.5, 0),
				ZIndex = 1,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
				TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
			})
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		trackChildren,
		scope:Frame({
			Name = "Thumb",
			Size = thumbSize,
			BackgroundColor3 = thumbColor,
			BackgroundTransparency = if disabled then 0.25 else 0,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			Position = thumbPos,
			CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
			ZIndex = 2,
		})
	)

	local track = scope:TextButton(P({
		Name = "Track",
		Text = "",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(TRACK_W, TRACK_H),
		BackgroundColor3 = trackColor,
		BackgroundTransparency = if disabled then 0.35 else 0,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Active = not disabled,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusPill,
		-- Keep stroke visible (ClipsDescendants clips UIStroke on the same instance).
		ClipsDescendants = false,
		Outline = {
			Color = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local c = Interaction.lerpColor(
					use(theme.Colors.Outline),
					use(theme.Colors.Primary),
					use(checkedS),
					use
				)
				return if disabled then use(theme.Colors.OutlineVariant) else c
			end),
			Thickness = 2,
			Transparency = if disabled then 0.45 else 0.15,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
		[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
			if not disabled then
				commit(not peek(checked))
			end
		end,
		[Children] = trackChildren,
	}))
	ix.wire(track)

	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "Switch",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			Padding = theme.Metrics.SpaceXs,
		},
		[Children] = {
			track,
			if props.Label
				then scope:TextLabel({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
					TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
					TextColor3 = if disabled
						then theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant
						else theme.Colors.OnSurface,
					TextTransparency = if disabled then 0.35 else 0,
					Text = props.Label,
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
				})
				else nil,
		},
	}) :: Frame
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.TabsProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local selected = Persist.value(
		scope,
		Persist.key("Tabs", props.Id, typeof(props.Selected) == "table"),
		"selected",
		peek(props.Selected) or (props.Items[1] and props.Items[1].Id) or ""
	)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Selected, selected)

	local chips = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local current = use(selected)
		local nodes = {}
		for i, item in props.Items do
			table.insert(
				nodes,
				Chip(scope, {
					Theme = theme,
					Text = item.Label,
					Selected = item.Id == current,
					LayoutOrder = i,
					OnClick = function()
						selected:set(item.Id)
						if props.OnChanged then
							props.OnChanged(item.Id)
						end
					end,
				})
			)
		end
		return nodes
	end)

	local tabs = ScrollArea(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Orientation = "Horizontal",
		ContentLayout = "List",
		ContentPadding = 0,
		ListPadding = theme.Metrics.SpaceXs,
		ScrollBarThickness = 4,
		ScrollBarPadding = 4,
		ScrollBarRailBackground = false,
		ScrollButtons = false,
		AutoHideScrollBar = true,
		Children = chips,
	})
	tabs.Name = "Tabs"
	return tabs
end
