--!strict
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Persist = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Persist)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Focus = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Focus)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Validators = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Validators)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.TextFieldProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local validationError = scope:Value(nil :: string?)
	local errText = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local live = props.Error
		local fromProp = if live == nil
			then nil
			else (if typeof(live) == "table" then use(live) else live)
		if fromProp ~= nil and fromProp ~= "" then
			return fromProp
		end
		return use(validationError)
	end)
	local hasError = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local e = use(errText)
		return e ~= nil and e ~= ""
	end)
	-- Typed text survives a rebuild when the app provides a Persist store (unless the text is
	-- controlled from outside).
	local persistKey = Persist.key("TextField", props.Id, typeof(props.Text) == "table")
	local persistedText = if persistKey
		then Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "text", props.Text or "")
		else nil
	local disabled = peek(props.Disabled) == true
	local multiline = props.Multiline == true
	local minLines = props.MinLines or (if multiline then 3 else 1)
	local maxLines = props.MaxLines or (if multiline then 12 else 1)
	local lineH = theme.Typography.Body.Size * theme.Typography.Body.LineHeight
	local resize: Types.TextFieldResize = props.Resize or (if multiline then "Y" else "None")
	local focused = scope:Value(0)
	local focusS = scope:Spring(focused, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)

	local minH = minLines * lineH + theme.Metrics.SpaceSm * 2
	local maxH = maxLines * lineH + theme.Metrics.SpaceSm * 2
	-- `Compact` is the small in-widget variant (number boxes, hex fields).
	local compact = props.Compact == true
	local height =
		scope:Value(if multiline then minH else (props.Height or (if compact then 28 else 40)))

	local strokeColor = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local t = use(focusS)
		if use(hasError) then
			return use(theme.Colors.Error)
		end
		return Interaction.lerpColor(use(theme.Colors.Outline), use(theme.Colors.Primary), t, use)
	end)
	local strokeThickness = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return 1 + use(focusS)
	end)

	local padH = if compact then 8 else theme.Metrics.SpaceMd
	local padV = if compact then 2 else theme.Metrics.SpaceSm
	local padL = if props.LeadingIcon then 36 elseif props.Prefix then padH + 14 else padH
	local padR = if props.TrailingIcon then 36 else padH

	local box = scope:TextBox({
		Name = "Input",
		ClearTextOnFocus = false,
		FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
		TextSize = if compact then 13 else theme.Typography.Body.Size,
		Text = if persistedText then peek(persistedText) else (props.Text or ""),
		PlaceholderText = props.Placeholder or "",
		TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
		PlaceholderColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer,
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, use(height))
		end),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = if multiline then Enum.TextYAlignment.Top else Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
		MultiLine = multiline,
		TextWrapped = multiline,
		TextEditable = not disabled,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		-- ClipsDescendants would cut the outline stroke.
		ClipsDescendants = false,
		CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusSm,
		Padding = { padV, padR, padV, padL },
		Outline = {
			Color = strokeColor,
			Thickness = strokeThickness,
			Mode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		},
	}) :: TextBox
	Focus.manage(box, theme, true)

	local function runValidation()
		if props.Validators == nil then
			return
		end
		local ok, msg = Validators.run(props.Validators, box.Text)
		validationError:set(if ok then nil else msg)
	end

	table.insert(
		scope,
		box.Focused:Connect(function()
			focused:set(1)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		scope,
		box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			focused:set(0)
			if props.ValidateOnBlur ~= false then
				runValidation()
			end
			if props.OnSubmit then
				props.OnSubmit(box.Text, box)
			end
		end)
	)

	if persistedText then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				persistedText:set(box.Text)
			end)
		)
	end

	-- A Value passed as `Text` follows what the user types.
	if Bind.isWritable(props.Text) then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				if peek(props.Text) ~= box.Text then
					(props.Text :: any):set(box.Text)
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	if props.OnChanged then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
				(props.OnChanged :: any)(box.Text)
			end)
		)
	end

	local adornments: { any } = {}
	if props.LeadingIcon then
		table.insert(
			adornments,
			scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = props.LeadingIcon,
				IconSize = 18,
				Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
			}))({
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0),
				ZIndex = 2,
			})
		)
	end
	if props.TrailingIcon then
		table.insert(
			adornments,
			scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = props.TrailingIcon,
				IconSize = 18,
				Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
			}))({
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
				ZIndex = 2,
			})
		)
	end

	if props.Prefix then
		table.insert(
			adornments,
			scope:TextLabel({
				Name = "Prefix",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, padH, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 20),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				FontFace = theme.Fonts.Body,
				TextSize = if compact then 13 else theme.Typography.Body.Size,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
				Text = props.Prefix,
				ZIndex = 2,
			})
		)
	end

	local inputWrapKids: { any } = { box }
	for _, a in adornments do
		table.insert(inputWrapKids, a)
	end

	if resize ~= "None" and multiline then
		local handle = scope:TextButton({
			Name = "ResizeHandle",
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
			ZIndex = 5,
			[Children] = {
				-- MD-style corner grip (two diagonal ticks)
				scope:Frame({
					BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2),
					Rotation = -45,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.55),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
				}),
				scope:Frame({
					BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
					BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2),
					Rotation = -45,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7),
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
				}),
			},
		}) :: TextButton

		table.insert(
			scope,
			handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				local start = input.Position
				local startH = peek(height)
				local startW = box.AbsoluteSize.X
				local move = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed: InputObject)
					if
						changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						and changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						return
					end
					local dy = changed.Position.Y - start.Y
					local dx = changed.Position.X - start.X
					if resize == "Y" or resize == "Both" then
						height:set(math.clamp(startH + dy, minH, maxH))
					end
					if resize == "X" or resize == "Both" then
						local parent = box.Parent
						if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") then
							local newW = math.max(120, startW + dx)
							parent.Size = UDim2.new(0, newW, 0, parent.AbsoluteSize.Y)
						end
					end
				end)
				local ended
				ended = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(endedInput)
					if
						endedInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or endedInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						move:Disconnect()
						ended:Disconnect()
					end
				end)
				table.insert(scope, move)
				table.insert(scope, ended)
			end)
		)
		table.insert(inputWrapKids, handle)
	end

	local field = scope:Frame({
		Name = "Field",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		[Children] = inputWrapKids,
	})

	local children = {}
	if props.Label then
		table.insert(
			children,
			scope:TextLabel({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
				TextSize = theme.Typography.Label.Size,
				TextColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return if use(hasError)
						then use(theme.Colors.Error)
						else use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant)
				end),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				Text = props.Label,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
				LayoutOrder = 1,
			})
		)
	end
	table.insert(children, field)
	table.insert(
		children,
		scope:TextLabel({
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(hasError)
					then use(theme.Colors.Error)
					else use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant)
			end),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Text = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local e = use(errText)
				if e and e ~= "" then
					return e
				end
				return props.Helper or ""
			end),
			Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local e = use(errText)
				return (e ~= nil and e ~= "") or (props.Helper ~= nil)
			end),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
			LayoutOrder = 3,
		})
	)

	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "TextField",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = theme.Metrics.Space2xs,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = children,
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
--[[
	A bar of tool buttons, toggles and separators. See docs/Components/Navigation/Toolbar.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local Tooltip = require(script.Parent.Tooltip)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local BUTTON = 30

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.ToolbarProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local vertical = props.Orientation == "Vertical"
	local kids: { any } = {
		scope:New("UIListLayout")({
			FillDirection = if vertical
				then Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
				else Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			HorizontalAlignment = if vertical
				then Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
				else Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
		}),
		scope:New("UIPadding")({
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6),
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4),
		}),
	}

	local function tip(target: Instance, text: string)
		if Layer.resolve(props) then
			Tooltip(scope, { Theme = theme, Layer = props.Layer, Target = target, Text = text })
		end
	end

	for index, item in props.Items do
		if item.Separator then
			table.insert(
				kids,
				scope:New("Frame")({
					Name = "Separator",
					BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					LayoutOrder = index,
					Size = if vertical then UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 1) else UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -8),
				})
			)
		elseif item.Spacer then
			-- Takes the room that is left, pushing the items after it to the end.
			table.insert(
				kids,
				scope:New("Frame")({
					Name = "Spacer",
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					LayoutOrder = index,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
					[Children] = scope:New("UIFlexItem")({ FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill }),
				})
			)
		elseif item.Content then
			table.insert(kids, scope:Apply(item.Content)({ LayoutOrder = index }))
		else
			local disabled = peek(item.Disabled) == true
			local toggled = if item.Toggled ~= nil then item.Toggled else nil
			-- A toggle owns a Value of its own when it isn't given one.
			local state = if item.Toggle
				then (if Bind.isWritable(toggled)
					then toggled
					else scope:Value(peek(toggled) == true))
				else toggled
			local on = scope:Computed(function(use)
				return if state ~= nil then use(state) == true else false
			end)
			local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, { Disabled = disabled })
			local labelKids: { any } = {
				scope:New("UIListLayout")({
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
				}),
				scope:New("UIPadding")({
					PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, if item.Text then 10 else 0),
					PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, if item.Text then 10 else 0),
				}),
			}
			local ink = scope:Computed(function(use)
				if disabled then
					return use(theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant)
				end
				return if use(on)
					then use(theme.Colors.OnPrimaryContainer)
					else use(theme.Colors.OnSurface)
			end)
			if item.Icon then
				table.insert(
					labelKids,
					scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
						Theme = theme,
						Name = item.Icon,
						IconSize = 18,
						Color = ink,
						Transparency = if disabled then 0.55 else 0,
					}))({ LayoutOrder = 1 })
				)
			end
			if item.Text then
				table.insert(
					labelKids,
					scope:New("TextLabel")({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, BUTTON),
						LayoutOrder = 2,
						FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
						TextSize = 13,
						TextColor3 = ink,
						TextTransparency = if disabled then 0.55 else 0,
						Text = item.Text,
					})
				)
			end
			local button = scope:New("TextButton")({
				Name = item.Id or `Item{index}`,
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Active = not disabled,
				LayoutOrder = index,
				AutomaticSize = if item.Text then Enum.AutomaticSize.X else Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
				Size = if item.Text
					then UDim2.fromOffset(0, BUTTON)
					else UDim2.fromOffset(BUTTON, BUTTON),
				BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
					local base = if use(on)
						then use(theme.Colors.PrimaryContainer)
						else use(theme.Colors.Surface)
					return Interaction.lerpColor(
						base,
						use(theme.Colors.OnSurface),
						ix.alpha(use),
						use
					)
				end),
				BackgroundTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return if use(on) then 0 else 1 - math.clamp(ix.alpha(use) * 6, 0, 1)
				end),
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
					if disabled then
						return
					end
					if item.Toggle and state ~= nil and Bind.isWritable(state) then
						(state :: any):set(not peek(state))
					end
					if item.OnClick then
						item.OnClick()
					end
				end,
				[Children] = {
					scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.RadiusSm) }),
					scope:New("Frame")({
						Name = "Content",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AutomaticSize = if item.Text
							then Enum.AutomaticSize.X
							else Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
						Size = if item.Text
							then UDim2.fromOffset(0, BUTTON)
							else UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						[Children] = labelKids,
					}),
				} :: any,
			}) :: TextButton
			ix.wire(button)
			table.insert(kids, button)
			local tipText = item.Tooltip or item.Text
			if tipText then
				tip(button, if item.Shortcut then `{tipText} ({item.Shortcut})` else tipText)
			end
		end
	end

	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Toolbar",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = props.Size or (if vertical then UDim2.new(0, 44, 1, 0) else UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		[Children] = kids,
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local CanvasFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.CanvasFade)
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Follow = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Follow)
local place = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Placement)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.TooltipProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local visible = scope:Value(0)
	local visibleS = scope:Spring(visible, theme.Motion.SpringSpeed, theme.Motion.SpringDamping)
	local placement: Types.TooltipPlacement = props.Placement or "Auto"
	local gap = props.Gap or 8

	local tip = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Tooltip",
		BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.SurfaceContainerHigh,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		Visible = CanvasFade.shown(scope, visibleS, nil, { Theme = theme }),
		BackgroundTransparency = CanvasFade.surfaceTransparency(scope, visibleS, { Theme = theme }),
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex or 120,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.RadiusSm) }),
			scope:New("UIPadding")({
				PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceXs),
				PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceXs),
				PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceSm),
				PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, theme.Metrics.SpaceSm),
			}),
			scope:New("UIStroke")({
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
				Color = theme.Colors.Outline,
				Thickness = 1,
			}),
			scope:New("TextLabel")({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
				TextSize = theme.Typography.Label.Size,
				TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
				Text = props.Text,
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame

	local host = CanvasFade.host(scope, tip, visibleS, { Theme = theme })
	Layer.mount(scope, props, host)

	local function updatePosition()
		local target = Layer.asGui(props.Target)
		if target == nil then
			return
		end
		local layer = Layer.resolve(props)
		local abs = target.AbsolutePosition
		local size = target.AbsoluteSize
		if layer then
			-- Place and clamp in the layer's own space, so inside a Window the tip stays
			-- within the window rather than only within the screen.
			local origin = layer.AbsolutePosition
			local pos, _ = place(
				placement,
				Vector2.new(abs.X - origin.X, abs.Y - origin.Y),
				size,
				host.AbsoluteSize,
				gap,
				layer.AbsoluteSize
			)
			host.Position = pos
		else
			local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local viewport = if camera then camera.ViewportSize else Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
			local pos, _ = place(
				placement,
				Vector2.new(abs.X, abs.Y),
				size,
				host.AbsoluteSize,
				gap,
				viewport - inset
			)
			host.Position = pos
		end
	end

	local hoverTarget = Layer.asGui(props.Target)
	if hoverTarget then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			hoverTarget.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				visible:set(1)
				task.defer(updatePosition)
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			scope,
			hoverTarget.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				visible:set(0)
			end)
		)
		Follow(scope, visible, function(v)
			return v > 0.5
		end, updatePosition)
	end

	return host
end

--!strict
--[[
	Recursive tree with collapse/expand, chevron rotation, folder/file icons.
	Child branches spring open/closed (height clip + fade + scale).
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Persist = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Persist)
local Bind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Bind)
local Interaction = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Interaction)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local P = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.props)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local function copyExpanded(map: { [string]: boolean }?): { [string]: boolean }
	local out: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	if map then
		for k, v in map do
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.TreeViewProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local persistKey = Persist.key("TreeView", props.Id, typeof(props.Expanded) == "table")
	local expanded =
		Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "expanded", copyExpanded(peek(props.Expanded)))
	local selected = Persist.value(scope, persistKey, "selected", peek(props.Selected) or "")
	Bind.link(scope, props.Selected, selected)
	Bind.link(scope, props.Expanded, expanded, {
		toInternal = copyExpanded,
		toProp = copyExpanded,
		equals = function(a: { [string]: boolean }, b: { [string]: boolean }): boolean
			for key, value in a do
				if b[key] ~= value then
					return false
				end
			end
			for key, value in b do
				if a[key] ~= value then
					return false
				end
			end
			return true
		end,
	})
	local order = 0

	local function renderNode(node: Types.TreeNode, depth: number): { Instance }
		local nodes: { Instance } = {}
		local hasChildren = node.Children ~= nil and #(node.Children :: { Types.TreeNode }) > 0
		local iconName = node.Icon or (if hasChildren then "folder" else "file")
		order += 1
		local layoutOrder = order

		local isExpanded = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return use(expanded)[node.Id] == true
		end)
		local expandS = scope:Spring(
			scope:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(isExpanded) then 1 else 0
			end),
			theme.Motion.SpringSpeed * 0.95,
			theme.Motion.SpringDamping
		)
		local isSelected = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return use(selected) == node.Id
		end)
		local ix = Interaction.bind(scope, theme, {
			StateColor = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
		})

		local chevron = if hasChildren
			then scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "ChevronHost",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
				LayoutOrder = 1,
				[Children] = {
					-- Rotate a child of the host: UIListLayout ignores Rotation on its direct children.
					scope:New("Frame")({
						Name = "ChevronRot",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						Rotation = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return (use(expandS) :: number) * 90
						end),
						[Children] = {
							scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
								Theme = theme,
								Name = "chevron-right",
								IconSize = 16,
								Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
							}))({
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
								Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
							}),
						},
					}),
				},
			})
			else scope:New("Frame")({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
				LayoutOrder = 1,
			})

		local row = scope:TextButton(P({
			Name = "Tree_" .. node.Id,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use)
				local base = if use(isSelected)
					then use(theme.Colors.PrimaryContainer)
					else use(theme.Colors.Surface)
				return Interaction.lerpColor(base, use(theme.Colors.OnSurface), ix.alpha(use), use)
			end),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
			LayoutOrder = layoutOrder,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			CornerRadius = theme.Metrics.RadiusSm,
			Padding = { theme.Metrics.Space2xs, theme.Metrics.SpaceXs },
			Layout = {
				Kind = "List",
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				Padding = theme.Metrics.SpaceXs,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			},
			[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
				selected:set(node.Id)
				if props.OnSelect then
					props.OnSelect(node.Id)
				end
				if hasChildren then
					local map = copyExpanded(peek(expanded))
					local nextOpen = not (map[node.Id] == true)
					map[node.Id] = nextOpen
					expanded:set(map)
					if props.OnToggle then
						props.OnToggle(node.Id, nextOpen)
					end
				end
			end,
			[Children] = {
				scope:Frame({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(depth * 16, 1),
					LayoutOrder = 0,
				}),
				chevron,
				scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
					Theme = theme,
					Name = iconName,
					IconSize = 16,
					Color = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
				}))({
					LayoutOrder = 2,
				}),
				scope:TextLabel({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					FontFace = theme.Typography.Body.Font,
					TextSize = theme.Typography.Body.Size,
					TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					Text = node.Label,
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
					LayoutOrder = 3,
				}),
			},
		})) :: TextButton
		ix.wire(row)
		table.insert(nodes, row)

		if hasChildren then
			local childNodes: { Instance } = {}
			for _, child in node.Children :: { Types.TreeNode } do
				for _, inst in renderNode(child, depth + 1) do
					table.insert(childNodes, inst)
				end
			end
			order += 1
			local branchHeight = scope:Value(0)
			local branchInner = scope:Frame({
				Name = "BranchInner",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				[Children] = {
					scope:New("UIScale")({
						Scale = scope:Computed(function(use)
							return 0.97 + 0.03 * use(expandS)
						end),
					}),
					scope:New("UIListLayout")({
						SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
						Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
					}),
					childNodes,
				},
			})
			local function syncBranch()
				local h = branchInner.AbsoluteSize.Y
				if h > 0 and math.abs(h - peek(branchHeight)) > 0.5 then
					branchHeight:set(h)
				end
			end
			table.insert(
				scope,
				branchInner:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(syncBranch)
			)
			task.defer(syncBranch)

			table.insert(
				nodes,
				scope:Frame({
					Name = "Children_" .. node.Id,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
						return UDim2.new(
							1,
							0,
							0,
							(use(expandS) :: number) * (use(branchHeight) :: number)
						)
					end),
					Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
						return use(expandS) > 0.01
					end),
					ClipsDescendants = true,
					LayoutOrder = order,
					[Children] = { branchInner },
				})
			)
		end

		return nodes
	end

	local all: { Instance } = {}
	for _, node in props.Nodes do
		for _, inst in renderNode(node, 0) do
			table.insert(all, inst)
		end
	end

	return scope:Frame({
		Name = "TreeView",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		Layout = {
			Kind = "List",
			Padding = 2,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		},
		[Children] = all,
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
--[[
	Rounded app chrome shell (elevated Sheet colors) that hosts AppBar,
	NavigationRail, content, and overlay layers (NavigationDrawer, menus, dialogs).
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Layer = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Layer)
local Corners = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Corners)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)
local Resize = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.Resize)
local Icon = require(script.Parent.Icon)
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local ALL_HANDLES =
	{ "Left", "Right", "Top", "Bottom", "TopLeft", "TopRight", "BottomLeft", "BottomRight" }
local HANDLE_EDGES: { [string]: Resize.Edges } = {
	Left = { left = true },
	Right = { right = true },
	Top = { top = true },
	Bottom = { bottom = true },
	TopLeft = { left = true, top = true },
	TopRight = { right = true, top = true },
	BottomLeft = { left = true, bottom = true },
	BottomRight = { right = true, bottom = true },
}

-- Cursor glyph shown over each resize handle (the system cursor is hidden meanwhile).
local HANDLE_CURSOR_ICON: { [string]: string } = {
	Left = "move-horizontal",
	Right = "move-horizontal",
	Top = "move-vertical",
	Bottom = "move-vertical",
	TopLeft = "move-diagonal-2",
	BottomRight = "move-diagonal-2",
	TopRight = "move-diagonal",
	BottomLeft = "move-diagonal",
}

local Children = Fusion.Children

-- Matches NavigationRail default horizontal height.
local HORIZONTAL_RAIL_HEIGHT = 52

local function isVerticalRail(rail: Instance?, explicit: ("Vertical" | "Horizontal")?): boolean
	if explicit == "Horizontal" then
		return false
	end
	if explicit == "Vertical" then
		return true
	end
	if rail == nil or not rail:IsA("GuiObject") then
		return true
	end
	-- NavigationRail horizontal default size is UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 72)
	local s = (rail :: GuiObject).Size
	if s.X.Scale >= 1 and s.Y.Scale == 0 and s.Y.Offset > 0 and s.Y.Offset <= 100 then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

return function(scope: Types.Scope, props: Types.WindowProps): Instance
	local theme = resolveTheme(props)
	local verticalRail = isVerticalRail(props.NavigationRail, props.RailOrientation)
	local hasAppBar = props.AppBar ~= nil
	local hasRail = props.NavigationRail ~= nil
	local appBarHeight = if hasAppBar then theme.Metrics.AppBarHeight else 0
	local railWidth = if hasRail and verticalRail then theme.Metrics.RailWidth else 0
	local railBottom = if hasRail and not verticalRail then HORIZONTAL_RAIL_HEIGHT else 0
	local radius = props.CornerRadius or theme.Metrics.RadiusPanel
	local elevated = if props.Elevated == nil then true else props.Elevated

	local overlayLayer = scope:Frame({
		Name = "OverlayLayer",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		ZIndex = 50,
	}) :: Frame

	if props.AppBar then
		-- With a side rail, the rail is full height and the app bar is narrower.
		scope:Apply(props.AppBar)({
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(railWidth, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -railWidth, 0, appBarHeight),
			ZIndex = 10,
		})
	end

	if props.NavigationRail then
		scope:Apply(props.NavigationRail)({
			Position = if verticalRail
				then UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
				else UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -railBottom),
			Size = if verticalRail
				then UDim2.new(0, railWidth, 1, 0)
				else UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, railBottom),
			-- The side rail sits above the app bar so its shadow falls on it.
			ZIndex = if verticalRail then 11 else 5,
		})
	end

	local content = scope:Frame({
		Name = "Content",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = if verticalRail
			then UDim2.fromOffset(railWidth, appBarHeight)
			else UDim2.fromOffset(0, appBarHeight),
		Size = if verticalRail
			then UDim2.new(1, -railWidth, 1, -appBarHeight)
			else UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(appBarHeight + railBottom)),
		ZIndex = 1,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		[Children] = props.Children,
	})

	local chrome: { any } = {
		content,
		overlayLayer,
		scope:New("UIStroke")({
			BorderStrokePosition = Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Outer,
			Color = theme.Colors.OutlineVariant,
			Transparency = 0.25,
			Thickness = 1,
			ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
			ZIndex = 5,
		}),
	}
	if props.AppBar then
		table.insert(chrome, 1, props.AppBar)
	end
	if props.NavigationRail then
		table.insert(chrome, props.NavigationRail)
	end

	-- CanvasGroup + CornerRadius clips descendants to the rounded rect (Sheet-equivalent fill).
	local window = scope:Frame({
		Name = "Window",
		BackgroundColor3 = if elevated
			then theme.Colors.SurfaceContainerHigh
			else theme.Colors.Surface,
		Shadow = {
			BlurRadius = if elevated then 24 else 6,
			Offset = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4),
			Transparency = 0.75,
		},
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		SizeConstraint = props.SizeConstraint or nil,
		AspectRatio = props.AspectRatio or nil,
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0),
		Position = props.Position or UDim2.fromScale(0, 0),
		Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		Visible = props.Visible,
		ZIndex = props.ZIndex,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		CornerRadius = radius,
		[Children] = chrome,
	}) :: Frame

	-- ClipsDescendants only clips to a rectangle, so the chrome rounds its own corners. With a
	-- side rail, the rail takes both left corners and the app bar the top right. With a bottom
	-- bar, the app bar takes the top corners and the bar the bottom ones.
	local r: number = radius :: any
	if hasRail and verticalRail then
		Corners.apply(props.AppBar, 0, r, 0, 0)
		Corners.apply(props.NavigationRail, r, 0, r, 0)
	else
		Corners.apply(props.AppBar, r, r, 0, 0)
		Corners.apply(props.NavigationRail, 0, 0, r, r)
	end

	local overlays = props.Overlays
	if overlays then
		for _, overlay in overlays do
			overlay.Parent = overlayLayer
		end
	end

	-- Let floating UI that fills the window (scrims, sheets) match its rounding.
	window:SetAttribute(Corners.WindowRadiusAttribute, r)

	if props.Draggable and props.AppBar then
		local handle = props.AppBar :: GuiObject
		local bounds = props.DragBounds or "Titlebar"
		local keepX = props.DragKeepVisible or 120

		-- Where the window's top-left may go (absolute screen space).
		local function clampTopLeft(topLeft: Vector2): Vector2
			local host = window:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
			if host == nil or bounds == "Free" then
				return topLeft
			end
			local hostPos = (host :: any).AbsolutePosition :: Vector2
			local hostSize = (host :: any).AbsoluteSize :: Vector2
			local size = window.AbsoluteSize
			local minX, maxX, minY, maxY
			if bounds == "Screen" then
				minX, maxX = hostPos.X, math.max(hostPos.X, hostPos.X + hostSize.X - size.X)
				minY, maxY = hostPos.Y, math.max(hostPos.Y, hostPos.Y + hostSize.Y - size.Y)
			else
				-- Titlebar: most of the window may leave the screen, but never the handle.
				local visibleX = math.min(size.X, keepX)
				local visibleY = math.min(size.Y, handle.AbsoluteSize.Y)
				minX, maxX = hostPos.X - (size.X - visibleX), hostPos.X + hostSize.X - visibleX
				minY, maxY = hostPos.Y, hostPos.Y + hostSize.Y - visibleY
			end
			return Vector2.new(math.clamp(topLeft.X, minX, maxX), math.clamp(topLeft.Y, minY, maxY))
		end

		table.insert(
			scope,
			handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
				if
					input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
					and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				then
					return
				end
				local startPointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
				local startPosition = window.Position
				local startTopLeft = window.AbsolutePosition

				ScrollInput.capture(window, function(move: InputObject)
					return move.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
						or move.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end, function(ended: InputObject)
					return ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				end, function(pointer: Vector3)
					local target = clampTopLeft(
						startTopLeft + (Vector2.new(pointer.X, pointer.Y) - startPointer)
					)
					local delta = target - startTopLeft
					local position = UDim2.new(
						startPosition.X.Scale,
						startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
						startPosition.Y.Scale,
						startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
					)
					-- A Value passed as `Position` keeps the position across rebuilds.
					local source: any = props.Position
					if typeof(source) == "table" and source.set then
						source:set(position)
					else
						window.Position = position
					end
				end, function() end)
			end)
		)
	end

	if props.Resizable then
		local minSize: Vector2 = props.MinSize or Vector2.new(240, 160)
		local maxSize: Vector2? = props.MaxSize
		local thickness: number = props.ResizeHandleSize or 6
		local cornerSize = thickness * 2
		local handles: { string } = props.ResizeHandles or ALL_HANDLES
		-- A locked ratio: explicit, else the window's own aspect-ratio constraint.
		local ratio: number? = props.ResizeRatio
		if ratio == nil and props.AspectRatio then
			ratio = (props.AspectRatio :: any).Ratio
		end

		-- (position, size) of each handle: thin strips on the edges, squares on the corners.
		local function geometry(name: string): (UDim2, UDim2)
			local t, c = thickness, cornerSize
			if name == "Left" then
				return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, c), UDim2.new(0, t, 1, -2 * c)
			elseif name == "Right" then
				return UDim2.new(1, -t, 0, c), UDim2.new(0, t, 1, -2 * c)
			elseif name == "Top" then
				return UDim2.new(0, c, 0, 0), UDim2.new(1, -2 * c, 0, t)
			elseif name == "Bottom" then
				return UDim2.new(0, c, 1, -t), UDim2.new(1, -2 * c, 0, t)
			elseif name == "TopLeft" then
				return UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(c, c)
			elseif name == "TopRight" then
				return UDim2.new(1, -c, 0, 0), UDim2.fromOffset(c, c)
			elseif name == "BottomLeft" then
				return UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -c), UDim2.fromOffset(c, c)
			end
			return UDim2.new(1, -c, 1, -c), UDim2.fromOffset(c, c)
		end

		-- A Value passed as `Size` / `Position` keeps the result across rebuilds.
		local function write(prop: string, value: UDim2)
			local source: any = (props :: any)[prop]
			if typeof(source) == "table" and source.set then
				source:set(value)
			else
				(window :: any)[prop] = value
			end
		end

		-- Resize cursor: a glyph that follows the pointer while it is over a handle or dragging.
		local cursor = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "ResizeCursor",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
			BackgroundColor3 = theme.Colors.SurfaceContainer,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
			Visible = false,
			Active = false,
			ZIndex = 1000,
			[Children] = {
				scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
				scope:New("UIStroke")({ Color = theme.Colors.Outline, Transparency = 0.5 }),
			},
		}) :: Frame
		local cursorIcons: { [string]: Instance } = {}
		for _, iconName in
			{ "move-horizontal", "move-vertical", "move-diagonal", "move-diagonal-2" }
		do
			local icon = scope:Apply(Icon(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Name = iconName,
				IconSize = 18,
				Color = theme.Colors.OnSurface,
			}))({
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Visible = false,
				Parent = cursor,
			})
			cursorIcons[iconName] = icon
		end
		local hovering: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		local draggingHandle: string? = nil
		local hiddenSystemCursor = false

		local function placeCursor()
			local host = window:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector") :: any
			if host and cursor.Parent ~= host then
				cursor.Parent = host
			end
			-- GetMouseLocation is in screen space (includes the top bar inset); the GUI space the
			-- cursor lives in only does when the ScreenGui ignores the inset.
			local pointer = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			if not (host and host:IsA("ScreenGui") and host.IgnoreGuiInset) then
				pointer -= GuiService:GetGuiInset()
			end
			cursor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pointer.X, pointer.Y)
		end

		local function refreshCursor(show: boolean?)
			local shown: string? = draggingHandle
			if shown == nil then
				for handleName in hovering do
					shown = handleName
					break
				end
			end
			if shown == nil then
				cursor.Visible = false
				if hiddenSystemCursor then
					hiddenSystemCursor = false
					UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
				end
				return
			end
			for iconName, icon in cursorIcons do
				(icon :: any).Visible = iconName == HANDLE_CURSOR_ICON[shown]
			end
			if show ~= false then
				placeCursor()
			end
			cursor.Visible = true
			if not hiddenSystemCursor then
				hiddenSystemCursor = true
				UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
			end
		end

		table.insert(scope, function()
			if hiddenSystemCursor then
				UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
			end
		end)

		for _, name in handles do
			local edges = HANDLE_EDGES[name]
			if edges == nil then
				continue
			end
			local position, size = geometry(name)
			local handle = scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = `Resize{name}`,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Active = true,
				Position = position,
				Size = size,
				-- Above the chrome, below the overlay layer (dialogs, sheets).
				ZIndex = 40,
				Parent = window,
			}) :: Frame

			table.insert(
				scope,
				handle.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					hovering[name] = true
					refreshCursor()
				end)
			)
			table.insert(
				scope,
				handle.MouseMoved:Connect(function()
					if hovering[name] or draggingHandle == name then
						refreshCursor()
					end
				end)
			)
			table.insert(
				scope,
				handle.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					hovering[name] = nil
					refreshCursor(false)
				end)
			)

			table.insert(
				scope,
				handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
					if
						input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					then
						return
					end
					local startPointer = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
					local startTopLeft = window.AbsolutePosition
					local startSize = window.AbsoluteSize
					local startPosition = window.Position
					local anchor = window.AnchorPoint

					local host = window:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector") :: any
					local hostSize: Vector2 = if host
						then host.AbsoluteSize
						else Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge)
					local limits: Resize.Limits = {
						minWidth = minSize.X,
						minHeight = minSize.Y,
						maxWidth = if maxSize then maxSize.X else hostSize.X,
						maxHeight = if maxSize then maxSize.Y else hostSize.Y,
						ratio = ratio,
						grid = props.ResizeSnap,
					}

					draggingHandle = name
					refreshCursor()

					ScrollInput.capture(window, function(move: InputObject)
						return move.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
							or move.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					end, function(ended: InputObject)
						return ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
							or ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					end, function(pointer: Vector3)
						refreshCursor()
						local x, y, w, h = Resize.compute(
							edges,
							startTopLeft.X,
							startTopLeft.Y,
							startSize.X,
							startSize.Y,
							pointer.X - startPointer.X,
							pointer.Y - startPointer.Y,
							limits
						)
						-- Position is anchored: move it by how far the anchor point moved.
						local shiftX = (x + anchor.X * w)
							- (startTopLeft.X + anchor.X * startSize.X)
						local shiftY = (y + anchor.Y * h)
							- (startTopLeft.Y + anchor.Y * startSize.Y)
						write(
							"Position",
							UDim2.new(
								startPosition.X.Scale,
								startPosition.X.Offset + shiftX,
								startPosition.Y.Scale,
								startPosition.Y.Offset + shiftY
							)
						)
						write("Size", UDim2.fromOffset(w, h))
						if props.OnResized then
							props.OnResized(Vector2.new(w, h))
						end
					end, function()
						draggingHandle = nil
						refreshCursor(false)
					end)
				end)
			)
		end
	end

	Layer.bind(overlayLayer)

	return window
end

--!strict
--[[
	The right-hand pane of the dev tools: the selected instance, its path, and editable properties.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Properties = require(script.Parent.Properties)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

local Details = {}

type Env = {
	theme: any,
	C: any,
	select: (instance: Instance?) -> (),
}

local function describe(value: any): string
	local kind = typeof(value)
	if kind == "UDim2" then
		return string.format(
			"{%.3g, %d}, {%.3g, %d}",
			value.X.Scale,
			value.X.Offset,
			value.Y.Scale,
			value.Y.Offset
		)
	elseif kind == "UDim" then
		return string.format("%.3g, %d", value.Scale, value.Offset)
	elseif kind == "Vector2" then
		return string.format("%.1f, %.1f", value.X, value.Y)
	elseif kind == "Color3" then
		return "#" .. value:ToHex()
	elseif kind == "number" then
		return string.format("%.4g", value)
	elseif kind == "EnumItem" then
		return value.Name
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

local function stepFor(name: string, value: number): (number, number?, number?)
	if string.find(name, "Transparency") then
		return 0.05, 0, 1
	elseif name == "Rotation" then
		return 1, nil, nil
	elseif math.abs(value - math.floor(value)) < 1e-9 then
		return 1, nil, nil
	end
	return 0.1, nil, nil
end

--- A row of number fields that edit the parts of a value (a UDim2 is four numbers).
local function numberParts(
	sc: any,
	env: Env,
	labels: { string },
	values: { number },
	apply: ({ number }) -> ()
): Instance
	local current = table.clone(values)
	local fields: { any } = {
		sc:New("UIListLayout")({
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
		}),
	}
	for index, label in labels do
		table.insert(
			fields,
			env.C.NumberField(sc, {
				Theme = env.theme,
				Label = label,
				Value = current[index],
				Step = if string.sub(label, 1, 1) == "S" then 0.05 else 1,
				LayoutOrder = index,
				Size = UDim2.new(1 / #labels, -4, 0, 26),
				OnChanged = function(n: number)
					current[index] = n
					apply(current)
				end,
			})
		)
	end
	return sc:New("Frame")({
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		[Children] = fields :: any,
	})
end

--- The control that edits one property, or text when it can't be edited.
local function editor(
	sc: any,
	env: Env,
	target: Instance,
	spec: Properties.Spec,
	value: any
): Instance
	local C, theme = env.C, env.theme
	local name = spec.name
	local function write(newValue: any)
		pcall(function()
			(target :: any)[name] = newValue
		end)
	end
	local state = sc:Value(value)
	table.insert(
		sc,
		target:GetPropertyChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
			local ok, now = pcall(function()
				return (target :: any)[name]
			end)
			if ok then
				state:set(now)
			end
		end)
	)

	local kind = typeof(value)
	if not spec.readOnly then
		if kind == "boolean" then
			return C.Switch(sc, { Theme = theme, Checked = state, OnChanged = write })
		elseif kind == "number" then
			local step, low, high = stepFor(name, value)
			return C.NumberField(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Value = state,
				Step = step,
				Min = low,
				Max = high,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
				OnChanged = write,
			})
		elseif kind == "string" then
			return C.TextField(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Compact = true,
				Text = state,
				OnSubmit = function(text: string)
					write(text)
				end,
			})
		elseif kind == "Color3" then
			return C.TextField(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Compact = true,
				Prefix = "#",
				Text = sc:Computed(function(use)
					return (use(state) :: Color3):ToHex()
				end),
				OnSubmit = function(text: string)
					local ok, color = pcall(Color3.fromHex, text)
					if ok then
						write(color)
					end
				end,
			})
		elseif kind == "EnumItem" then
			-- Pressing the button goes to the next item of the enum.
			return C.Button(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Variant = "Tonal",
				Text = sc:Computed(function(use)
					return (use(state) :: EnumItem).Name
				end),
				OnClick = function()
					local items = (value :: EnumItem).EnumType:GetEnumItems()
					local current = peek(state) :: EnumItem
					for index, item in items do
						if item == current then
							write(items[index % #items + 1])
							return
						end
					end
				end,
			})
		elseif kind == "UDim2" then
			local udim2 = value :: UDim2
			return numberParts(
				sc,
				env,
				{ "SX", "OX", "SY", "OY" },
				{ udim2.X.Scale, udim2.X.Offset, udim2.Y.Scale, udim2.Y.Offset },
				function(n: { number })
					write(UDim2.new(n[1], n[2], n[3], n[4]))
				end
			)
		elseif kind == "UDim" then
			local udim = value :: UDim
			return numberParts(
				sc,
				env,
				{ "S", "O" },
				{ udim.Scale, udim.Offset },
				function(n: { number })
					write(UDim.new(n[1], n[2]))
				end
			)
		elseif kind == "Vector2" then
			local vector = value :: Vector2
			return numberParts(
				sc,
				env,
				{ "X", "Y" },
				{ vector.X, vector.Y },
				function(n: { number })
					write(Vector2.new(n[1], n[2]))
				end
			)
		end
	end
	return sc:New("TextLabel")({
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		FontFace = theme.Fonts.Mono,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
		Text = sc:Computed(function(use)
			return describe(use(state))
		end),
	})
end

--- Build the pane for `target`. It lives in scope `sc`, so everything it connects goes with it.
function Details.build(sc: any, env: Env, target: Instance): Instance
	local C, theme = env.C, env.theme
	local order = 0
	local function nextOrder(): number
		order += 1
		return order
	end
	local kids: { any } = {
		sc:New("UIListLayout")({
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
		}),
		sc:New("UIPadding")({
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}),
	}

	local function section(title: string)
		table.insert(
			kids,
			C.Text(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Text = title,
				Variant = "Label",
				Color = theme.Colors.Primary,
				LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			})
		)
	end

	-- Header: the class, and the name, which can be edited.
	table.insert(
		kids,
		C.Text(sc, {
			Theme = theme,
			Text = target.ClassName,
			Variant = "Title",
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
		})
	)
	table.insert(
		kids,
		C.TextField(sc, {
			Theme = theme,
			Compact = true,
			Label = "Name",
			Text = target.Name,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			OnSubmit = function(text: string)
				if text ~= "" then
					pcall(function()
						target.Name = text
					end)
				end
			end,
		})
	)

	-- The path: press an ancestor to select it.
	local crumbs: { any } = {
		sc:New("UIListLayout")({
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Wraps = true,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 2),
		}),
	}
	local chain: { Instance } = {}
	local at: Instance? = target.Parent
	while at and at ~= game do
		table.insert(chain, 1, at)
		at = at.Parent
	end
	for index, ancestor in chain do
		table.insert(
			crumbs,
			C.Button(sc, {
				Theme = theme,
				Text = ancestor.Name .. " ›",
				Variant = "Text",
				LayoutOrder = index,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
				OnClick = function()
					env.select(ancestor)
				end,
			})
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		kids,
		sc:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Path",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
			[Children] = crumbs :: any,
		})
	)

	-- Properties.
	local specs = Properties.specsFor(target)
	if #specs > 0 then
		section("Properties")
	end
	for _, spec in specs do
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return (target :: any)[spec.name]
		end)
		if ok then
			table.insert(
				kids,
				sc:New("Frame")({
					Name = spec.name,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
					LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
					[Children] = {
						sc:New("UIListLayout")({
							FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
							VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
							SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
							Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
						}),
						sc:New("TextLabel")({
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.new(0.34, 0, 0, 26),
							LayoutOrder = 1,
							TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
							TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
							FontFace = theme.Typography.Label.Font,
							TextSize = 12,
							TextColor3 = theme.Colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
							Text = spec.name,
						}),
						sc:New("Frame")({
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.new(0.66, -8, 0, 0),
							AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
							LayoutOrder = 2,
							[Children] = editor(sc, env, target, spec, value),
						}),
					} :: any,
				})
			)
		end
	end

	-- Attributes.
	local attributes = target:GetAttributes()
	if next(attributes) ~= nil then
		section("Attributes")
		local names: { string } = {}
		for key in attributes do
			table.insert(names, key)
		end
		table.sort(names)
		for _, key in names do
			table.insert(
				kids,
				C.Text(sc, {
					Theme = theme,
					Text = `{key} = {describe(attributes[key])}`,
					Variant = "Mono",
					LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
				})
			)
		end
	end

	-- Children: press one to select it.
	local count = #target:GetChildren()
	if count > 0 then
		section(`Children ({count})`)
		for index, child in target:GetChildren() do
			if index > 40 then
				table.insert(
					kids,
					C.Text(sc, {
						Theme = theme,
						Text = `… and {count - 40} more`,
						Variant = "Label",
						LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
					})
				)
				break
			end
			table.insert(
				kids,
				C.Button(sc, {
					Theme = theme,
					Text = `{child.Name}  ({child.ClassName})`,
					Variant = "Text",
					LayoutOrder = nextOrder(),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
					OnClick = function()
						env.select(child)
					end,
				})
			)
		end
	end

	return sc:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Details",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		[Children] = kids :: any,
	})
end

return Details

--!strict
--[[
	Which properties the details pane lists for an instance, and how each is edited.
]]
local Properties = {}

export type Spec = { name: string, readOnly: boolean? }

local function plain(...: string): { Spec }
	local list: { Spec } = {}
	for _, name in { ... } do
		table.insert(list, { name = name })
	end
	return list
end

local function readOnly(...: string): { Spec }
	local list: { Spec } = {}
	for _, name in { ... } do
		table.insert(list, { name = name, readOnly = true })
	end
	return list
end

local function join(...: { Spec }): { Spec }
	local out: { Spec } = {}
	for _, list in { ... } do
		for _, spec in list do
			table.insert(out, spec)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local GUI_OBJECT = plain(
	"Visible",
	"Active",
	"ZIndex",
	"LayoutOrder",
	"Position",
	"Size",
	"AnchorPoint",
	"Rotation",
	"AutomaticSize",
	"ClipsDescendants",
	"BackgroundColor3",
	"BackgroundTransparency",
	"BorderSizePixel"
)
local GUI_READ = readOnly("AbsolutePosition", "AbsoluteSize")

--- Properties by class, for the most specific class that matches first.
local BY_CLASS: { { class: string, specs: { Spec } } } = {
	{
		class = "TextLabel",
		specs = plain(
			"Text",
			"TextColor3",
			"TextTransparency",
			"TextSize",
			"TextXAlignment",
			"TextYAlignment",
			"TextWrapped",
			"RichText"
		),
	},
	{
		class = "TextButton",
		specs = plain(
			"Text",
			"TextColor3",
			"TextTransparency",
			"TextSize",
			"TextXAlignment",
			"AutoButtonColor"
		),
	},
	{
		class = "TextBox",
		specs = plain(
			"Text",
			"PlaceholderText",
			"TextColor3",
			"TextSize",
			"ClearTextOnFocus",
			"TextEditable"
		),
	},
	{
		class = "ImageLabel",
		specs = plain("Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "ScaleType"),
	},
	{
		class = "ImageButton",
		specs = plain("Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "ScaleType"),
	},
	{
		class = "ScrollingFrame",
		specs = join(
			plain("CanvasSize", "ScrollBarThickness", "AutomaticCanvasSize"),
			readOnly("CanvasPosition")
		),
	},
	{ class = "CanvasGroup", specs = plain("GroupTransparency", "GroupColor3") },
}

local MODIFIERS: { [string]: { Spec } } = {
	UICorner = plain("CornerRadius"),
	UIStroke = plain("Color", "Thickness", "Transparency", "ApplyStrokeMode", "Enabled"),
	UIPadding = plain("PaddingTop", "PaddingBottom", "PaddingLeft", "PaddingRight"),
	UIListLayout = plain(
		"FillDirection",
		"Padding",
		"SortOrder",
		"HorizontalAlignment",
		"VerticalAlignment",
		"Wraps"
	),
	UIGridLayout = plain("CellSize", "CellPadding", "FillDirection", "SortOrder"),
	UIGradient = plain("Rotation", "Offset", "Enabled"),
	UIScale = plain("Scale"),
	UIAspectRatioConstraint = plain("AspectRatio", "AspectType", "DominantAxis"),
	UISizeConstraint = plain("MinSize", "MaxSize"),
	UIFlexItem = plain("FlexMode", "GrowRatio", "ShrinkRatio"),
}

--- The properties to list for `instance`, in order.
function Properties.specsFor(instance: Instance): { Spec }
	if instance:IsA("GuiObject") then
		local specs = table.clone(GUI_OBJECT)
		for _, entry in BY_CLASS do
			if instance:IsA(entry.class) then
				for _, spec in entry.specs do
					table.insert(specs, spec)
				end
				break
			end
		end
		for _, spec in GUI_READ do
			table.insert(specs, spec)
		end
		return specs
	end
	for class, specs in MODIFIERS do
		if instance:IsA(class) then
			return specs
		end
	end
	return {}
end

return Properties

--!strict
--[[
	In-game dev tools, modelled on React DevTools: a docked panel with a Components tab (a tree
	of the live interface and an editable properties pane), a Profiler tab that counts changes,
	and Settings. Highlight Updates flashes whatever changes.
	See docs/Modules/DevTools.md.

		Pantheon.Flags.DevTools = true
		local unmount = Pantheon.DevTools.mount()   -- F8 opens and closes the panel
]]
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local Packages = script.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Types = require(script.Parent.Types)
local Flags = require(script.Parent.Internal.Flags)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)
local resolveTheme = require(script.Parent.Internal.resolveTheme).resolveTheme
local Details = require(script.Details)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

export type Props = {
	--- Where the overlay ScreenGui is parented (default: the local PlayerGui).
	Parent: Instance?,
	--- Opens and closes the panel (default F8).
	Hotkey: Enum.KeyCode?,
	--- Theme of the tools. The default is a dark theme of their own, so they look the same in any app.
	Theme: Types.ThemeRef?,
	--- Open at once (default false).
	Open: boolean?,
	--- Height of the panel in px (default 340).
	Height: number?,
}

-- What the profiler does not count: these change whenever the layout does.
local LAYOUT_PROPERTIES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	AbsolutePosition = true,
	AbsoluteSize = true,
	AbsoluteRotation = true,
	AbsoluteContentSize = true,
	AbsoluteCanvasSize = true,
	AbsoluteWindowSize = true,
	Parent = true,
}
local FLASH_TIME = 0.5
local MAX_FLASHES = 30
local PROFILE_ROWS = 20

local function mount(props: Props?): () -> ()
	local p: Props = props or {}
	if not Flags.DevTools then
		warn("[Pantheon.DevTools] Set Pantheon.Flags.DevTools = true before mounting.")
		return function() end
	end

	-- Required here, not at the top: the library requires this module while it loads.
	local Pantheon = require(script.Parent) :: any
	local C = Pantheon.Components
	local theme = if p.Theme then resolveTheme(p) else Pantheon.Theme.create("Dark")
	local colors = theme.Colors
	local scope = Pantheon.scoped()

	-- The tools read the local player's interface, and draw in `Parent`.
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local guiParent = p.Parent or playerGui
	local hotkey = p.Hotkey or Enum.KeyCode.F8

	-- state
	local open = scope:Value(p.Open == true)
	local inspecting = scope:Value(false)
	local highlight = scope:Value(false)
	local recording = scope:Value(false)
	local filter = scope:Value("")
	local picked = scope:Value({} :: { Instance })
	local selected = scope:Value(nil :: Instance?)
	local reveal = scope:Value(nil :: Instance?)
	local hoverFromTree = scope:Value(nil :: Instance?)
	local height = scope:Value(p.Height or 340)
	local profile = scope:Value({} :: { { instance: Instance, count: number, rate: number } })

	local gui = scope:New("ScreenGui")({
		Name = "PantheonDevTools",
		DisplayOrder = 2 ^ 20,
		IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	}) :: ScreenGui

	local function isOwn(instance: Instance): boolean
		return instance == gui or instance:IsDescendantOf(gui)
	end

	local function choose(instance: Instance?)
		selected:set(instance)
		picked:set(if instance then { instance } else {})
		if instance then
			reveal:set(nil)
			reveal:set(instance)
		end
	end
	table.insert(
		scope,
		scope:Observer(picked):onChange(function()
			local list = peek(picked) :: { Instance }
			selected:set(list[#list])
		end)
	)

	-- highlight boxes
	local function box(color: Color3, fill: number): Frame
		return scope:New("Frame")({
			Parent = gui,
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
			BackgroundTransparency = fill,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 5,
			[Children] = scope:New("UIStroke")({ Color = color, Thickness = 2 }),
		}) :: Frame
	end
	local hoverBox = box(Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255), 0.75)
	local selectBox = box(colors.Warning, 1)
	local tip = scope:New("TextLabel")({
		Parent = gui,
		ZIndex = 6,
		Visible = false,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 170, 255),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 20, 40),
		FontFace = theme.Fonts.Mono,
		TextSize = 12,
		Text = "",
		[Children] = scope:New("UIPadding")({
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6),
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 2),
		}),
	}) :: TextLabel

	local function outline(frame: Frame, target: GuiObject?)
		if target == nil or not target:IsDescendantOf(game) or isOwn(target) then
			frame.Visible = false
			return
		end
		frame.Visible = true
		frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(target.AbsolutePosition.X, target.AbsolutePosition.Y)
		frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(target.AbsoluteSize.X, target.AbsoluteSize.Y)
	end

	-- watching for changes (Highlight Updates and the profiler)
	local counts: { [Instance]: number } = {}
	local previous: { [Instance]: number } = {}
	local watchers: { [Instance]: RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	local flashes: { { frame: Frame, target: GuiObject, born: number } } = {}
	local pool: { Frame } = {}

	local function flash(target: GuiObject)
		if #flashes >= MAX_FLASHES or isOwn(target) then
			return
		end
		local frame = table.remove(pool) or box(colors.Warning, 1)
		frame.Visible = true
		table.insert(flashes, { frame = frame, target = target, born = os.clock() })
	end

	local function watch(instance: Instance)
		if watchers[instance] or isOwn(instance) or not instance:IsA("GuiObject") then
			return
		end
		watchers[instance] = (instance :: GuiObject).Changed:Connect(function(property: string)
			if LAYOUT_PROPERTIES[property] then
				return
			end
			counts[instance] = (counts[instance] or 0) + 1
			if peek(highlight) then
				flash(instance :: GuiObject)
			end
		end)
	end
	local descendantAdded: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local function setWatching(on: boolean)
		if on and descendantAdded == nil then
			for _, instance in playerGui:GetDescendants() do
				watch(instance)
			end
			descendantAdded = playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)
		elseif not on and descendantAdded then
			descendantAdded:Disconnect()
			descendantAdded = nil
			for instance, connection in watchers do
				connection:Disconnect()
				watchers[instance] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	local function refreshWatching()
		setWatching(peek(highlight) or peek(recording))
	end
	table.insert(scope, scope:Observer(highlight):onChange(refreshWatching))
	table.insert(scope, scope:Observer(recording):onChange(refreshWatching))
	table.insert(scope, function()
		setWatching(false)
	end)

	-- the Components tab
	local env = { theme = theme, C = C, select = choose }

	local emptyDetails = C.Text(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Text = "Select an element, or press the pointer button and click one.",
		Variant = "Body",
		Color = colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
		TextWrapped = true,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0),
	})
	local detailsHost = scope:Frame({
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		[Children] = scope:Computed(function(use, inner: any)
			local target = use(selected) :: Instance?
			if target == nil or not target:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				return scope:Frame({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60),
					Padding = { 10 },
					[Children] = emptyDetails,
				})
			end
			return Details.build(inner, env, target)
		end),
	})

	local tree = C.Explorer(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Roots = { playerGui },
		Filter = filter,
		Selected = picked,
		Reveal = reveal,
		Include = function(instance: Instance): boolean
			return not isOwn(instance)
		end,
		OnHover = function(instance: Instance?)
			hoverFromTree:set(instance)
		end,
	})
	local left = scope:Frame({
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Frame({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
				Padding = { 6 },
				[Children] = C.TextField(scope, {
					Theme = theme,
					Compact = true,
					Placeholder = "Search by name",
					LeadingIcon = "search",
					Text = filter,
				}),
			}),
			scope:Frame({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 44),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -44),
				[Children] = tree,
			}),
		},
	})
	local right = C.ScrollArea(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Children = { detailsHost },
		ContentPadding = 0,
	})
	local componentsTab = C.SplitPane(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Panes = { left, right },
		Ratios = { 5, 4 },
	})

	-- the Profiler tab
	local profilerRows = scope:Computed(function(use, inner: any)
		local list = use(profile) :: { { instance: Instance, count: number, rate: number } }
		local rows: { any } = {
			inner:New("UIListLayout")({ SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		}
		if #list == 0 then
			table.insert(
				rows,
				C.Text(inner, {
					Theme = theme,
					Text = if peek(recording)
						then "Nothing has changed yet."
						else "Press Record, then use the interface.",
					Variant = "Body",
					Color = colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
					LayoutOrder = 1,
				})
			)
		end
		for index, entry in list do
			table.insert(
				rows,
				C.Button(inner, {
					Theme = theme,
					Variant = "Text",
					LayoutOrder = index,
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
					Text = string.format(
						"%-34s %6d  %5.1f/s",
						string.sub(entry.instance.Name, 1, 34),
						entry.count,
						entry.rate
					),
					OnClick = function()
						choose(entry.instance)
					end,
				})
			)
		end
		return inner:Frame({
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			[Children] = rows :: any,
		})
	end)
	local profilerTab = scope:Frame({
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		[Children] = {
			scope:Frame({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44),
				Padding = { 6 },
				Layout = {
					Kind = "List",
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					Padding = 8,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
				},
				[Children] = {
					C.Switch(scope, {
						Theme = theme,
						Label = "Record",
						Checked = recording,
						LayoutOrder = 1,
					}),
					C.Button(scope, {
						Theme = theme,
						Text = "Clear",
						Variant = "Tonal",
						LayoutOrder = 2,
						OnClick = function()
							table.clear(counts)
							table.clear(previous)
							profile:set({})
						end,
					}),
				},
			}),
			scope:Frame({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 44),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -44),
				[Children] = C.ScrollArea(scope, {
					Theme = theme,
					Children = { profilerRows },
					ContentPadding = 8,
				}),
			}),
		},
	})

	-- the Settings tab
	local settingKids: { any } = {}
	for index, setting in
		{
			{ "CanvasFade", "Fade chrome with a CanvasGroup (Flags.CanvasFade)" },
			{ "LifetimeChecks", "Fusion lifetime checks (slow, Flags.LifetimeChecks)" },
			{ "BetaUI", "Use Studio-beta UI features (Flags.BetaUI)" },
		}
	do
		local state = scope:Value((Flags :: any)[setting[1]] == true)
		table.insert(
			settingKids,
			C.Switch(scope, {
				Theme = theme,
				Label = setting[2],
				Checked = state,
				LayoutOrder = index,
				OnChanged = function(on: boolean)
					(Flags :: any)[setting[1]] = on
				end,
			})
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		settingKids,
		C.Text(scope, {
			Theme = theme,
			Text = "Flags apply to what is built after you change them. Rebuild the interface to see the effect.",
			Variant = "Label",
			Color = colors.OnSurfaceVariant,
			TextWrapped = true,
			LayoutOrder = 10,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		})
	)
	local settingsTab = C.ScrollArea(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Children = settingKids,
		ListPadding = 10,
	})

	-- the panel
	local tipLayer = scope:Frame({
		Name = "TipLayer",
		Parent = gui,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		ZIndex = 50,
	})
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(open) then 1 else 0
		end),
		22,
		1
	)

	local actions = C.Toolbar(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Layer = tipLayer,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 28),
		Items = {
			{
				Id = "inspect",
				Icon = "mouse-pointer",
				Tooltip = "Select an element in the page to inspect it",
				Toggle = true,
				Toggled = inspecting,
			},
			{
				Id = "highlight",
				Icon = "zap",
				Tooltip = "Highlight updates",
				Toggle = true,
				Toggled = highlight,
			},
		},
	})
	local panelHeight = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return use(height)
	end)
	local dock = C.DockPanel(scope, {
		Theme = theme,
		Tabs = {
			{ Id = "components", Title = "Components", Content = componentsTab },
			{ Id = "profiler", Title = "Profiler", Content = profilerTab },
			{ Id = "settings", Title = "Settings", Content = settingsTab },
		},
		Actions = { actions },
		OnClose = function()
			open:set(false)
		end,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -6),
	})
	local handle = scope:New("TextButton")({
		Name = "Resize",
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = colors.Outline,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6),
	}) :: TextButton
	table.insert(
		scope,
		handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				return
			end
			local startY = input.Position.Y
			local startHeight = peek(height) :: number
			ScrollInput.capture(handle, function(changed: InputObject)
				return changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			end, function(ended: InputObject)
				return ended.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			end, function(position: Vector3)
				local limit = (
					workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y or 800
				) * 0.85
				height:set(math.clamp(startHeight - (position.Y - startY), 160, limit))
			end, function() end)
		end)
	)
	scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Panel",
		Parent = gui,
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
		Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.new(
				0,
				0,
				1,
				(1 - math.clamp(use(openS) :: number, 0, 1)) * (use(height) :: number)
			)
		end),
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, use(panelHeight) :: number)
		end),
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return (use(openS) :: number) > 0.01
		end),
		BackgroundColor3 = colors.Surface,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 10,
		[Children] = {
			handle,
			scope:Frame({
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -6),
				[Children] = dock,
			}),
		} :: any,
	})

	-- every frame
	local lastProfile = 0
	local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	local function pick(): GuiObject?
		local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		for _, object in playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(mouse.X, mouse.Y) do
			if not isOwn(object) then
				return object
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	table.insert(
		connections,
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local hovered: GuiObject? = nil
			if peek(inspecting) then
				hovered = pick()
			else
				local fromTree = peek(hoverFromTree)
				hovered = if fromTree and fromTree:IsA("GuiObject") then fromTree else nil
			end
			outline(hoverBox, hovered)
			local current = peek(selected)
			outline(selectBox, if current and current:IsA("GuiObject") then current else nil)
			if hovered then
				local size = hovered.AbsoluteSize
				tip.Text = `{hovered.Name}  {math.round(size.X)} × {math.round(size.Y)}`
				tip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
					hovered.AbsolutePosition.X,
					math.max(hovered.AbsolutePosition.Y - 20, 0)
				)
				tip.Visible = true
			else
				tip.Visible = false
			end

			-- Flashes fade out.
			local now = os.clock()
			for index = #flashes, 1, -1 do
				local entry = flashes[index]
				local age = (now - entry.born) / FLASH_TIME
				if age >= 1 or not entry.target:IsDescendantOf(game) then
					entry.frame.Visible = false
					table.insert(pool, entry.frame)
					table.remove(flashes, index)
				else
					entry.frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
						entry.target.AbsolutePosition.X,
						entry.target.AbsolutePosition.Y
					)
					entry.frame.Size =
						UDim2.fromOffset(entry.target.AbsoluteSize.X, entry.target.AbsoluteSize.Y)
					entry.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 + 0.4 * age
					local stroke = entry.frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
					if stroke then
						stroke.Transparency = age
					end
				end
			end

			-- The profiler list, twice a second.
			if peek(recording) and now - lastProfile >= 0.5 then
				local elapsed = now - lastProfile
				lastProfile = now
				local rows: { { instance: Instance, count: number, rate: number } } = {}
				for instance, count in counts do
					if instance:IsDescendantOf(game) then
						table.insert(rows, {
							instance = instance,
							count = count,
							rate = (count - (previous[instance] or 0)) / math.max(elapsed, 0.01),
						})
					end
					previous[instance] = count
				end
				table.sort(rows, function(a, b)
					if a.rate ~= b.rate then
						return a.rate > b.rate
					end
					return a.count > b.count
				end)
				while #rows > PROFILE_ROWS do
					table.remove(rows)
				end
				profile:set(rows)
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		connections,
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
			if input.KeyCode == hotkey and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
				open:set(not peek(open))
				if not peek(open) then
					inspecting:set(false)
				end
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and peek(inspecting) then
				inspecting:set(false)
			elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and peek(inspecting) then
				local target = pick()
				if target then
					choose(target)
					inspecting:set(false)
				end
			end
		end)
	)

	gui.Parent = guiParent

	return function()
		for _, connection in connections do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		Fusion.doCleanup(scope)
	end
end

return { mount = mount }

--!strict
--[[
	Feeds a Hotbar from the player's Roblox Backpack. See docs/Game/Backpack.md.
]]
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Backpack = {}

export type Options = {
	Player: Player?,
	Capacity: number?,
}

function Backpack.new(scope: any, options: Options?)
	local opts: Options = options or {}
	local player = opts.Player or Players.LocalPlayer
	local capacity = opts.Capacity or 30

	local items = scope:Value({} :: { [number]: any })
	local selected = scope:Value(nil :: number?)
	local toolAt: { [number]: Tool } = {}
	local slotOf: { [Tool]: number } = {}
	local watching: { [Tool]: { RBXScriptConnection } } = {}
	local backpack: Instance? = nil

	local function describe(tool: Tool)
		return {
			Id = tool.Name,
			Name = tool.Name,
			Description = if tool.ToolTip ~= "" then tool.ToolTip else nil,
			Image = if tool.TextureId ~= "" then tool.TextureId else nil,
			Tool = tool,
		}
	end

	local function publish()
		local list: { [number]: any } = {}
		for slot, tool in toolAt do
			list[slot] = describe(tool)
		end
		items:set(list)
	end

	local function equipped(): Tool?
		local character = player.Character
		return if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") else nil
	end

	local function syncSelected()
		local tool = equipped()
		selected:set(if tool then slotOf[tool] else nil)
	end

	local function add(tool: Tool)
		if slotOf[tool] then
			return
		end
		for slot = 1, capacity do
			if not toolAt[slot] then
				toolAt[slot] = tool
				slotOf[tool] = slot
				break
			end
		end
		local connections = {}
		for _, property in { "Name", "ToolTip", "TextureId" } do
			table.insert(connections, tool:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(publish))
		end
		watching[tool] = connections
		publish()
		syncSelected()
	end

	local function remove(tool: Tool)
		local slot = slotOf[tool]
		if slot == nil then
			return
		end
		toolAt[slot] = nil
		slotOf[tool] = nil
		local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = watching[tool] or {}
		for _, connection in connections do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		watching[tool] = nil
		publish()
		syncSelected()
	end

	--- A Tool moves between the Backpack and the character when equipped or unequipped. Only
	--- forget it once it is in neither.
	local function watch(container: Instance)
		for _, child in container:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				add(child)
			end
		end
		table.insert(
			scope,
			container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("Tool") then
					add(child)
					syncSelected()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			scope,
			container.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
				if not child:IsA("Tool") then
					return
				end
				task.defer(function()
					local character = player.Character
					if
						child.Parent ~= backpack and (character == nil or child.Parent ~= character)
					then
						remove(child :: Tool)
					end
					syncSelected()
				end)
			end)
		)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")
		watch(backpack :: Instance)
	end)
