	if player.Character then
		watch(player.Character)
	end
	table.insert(
		scope,
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			watch(character)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(scope, function()
		for _, connections in watching do
			for _, connection in connections do
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end
	end)

	local function onSelect(slot: number?)
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if humanoid == nil then
			return
		end
		local tool = if slot then toolAt[slot] else nil
		if tool then
			humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
		else
			humanoid:UnequipTools()
		end
	end

	local function onMove(from: number, to: number)
		local a, b = toolAt[from], toolAt[to]
		toolAt[from], toolAt[to] = b, a
		if a then
			slotOf[a] = to
		end
		if b then
			slotOf[b] = from
		end
		publish()
		syncSelected()
	end

	return {
		Items = items,
		Selected = selected,
		OnSelect = onSelect,
		OnMove = onMove,
	}
end

return Backpack

--!strict
--[[
	Fuzzy matching for the Hotbar search. See docs/Game/Hotbar.md.
]]

export type Scopes = { [string]: (item: any) -> (string | { string })? }

local Fuzzy = {}

local function isBoundary(char: string): boolean
	return string.match(char, "[%w]") == nil
end

--- 0..1 for how well `query` matches `text` as a subsequence, or nil when it doesn't.
function Fuzzy.score(query: string, text: string): number?
	query, text = string.lower(query), string.lower(text)
	if query == "" then
		return 1
	end
	local qi, last, total = 1, -2, 0
	for ti = 1, #text do
		if string.sub(text, ti, ti) == string.sub(query, qi, qi) then
			local bonus = 1
			if ti == last + 1 then
				bonus += 2
			end
			if ti == 1 or isBoundary(string.sub(text, ti - 1, ti - 1)) then
				bonus += 2
			end
			total += bonus
			last = ti
			qi += 1
			if qi > #query then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if qi <= #query then
		return nil
	end
	local score = total / (#query * 5)
	local at = string.find(text, query, 1, true)
	if at then
		score += if at == 1 then 1 else 0.5
	end
	return math.clamp(score / 1.5, 0, 1)
end

--- Everything searchable about an item, grouped by scope name (lower case).
local function identifiers(item: any, scopes: Scopes?): { [string]: { string } }
	local found: { [string]: { string } } = {}
	local function add(scope: string, value: any)
		if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
			found[scope] = found[scope] or {}
			table.insert(found[scope], value)
		elseif type(value) == "table" then
			for _, entry in value do
				if type(entry) == "string" then
					add(scope, entry)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	add("name", item.Name)
	add("description", item.Description)
	add("id", item.Id)
	add("tags", item.Tags)
	for key, value in item do
		local lower = string.lower(tostring(key))
		if
			type(value) == "string"
			and found[lower] == nil
			and lower ~= "image"
			and lower ~= "name"
			and lower ~= "description"
			and lower ~= "id"
		then
			add(lower, value)
		end
	end
	if scopes then
		for scope, extract in scopes do
			found[string.lower(scope)] = nil
			add(string.lower(scope), extract(item))
		end
	end
	return found
end

--- Best score of `query` against `item`, or nil if any word of it fails to match.
function Fuzzy.matchItem(query: string, item: any, scopes: Scopes?): number?
	local words: { string } = {}
	for word in string.gmatch(query, "%S+") do
		table.insert(words, word)
	end
	if #words == 0 then
		return 1
	end
	local known = identifiers(item, scopes)
	local total = 0
	for _, word in words do
		local scope, text = string.match(word, "^(%w+):(.*)$")
		local pool: { string } = {}
		if scope and known[string.lower(scope)] then
			pool = known[string.lower(scope)]
		else
			text = word
			for _, list in known do
				for _, value in list do
					table.insert(pool, value)
				end
			end
		end
		local best: number? = nil
		for _, value in pool do
			local score = Fuzzy.score(text :: string, value)
			if score and (best == nil or score > best) then
				best = score
			end
		end
		if best == nil then
			return nil
		end
		total += best
	end
	return total / #words
end

return Fuzzy

--!strict
--[[
	Inventory bar with an expandable, searchable grid. See docs/Game/Hotbar.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Style = require(script.Parent.Style)
local Fuzzy = require(script.Parent.Fuzzy)
local GroupFade = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.GroupFade)
local ScrollInput = require(script.Parent.Parent.Internal.ScrollInput)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Parent.Theme)
local TextField = require(script.Parent.Parent.Components.TextField)
local VirtualList = require(script.Parent.Parent.Components.VirtualList)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

export type HotbarItem = {
	Name: string?,
	Description: string?,
	Image: string?,
	Count: number?,
	Cooldown: any?, -- number | State<number>
	Tags: { string }?,
	Id: string?,
	[string]: any,
}

export type HotbarProps = {
	Items: any?,
	Selected: any?,
	Expanded: any?,
	Slots: number?,
	Capacity: number?,
	Columns: number?,
	ExpandedRows: number?,
	SlotSize: number?,
	BindKeys: boolean?,
	DisableDefault: boolean?,
	SearchScopes: Fuzzy.Scopes?,
	OnSelect: ((slot: number?) -> ())?,
	OnMove: ((from: number, to: number) -> ())?,
	Position: UDim2?,
	AnchorPoint: Vector2?,
	LayoutOrder: number?,
}

local KEYS = {
	Enum.KeyCode.One,
	Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	Enum.KeyCode.Three,
	Enum.KeyCode.Four,
	Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	Enum.KeyCode.Six,
	Enum.KeyCode.Seven,
	Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	Enum.KeyCode.Nine,
	Enum.KeyCode.Zero,
}

local DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6 -- px before a press becomes a drag
local PANEL_PAD = 14
local SEARCH_HEIGHT = 40
local PANEL_GAP = 12
-- A slot arriving or leaving animates as one unit (slide, scale, fade) on a bouncy spring.
-- Its width in the layout uses a separate spring without bounce. It opens immediately and
-- closes only after the exit animation, so neighbouring slots don't overlap.
local SHOW_SPEED = 20
local SHOW_DAMPING = 0.55
local WIDTH_SPEED = 18
local EXIT_DELAY = 0.3
local ROW_PAD = 8 -- room above and below a grid row for the hover scale

local darkTheme = Theme.create("Dark")

local function isPointer(input: InputObject): boolean
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

return function(scope: any, props: HotbarProps): Instance
	local slots = math.clamp(props.Slots or 9, 1, #KEYS)
	local capacity = math.max(props.Capacity or slots * 3, slots)
	local columns = props.Columns or slots
	local maxRows = props.ExpandedRows or 4
	local size = props.SlotSize or 56
	local gap = 6

	local selected = if typeof(props.Selected) == "table" then props.Selected else scope:Value(nil)
	local expanded = if typeof(props.Expanded) == "table"
		then props.Expanded
		else scope:Value(false)
	local dragFrom = scope:Value(nil :: number?)
	local query = scope:Value("")

	if props.DisableDefault ~= false then
		pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)
		table.insert(scope, function()
			pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, true)
		end)
	end

	local function itemAt(use: any, index: number): HotbarItem?
		local items = use(props.Items)
		return if items then items[index] else nil
	end

	-- Actions
	local function choose(slot: number)
		if itemAt(peek, slot) == nil then
			return
		end
		local next: number? = if peek(selected) == slot then nil else slot
		selected:set(next)
		if props.OnSelect then
			props.OnSelect(next)
		end
	end

	local function move(from: number, to: number)
		if from == to then
			return
		end
		if props.OnMove then
			-- OnMove owns the inventory, including which slot stays equipped.
			props.OnMove(from, to)
			return
		end
		if typeof(props.Items) ~= "table" or not (props.Items :: any).set then
			return
		end
		local list = table.clone(peek(props.Items))
		list[from], list[to] = list[to], list[from]
		props.Items:set(list)
		-- The equipped item travels with the move.
		local current = peek(selected)
		if current == from then
			selected:set(to)
		elseif current == to then
			selected:set(from)
		end
	end

	if props.BindKeys ~= false then
		table.insert(
			scope,
			UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
				if processed then
					return
				end
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backquote then
					expanded:set(not peek(expanded))
					return
				end
				local index = table.find(KEYS, input.KeyCode)
				if index and index <= slots then
					choose(index)
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	-- Drag support
	type Cell = { gui: GuiObject, index: any }
	local cells: { Cell } = {}
	local root: Frame

	--- Copy of the item (icon or letters) that follows the pointer while dragging.
	local function makeGhost(item: HotbarItem, at: Vector3): Frame
		local ghost = scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = "DragGhost",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
			BackgroundColor3 = Style.Panel,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ZIndex = 100,
			[Children] = {
				scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Style.Radius) }),
				scope:New("UIScale")({ Scale = 1.12 }),
				scope:New("UIStroke")({
					Color = Style.Edge,
					Transparency = 0.5,
					ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
				}),
				-- Held items cast a bigger shadow than an equipped one.
				scope:New("UIShadow")({
					Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					Transparency = 0.35,
					BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 20),
					Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 8),
				}),
				if item.Image
					then scope:New("ImageLabel")({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7),
						Image = item.Image,
						ZIndex = 101,
					})
					else scope:New("TextLabel")({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						FontFace = Style.FontBold,
						TextSize = math.floor(size * 0.36),
						TextColor3 = Style.Text,
						Text = string.upper(string.sub(item.Name or "", 1, 2)),
						ZIndex = 101,
					}),
			},
		}) :: Frame
		local collector = root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
		if collector then
			ghost.Parent = collector
			local origin = (collector :: any).AbsolutePosition :: Vector2
			ghost.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(at.X - origin.X, at.Y - origin.Y)
		end
		return ghost
	end

	local function slotAt(point: Vector3): number?
		for _, cell in cells do
			local index = peek(cell.index) :: number?
			local topLeft, extent = cell.gui.AbsolutePosition, cell.gui.AbsoluteSize
			if
				index
				and cell.gui.Visible
				and point.X >= topLeft.X
				and point.X <= topLeft.X + math.max(extent.X, size)
				and point.Y >= topLeft.Y
				and point.Y <= topLeft.Y + extent.Y
			then
				return index
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- One slot
	--- `indexArg` is a fixed slot number (the bar) or a State of one (grid cells, whose slot
	--- changes as the search reorders them).
	local function slotFrame(sc: any, indexArg: any, inBar: boolean): Instance
		local idx = if typeof(indexArg) == "number" then sc:Value(indexArg) else indexArg
		local item = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local index = use(idx)
			return if index then itemAt(use, index) else nil
		end)
		-- Keep the last item so its icon is still drawn while the slot animates out.
		local display = sc:Value(peek(item))
		table.insert(
			sc,
			sc:Observer(item):onChange(function()
				local current = peek(item)
				if current then
					display:set(current)
				end
			end)
		)
		local has = sc:Computed(function(use)
			return use(item) ~= nil
		end)
		local hovered = sc:Value(false)
		-- The name tip and the equipped shadow are created on first use, not for every slot.
		local tipWanted = sc:Value(false)
		local shadowWanted = sc:Value(false)
		local isSelected = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local index = use(idx)
			return index ~= nil and use(selected) == index
		end)
		local dragActive = sc:Computed(function(use)
			return use(dragFrom) ~= nil
		end)
		local isSource = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local index = use(idx)
			return index ~= nil and use(dragFrom) == index
		end)

		-- A slot is shown when it has an item, when it is empty during a drag (a drop target), or
		-- when the bar is expanded. Other slots are hidden and the bar closes up around them.
		local shown = sc:Computed(function(use)
			if use(idx) == nil then
				return false
			end
			return use(has) or use(dragActive) or (inBar and use(expanded))
		end)
		-- Arrival: slides up from below, small and transparent. Departure: keeps sliding up,
		-- shrinks and fades. `slide` is +1 below the slot, 0 in place and -1 above it.
		local show = sc:Spring(
			sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(shown) then 1 else 0
			end),
			SHOW_SPEED,
			SHOW_DAMPING
		)
		local slideGoal = sc:Value(if peek(shown) then 0 else -1)
		local slide = sc:Spring(slideGoal, SHOW_SPEED, SHOW_DAMPING)
		local widthGoal = sc:Value(if peek(shown) then 1 else 0)
		local width = sc:Spring(widthGoal, WIDTH_SPEED, 1)
		local ticket = 0
		table.insert(
			sc,
			sc:Observer(shown):onChange(function()
				ticket += 1
				local mine = ticket
				if peek(shown) then
					(slide :: any):setPosition(1)
					slideGoal:set(0)
					widthGoal:set(1)
				else
					slideGoal:set(-1)
					task.delay(EXIT_DELAY, function()
						if mine == ticket then
							widthGoal:set(0)
						end
					end)
				end
			end)
		)
		-- An item dropped into a slot that is already open just fades in.
		local itemIn = sc:Spring(
			sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(has) then 1 else 0
			end),
			26,
			1
		)
		local fade = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local visible = math.clamp(math.min(use(show) :: number, use(itemIn) :: number), 0, 1)
			local dimmed = if use(isSource) then 0.6 else 0
			return math.max(1 - visible, dimmed)
		end)

		local lift = sc:Spring(
			sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(hovered) and not use(dragActive) then 1 else 0
			end),
			34,
			0.7
		)
		local equip = sc:Spring(
			sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(isSelected) and use(has) then 1 else 0
			end),
			28,
			0.8
		)
		local tipIn = sc:Spring(
			sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(hovered) and not use(dragActive) and use(has) then 1 else 0
			end),
			36,
			1
		)
		local cooldown = sc:Computed(function(use)
			local current = use(item) :: HotbarItem?
			if current == nil or current.Cooldown == nil then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp(use(current.Cooldown) :: number, 0, 1)
		end)

		table.insert(
			sc,
			sc:Observer(isSelected):onBind(function()
				if peek(isSelected) then
					shadowWanted:set(true)
				end
			end)
		)

		local ink = sc:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(equip) > 0.5 then Style.OnEquipped else Style.Text
		end)

		local button = sc:New("TextButton")({
			Name = "Slot",
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (use(slide) :: number) * size * 0.6)
			end),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			BackgroundColor3 = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return Style.Panel:Lerp(Style.Equipped, math.clamp(use(equip) :: number, 0, 1))
			end),
			BackgroundTransparency = sc:Computed(function(use)
				local base = Style.PanelTransparency - 0.12 * use(lift)
				local filled = base * (1 - math.clamp(use(equip) :: number, 0, 1))
					+ 0.04 * use(equip)
				-- Fade in with the slot.
				return 1 - (1 - filled) * math.clamp(use(show) :: number, 0, 1)
			end),
			[OnEvent("MouseEnter")] = function()
				hovered:set(true)
				tipWanted:set(true)
			end,
			[OnEvent("MouseLeave")] = function()
				hovered:set(false)
			end,
			[Children] = (
					{
						sc:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Style.Radius) }),
						sc:New("UIScale")({
							Scale = sc:Computed(function(use)
								local present = math.clamp(use(show) :: number, 0, 1.08)
								return (0.6 + 0.4 * present)
									* (1 + 0.1 * use(lift) + 0.04 * use(equip))
							end),
						}),
						sc:New("UIStroke")({
							Color = Style.Edge,
							Thickness = 1,
							Transparency = sc:Computed(function(use)
								local lit = math.clamp(use(equip) :: number, 0, 1)
								local edge = Style.EdgeTransparency
									+ (1 - Style.EdgeTransparency) * lit
								return 1 - (1 - edge) * math.clamp(use(show) :: number, 0, 1)
							end),
							ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
						}),
						-- Shadow for the equipped slot.
						sc:Computed(function(get: any, inner: any)
							if not get(shadowWanted) then
								return nil
							end
							return inner:New("UIShadow")({
								Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
								Transparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
									return 1 - 0.5 * math.clamp(use(equip) :: number, 0, 1)
								end),
								BlurRadius = UDim.new(0, 10),
								Offset = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
							})
						end),
						-- Item contents.
						sc:New("Frame")({
							Name = "Contents",
							BackgroundTransparency = 1,
							Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
							[Children] = {
								sc:New("ImageLabel")({
									Name = "Icon",
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
									Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
									Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.7),
									ImageTransparency = fade,
									Image = sc:Computed(function(use)
										local current = use(display)
										return if current then current.Image or "" else ""
									end),
									ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
								}),
								sc:New("TextLabel")({
									Name = "Glyph",
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
									FontFace = Style.FontBold,
									TextSize = math.floor(size * 0.36),
									TextColor3 = ink,
									TextTransparency = fade,
									Text = sc:Computed(function(use)
										local current = use(display)
										if current == nil or current.Image then
											return ""
										end
										return string.upper(string.sub(current.Name or "", 1, 2))
									end),
								}),
								sc:New("TextLabel")({
									Name = "Count",
									BackgroundTransparency = 1,
									AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
									Position = UDim2.new(1, -5, 1, -3),
									Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 14),
									TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
									FontFace = Style.FontBold,
									TextSize = 13,
									TextColor3 = ink,
									TextTransparency = fade,
									Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
										local current = use(display)
										return current ~= nil
											and current.Count ~= nil
											and current.Count > 1
									end),
									Text = sc:Computed(function(use)
										local current = use(display)
										return if current and current.Count
											then tostring(current.Count)
											else ""
									end),
								}),
							},
						}),
						-- Cooldown overlay; its height is the remaining fraction.
						sc:New("Frame")({
							Name = "Cooldown",
							AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
							Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
							Size = sc:Computed(function(use)
								return UDim2.fromScale(1, use(cooldown))
							end),
							BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
							BorderSizePixel = 0,
							Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
								return use(cooldown) > 0
							end),
							[Children] = {
								sc:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, Style.Radius) }),
							},
						}),
						if inBar
							then sc:New("TextLabel")({
								Name = "Key",
								BackgroundTransparency = 1,
								Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 3),
								Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
								TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
								FontFace = Style.FontBold,
								TextSize = 12,
								TextColor3 = sc:Computed(function(use)
									return if use(equip) > 0.5
										then Style.OnEquipped
										else Style.TextDim
								end),
								Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
									return use(has) or use(expanded)
								end),
								Text = tostring(peek(idx) % 10),
							})
							else nil,
						-- Name tip above the slot.
						sc:Computed(function(get: any, inner: any)
							if not get(tipWanted) then
								return nil
							end
							return inner:New("Frame")({
								Name = "Tip",
								AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
								Position = inner:Computed(function(use)
									return UDim2.new(
										0.5,
										0,
										0,
										-6 - 4 * (1 - math.clamp(use(tipIn) :: number, 0, 1))
									)
								end),
								AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
								BackgroundColor3 = Style.Panel,
								BackgroundTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
									return 1 - 0.9 * math.clamp(use(tipIn) :: number, 0, 1)
								end),
								BorderSizePixel = 0,
								ZIndex = 20,
								Visible = inner:Computed(function(use)
									return (use(tipIn) :: number) > 0.02
								end),
								[Children] = {
									inner:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) }),
									inner:New("UIPadding")({
										PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5),
										PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 5),
										PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9),
										PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 9),
									}),
									inner:New("UIListLayout")({
										SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
									}),
									inner:New("TextLabel")({
										BackgroundTransparency = 1,
										AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
										LayoutOrder = 1,
										FontFace = Style.FontBold,
										TextSize = 13,
										TextColor3 = Style.Text,
										TextTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
											return 1 - math.clamp(use(tipIn) :: number, 0, 1)
										end),
										Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
											local current = use(display)
											return if current then current.Name or "" else ""
										end),
									}),
									inner:New("TextLabel")({
										BackgroundTransparency = 1,
										AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
										LayoutOrder = 2,
										FontFace = Style.Font,
										TextSize = 12,
										TextColor3 = Style.TextDim,
										TextTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
											return 1 - math.clamp(use(tipIn) :: number, 0, 1)
										end),
										Visible = inner:Computed(function(use)
											local current = use(display)
											return current ~= nil and current.Description ~= nil
										end),
										Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
											local current = use(display)
											return if current then current.Description or "" else ""
										end),
									}),
								},
							})
						end),
					} :: any
				) :: any,
		}) :: TextButton

		-- A click equips. Moving past the threshold starts a drag.
		table.insert(
			sc,
			button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
				local index = peek(idx) :: number?
				if not isPointer(input) or index == nil or peek(item) == nil then
					return
				end
				local start = input.Position
				local last = start
				local ghost: Frame? = nil
				ScrollInput.capture(
					button,
					function(changed: InputObject)
						return changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
							or changed.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
					end,
					isPointer,
					function(position: Vector3)
						last = position
						if ghost == nil and (position - start).Magnitude > DRAG_THRESHOLD then
							local picked = peek(item)
							if picked then
								dragFrom:set(index)
								hovered:set(false)
								ghost = makeGhost(picked, position)
							end
						end
						if ghost then
							local collector = root:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
							if collector then
								local origin = (collector :: any).AbsolutePosition :: Vector2
								ghost.Position =
									UDim2.fromOffset(position.X - origin.X, position.Y - origin.Y)
							end
						end
					end,
					function()
						if ghost then
							ghost:Destroy()
							dragFrom:set(nil)
							local target = slotAt(last)
							if target then
								move(index, target)
							end
						elseif (last - start).Magnitude <= DRAG_THRESHOLD then
							choose(index)
						end
					end
				)
			end)
		)

		local cell = sc:New("Frame")({
			Name = "Slot",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = if inBar then peek(idx) else 0,
			Size = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return UDim2.fromOffset(size * math.max(use(width) :: number, 0), size)
			end),
			Visible = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return (use(width) :: number) > 0.01 or (use(show) :: number) > 0.01
			end),
			ZIndex = sc:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(hovered) or use(isSource) then 6 else 1
			end),
			[Children] = { button },
		}) :: Frame
		local entry: Cell = { gui = cell, index = idx }
		table.insert(cells, entry)
		table.insert(sc, function()
			local at = table.find(cells, entry)
			if at then
				table.remove(cells, at)
			end
		end)
		return cell
	end

	-- The bar
	local rowChildren: { any } = {
		scope:New("UIListLayout")({
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, gap),
		}),
	}
	for index = 1, slots do
		table.insert(rowChildren, slotFrame(scope, index, true))
	end

	-- The grid: which slots it lists, in what order
	-- Slots the grid lists. Normally every filled slot outside the bar, in order. While searching,
	-- the matches by score. While dragging, all of them, so items can be dropped on empty slots.
	local gridSlots = scope:Computed(function(use)
		local text = use(query) :: string
		local dragging = use(dragFrom) ~= nil
		local found: { { index: number, score: number } } = {}
		for index = slots + 1, capacity do
			local current = itemAt(use, index)
			if dragging then
				table.insert(found, { index = index, score = 1 })
			elseif current then
				local score = if text == ""
					then 1
					else Fuzzy.matchItem(text, current, props.SearchScopes)
				if score then
					table.insert(found, { index = index, score = score })
				end
			end
		end
		if text ~= "" and not dragging then
			table.sort(found, function(a, b)
				if a.score ~= b.score then
					return a.score > b.score
				end
				return a.index < b.index
			end)
		end
		local list: { number } = {}
		for _, entry in found do
			table.insert(list, entry.index)
		end
		return list
	end)
	local rowCount = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return math.ceil(#use(gridSlots) / columns)
	end)

	local rowHeight = size + 2 * ROW_PAD
	local gridWidth = columns * (size + gap) - gap
	local gridViewHeight = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return math.clamp(use(rowCount) :: number, 1, maxRows) * rowHeight
	end)
	local panelWidth = gridWidth + 2 * PANEL_PAD + 16
	local panelHeight = scope:Computed(function(use)
		return 2 * PANEL_PAD + SEARCH_HEIGHT + PANEL_GAP + (use(gridViewHeight) :: number)
	end)

	local reveal = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			return if use(expanded) then 1 else 0
		end),
		26,
		0.7
	)

	local search = TextField(scope, {
		Theme = darkTheme,
		Placeholder = "Search",
		LeadingIcon = "search",
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		OnChanged = function(text: string)
			query:set(text)
		end,
	})

	local grid = VirtualList(scope, {
		Theme = darkTheme,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, use(gridViewHeight))
		end),
		ItemCount = rowCount,
		ItemHeight = rowHeight,
		RenderItem = function(sc: any, row: number)
			local kids: { any } = {
				sc:New("UIListLayout")({
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
					Padding = UDim.new(0, gap),
				}),
			}
			for column = 1, columns do
				local position = (row - 1) * columns + column
				local slotState = sc:Computed(function(use)
					return use(gridSlots)[position]
				end)
				local cell = slotFrame(sc, slotState, false) :: Frame
				cell.LayoutOrder = column
				table.insert(kids, cell)
			end
			return sc:New("Frame")({ BackgroundTransparency = 1, [Children] = kids })
		end,
	})

	-- Inventory panel. Scales up, slides up and fades in from its bottom edge.
	local panel = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Panel",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, (1 - math.clamp(use(reveal) :: number, 0, 1.2)) * 28)
		end),
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, use(panelHeight))
		end),
		BackgroundColor3 = Style.Panel,
		BackgroundTransparency = Style.PanelTransparency,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12) }),
			scope:New("UIScale")({
				Scale = scope:Computed(function(use)
					return 0.9 + 0.1 * math.clamp(use(reveal) :: number, 0, 1.2)
				end),
			}),
			scope:New("UIStroke")({
				Color = Style.Edge,
				Transparency = Style.EdgeTransparency,
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
			}),
			scope:New("UIPadding")({
				PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, PANEL_PAD),
				PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, PANEL_PAD),
				PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, PANEL_PAD),
				PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, PANEL_PAD),
			}),
			scope:New("UIListLayout")({
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, PANEL_GAP),
			}),
			search,
			grid,
		},
	}) :: Frame
	GroupFade.bind(scope, panel, reveal)

	local gridHolder = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "GridHolder",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = 1,
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return UDim2.fromOffset(panelWidth, use(panelHeight))
		end),
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use)
			return (use(reveal) :: number) > 0.01
		end),
		[Children] = { panel },
	})

	root = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Hotbar",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint,
		Position = props.Position,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UIListLayout")({
				HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
				VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom,
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Padding = UDim.new(0, gap),
			}),
			gridHolder,
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Bar",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				LayoutOrder = 2,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, size),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				[Children] = rowChildren,
			}),
		},
	}) :: Frame
	return root
end

--!strict
--[[
	Player list in the style of Roblox's: translucent rows with a faded headshot, the display name
	that gives way to the username on hover, and collapsible team headers.
	See docs/Game/Leaderboard.md.
]]
local Packages = script.Parent.Parent.Parent
local Fusion = require(Packages.Fusion)
local Style = require(script.Parent.Style)

local Children = Fusion.Children
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local peek = Fusion.peek

local EXIT_TIME = 0.4
local HEADER_HEIGHT = 24

export type Row = {
	--- Identifies the row. Keep it between updates, so the row isn't rebuilt.
	Id: any,
	--- Username. Shown as `@Name` on hover.
	Name: string,
	DisplayName: string?,
	--- Roblox user id, for the headshot.
	UserId: number?,
	--- Asset id of a picture, for a row that isn't a Roblox user.
	Image: string?,
	--- Asset id of a small icon at the end of the row.
	Icon: string?,
	--- A stat shown at the end of the row: a number or text.
	Value: any?,
}

export type Team = {
	Name: string,
	Color: Color3?,
	Players: { Row },
	--- A `Value<boolean>` that holds whether the team is collapsed. The list keeps its own if left out.
	Collapsed: any?,
}

export type Props = {
	--- Teams, each with a coloured header. A header is left out for a team with no `Name`.
	Teams: any?,
	--- Players with no teams.
	Players: any?,
	Title: string?,
	--- `Id` of the local player's row, which is lightly highlighted.
	Self: any?,
	--- Whether the list is on screen. It slides off the edge when `false`.
	Open: any?,
	Width: number?,
	--- Height at which the list starts to scroll.
	MaxHeight: number?,
	RowHeight: number?,
	--- "Value" sorts each team by `Value`, highest first.
	Sort: ("None" | "Value")?,
	ValueFormat: ((value: any) -> string)?,
	OnPlayerClick: ((row: Row) -> ())?,
	Position: UDim2?,
	AnchorPoint: Vector2?,
	LayoutOrder: number?,
}

local function defaultFormat(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "number" then
		local text = tostring(math.floor(value))
		local grouped = string.reverse((string.gsub(string.reverse(text), "(%d%d%d)", "%1,")))
		return (string.gsub(grouped, "^,", ""))
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

local function isState(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "table" and (value :: any).type == "State"
end

local function read(value: any): any
	return if isState(value) then peek(value) else value
end

return function(scope: any, props: Props): Instance
	local rowHeight = props.RowHeight or 42
	local width = props.Width or 220
	local format = props.ValueFormat or defaultFormat

	local contentHeight = scope:Value(0)
	local openS = scope:Spring(
		scope:Computed(function(use)
			local open = props.Open
			if open == nil then
				return 1
			end
			return if (if isState(open) then use(open) else open) == false then 0 else 1
		end),
		22,
		1
	)

	-- the list of rows and headers
	local body = scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Body",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
	}) :: Frame
	local layout = scope:New("UIListLayout")({
		Parent = body,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}) :: UIListLayout

	type Entry = { scope: any, order: any, shown: any, gone: boolean, data: any? }
	local entries: { [string]: Entry } = {}
	local collapsed: { [string]: any } = {}

	local function collapsedFor(team: Team, key: string): any
		if team.Collapsed ~= nil then
			return team.Collapsed
		end
		if collapsed[key] == nil then
			collapsed[key] = scope:Value(false)
		end
		return collapsed[key]
	end

	local function buildHeader(key: string, name: string, color: Color3, hide: any): Entry
		local inner = scope:innerScope()
		local data = inner:Value({ Name = name, Color = color, Count = 0 })
		local order = inner:Value(0)
		local shown = inner:Value(0)
		local shownS = inner:Spring(shown, 22, 1)
		inner:New("Frame")({
			Name = key,
			Parent = body,
			BackgroundColor3 = inner:Computed(function(use)
				return (use(data) :: any).Color
			end),
			BackgroundTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - 0.7 * math.clamp(use(shownS) :: number, 0, 1)
			end),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, HEADER_HEIGHT),
			[Children] = {
				inner:New("TextLabel")({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 1, 0),
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
					FontFace = Style.FontBold,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextColor3 = Style.Text,
					TextTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
						return 1 - math.clamp(use(shownS) :: number, 0, 1)
					end),
					Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
						return (use(data) :: any).Name
					end),
				}),
				inner:New("TextLabel")({
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, 0),
					TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
					FontFace = Style.Font,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextColor3 = Style.Text,
					TextTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
						return 1 - 0.5 * math.clamp(use(shownS) :: number, 0, 1)
					end),
					Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
						return tostring((use(data) :: any).Count)
					end),
				}),
				-- Pressing the header folds the team's rows away.
				inner:New("TextButton")({
					Name = "Toggle",
					Text = "",
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					ZIndex = 3,
					[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
						hide:set(not peek(hide))
					end,
				}),
			} :: any,
		})
		task.defer(function()
			shown:set(1)
		end)
		return { scope = inner, order = order, shown = shown, gone = false, data = data }
	end

	local function buildRow(key: string, hide: any): Entry
		local inner = scope:innerScope()
		local data = inner:Value({ Id = key, Name = "" } :: Row)
		local order = inner:Value(0)
		local last = inner:Value(false)
		local shown = inner:Value(0)
		local hovered = inner:Value(false)
		-- The row's height follows `visible`: it is 0 while the team is folded or the row has not
		-- arrived yet, and the slide of the content follows the same spring.
		local visible = inner:Spring(
			inner:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(shown) == 1 and not use(hide) then 1 else 0
			end),
			26,
			1
		)
		local hover = inner:Spring(
			inner:Computed(function(use)
				return if use(hovered) then 1 else 0
			end),
			40,
			0.7
		)
		local isSelf = inner:Computed(function(use)
			local me = if props.Self ~= nil
				then (if isState(props.Self) then use(props.Self) else props.Self)
				else nil
			return me ~= nil and (use(data) :: Row).Id == me
		end)

		local function fade(base: number): any
			return inner:Computed(function(use)
				return 1 - (1 - base) * math.clamp(use(visible) :: number, 0, 1)
			end)
		end

		inner:New("Frame")({
			Name = key,
			Parent = body,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = inner:Computed(function(use)
				return UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight * math.max(use(visible) :: number, 0))
			end),
			[Children] = inner:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Slide",
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight),
				Position = inner:Computed(function(use)
					return UDim2.new(1 - math.clamp(use(visible) :: number, 0, 1), 0, 0, 0)
				end),
				[OnEvent("MouseEnter")] = function()
					hovered:set(true)
				end,
				[OnEvent("MouseLeave")] = function()
					hovered:set(false)
				end,
				[Children] = {
					inner:New("Frame")({
						Name = "Fill",
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
						BackgroundTransparency = fade(0.5),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					}),
					inner:New("Frame")({
						Name = "SelfTint",
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
						BackgroundTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return if use(isSelf) then 0.9 else 1
						end),
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
					}),
					inner:New("ImageLabel")({
						Name = "Headshot",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, rowHeight),
						ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
						ZIndex = 2,
						Image = inner:Computed(function(use)
							local row = use(data) :: Row
							if row.Image then
								return row.Image
							elseif row.UserId then
								return `rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id={row.UserId}&w=60&h=60`
							end
							return ""
						end),
						ImageTransparency = fade(0.6),
						[Children] = inner:New("UIGradient")({
							Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
							}),
						}),
					}),
					inner:New("TextLabel")({
						Name = "DisplayName",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0),
						ZIndex = 3,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						FontFace = Style.FontBold,
						TextSize = 14,
						TextColor3 = Style.Text,
						Position = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return UDim2.fromOffset(16 * (1 - (use(hover) :: number)), 0)
						end),
						TextTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return math.clamp(
								1 - (1 - (use(hover) :: number)) * (use(visible) :: number),
								0,
								1
							)
						end),
						Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
							local row = use(data) :: Row
							return row.DisplayName or row.Name
						end),
					}),
					inner:New("TextLabel")({
						Name = "Username",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 1, 0),
						ZIndex = 3,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
						FontFace = Style.Font,
						TextSize = 14,
						TextColor3 = Style.Text,
						Position = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return UDim2.fromOffset(32 - 16 * (use(hover) :: number), 0)
						end),
						TextTransparency = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return 1 - 0.5 * (use(hover) :: number) * (use(visible) :: number)
						end),
						Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return "@" .. (use(data) :: Row).Name
						end),
					}),
					inner:New("TextLabel")({
						Name = "Value",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
						Position = inner:Computed(function(use)
							local row = use(data) :: Row
							return UDim2.new(1, if row.Icon then -40 else -16, 0, 0)
						end),
						Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 1, 0),
						ZIndex = 3,
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
						FontFace = Style.FontBold,
						TextSize = 14,
						TextColor3 = Style.Text,
						TextTransparency = fade(0),
						Text = inner:Computed(function(use)
							local row = use(data) :: Row
							return if row.Value ~= nil then format(row.Value) else ""
						end),
					}),
					inner:New("ImageLabel")({
						Name = "Icon",
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
						Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
						Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
						ZIndex = 3,
						ImageTransparency = fade(0),
						Image = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return (use(data) :: Row).Icon or ""
						end),
					}),
					inner:New("Frame")({
						Name = "Divider",
						AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
						Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 1),
						BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.9,
						BorderSizePixel = 0,
						Visible = inner:Computed(function(use)
							return not use(last)
						end),
						ZIndex = 3,
					}),
					inner:New("TextButton")({
						Name = "Press",
						Text = "",
						AutoButtonColor = false,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
						ZIndex = 4,
						[OnEvent("Activated")] = function()
							if props.OnPlayerClick then
								props.OnPlayerClick(peek(data))
							end
						end,
					}),
				} :: any,
			}),
		})
		task.defer(function()
			shown:set(1)
		end)
		return {
			scope = inner,
			order = order,
			shown = shown,
			gone = false,
			data = { data = data, last = last },
		}
	end

	local function remove(key: string)
		local entry = entries[key]
		if entry == nil or entry.gone then
			return
		end
		entry.gone = true
		entries[key] = nil
		entry.shown:set(0)
		task.delay(EXIT_TIME, function()
			Fusion.doCleanup(entry.scope)
		end)
	end

	local function update()
		local teams: { Team } = {}
		if props.Teams ~= nil then
			teams = table.clone(read(props.Teams) or {})
		elseif props.Players ~= nil then
			teams = { { Name = "", Players = read(props.Players) or {} } }
		end
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
		local order = 0
		for index, team in teams do
			local teamKey = `team:{index}:{team.Name}`
			local hide = collapsedFor(team, teamKey)
			local list = table.clone(team.Players)
			if props.Sort == "Value" then
				table.sort(list, function(a, b)
					local av, bv = tonumber(a.Value) or 0, tonumber(b.Value) or 0
					if av ~= bv then
						return av > bv
					end
					return tostring(a.Id) < tostring(b.Id)
				end)
			end
			if team.Name ~= "" then
				order += 1
				seen[teamKey] = true
				local header = entries[teamKey]
				if header == nil then
					header = buildHeader(
						teamKey,
						team.Name,
						team.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80),
						hide
					)
					entries[teamKey] = header
				end
				header.order:set(order)
				local headerData = header.data :: any
				headerData:set({
					Name = team.Name,
					Color = team.Color or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80),
					Count = #list,
				})
			end
			for position, row in list do
				order += 1
				local rowKey = `row:{row.Id}`
				seen[rowKey] = true
				local entry = entries[rowKey]
				if entry == nil then
					entry = buildRow(rowKey, hide)
					entries[rowKey] = entry
				end
				entry.order:set(order)
				entry.data.data:set(row)
				entry.data.last:set(position == #list)
			end
		end
		for key in table.clone(entries) do
			if not seen[key] then
				remove(key)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, source in { props.Teams, props.Players, props.Self } do
		if isState(source) then
			table.insert(scope, scope:Observer(source):onChange(update))
		end
	end
	update()

	-- the panel
	local scroller = scope:New("ScrollingFrame")({
		Name = "Scroll",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Size = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local height = use(contentHeight) :: number
			local cap = props.MaxHeight
			return UDim2.new(
				1,
				0,
				0,
				if cap then math.min(height, cap - HEADER_HEIGHT - 6) else height
			)
		end),
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		[Children] = body,
	}) :: ScrollingFrame
	table.insert(
		scope,
		layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
			contentHeight:set(layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
		end)
	)

	local function cap(name: string, order: number, top: boolean): Instance
		return scope:New("Frame")({
			Name = name,
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, if top then HEADER_HEIGHT else 6),
			[Children] = {
				scope:New("UICorner")({ CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, if top then 6 else 6) }),
				if top
					then scope:New("TextLabel")({
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0),
						Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0),
						TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
						FontFace = Style.FontBold,
						TextSize = 12,
						TextTransparency = 0.2,
						TextColor3 = Style.Text,
						Text = props.Title or "Players",
					})
					else nil,
			} :: any,
		})
	end

	return scope:New("Frame")({
		Name = "Leaderboard",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AnchorPoint = props.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = scope:Computed(function(use)
			local base = props.Position or UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8)
			return base
				+ UDim2.fromOffset((1 - math.clamp(use(openS) :: number, 0, 1)) * (width + 24), 0)
		end),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = props.LayoutOrder or 0,
		[Children] = {
			scope:New("UIListLayout")({ SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
			cap("Header", 1, true),
			scroller,
			cap("Footer", 3, false),
		} :: any,
	}) :: Frame
end

--!strict
--[[
	Feeds a Leaderboard from the players and teams of the Roblox experience.
	See docs/Game/Leaderboard.md.
]]
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

local FRIEND_ICON = "rbxasset://textures/ui/PlayerList/FriendIcon.png"
local PREMIUM_ICON = "rbxasset://textures/ui/PlayerList/PremiumIcon.png"
local NO_TEAM_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120)

local Roster = {}

export type Options = {
	--- Return a stat for a player to show at the end of the row.
	Value: ((player: Player) -> any)?,
	--- Return an asset id for the icon of a player. The default is a friend or Premium icon.
	Icon: ((player: Player) -> string?)?,
}

function Roster.new(scope: any, options: Options?)
	local opts: Options = options or {}
	local teams = scope:Value({} :: { any })
	local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local friends: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	local alive = true
	table.insert(scope, function()
		alive = false
		for _, connection in connections do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end)

	local function iconFor(player: Player): string?
		if opts.Icon then
			return opts.Icon(player)
		end
		if friends[player.UserId] then
			return FRIEND_ICON
		elseif player.MembershipType == Enum.MembershipType.Premium then
			return PREMIUM_ICON
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function row(player: Player)
		return {
			Id = player.UserId,
			Name = player.Name,
			DisplayName = player.DisplayName,
			UserId = player.UserId,
			Icon = iconFor(player),
			Value = if opts.Value then opts.Value(player) else nil,
		}
	end

	local refresh: () -> ()
	local pending = false
	local function schedule()
		if pending then
			return
		end
		pending = true
		task.defer(function()
			pending = false
			if alive then
				refresh()
			end
		end)
	end

	refresh = function()
		local built = {}
		local listed = Teams:GetTeams()
		if #listed == 0 then
			local everyone = {}
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				table.insert(everyone, row(player))
			end
			built = { { Name = "", Players = everyone } }
		else
			for _, team in listed do
				if not team:GetAttribute("Hidden") then
					local members = {}
					for _, player in team:GetPlayers() do
						table.insert(members, row(player))
					end
					table.insert(
						built,
						{ Name = team.Name, Color = team.TeamColor.Color, Players = members }
					)
				end
			end
			local neutral = {}
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if player.Team == nil then
					table.insert(neutral, row(player))
				end
			end
			if #neutral > 0 then
				table.insert(built, { Name = "No Team", Color = NO_TEAM_COLOR, Players = neutral })
			end
		end
		teams:set(built)
	end

	--- Whether each other player is a friend of the local player. IsFriendsWithAsync yields, so it
	--- runs off to the side and the list is updated when the answer is in.
	local function checkFriend(player: Player)
		if localPlayer == nil or player == localPlayer then
			return
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, result = pcall(player.IsFriendsWithAsync, player, localPlayer.UserId)
			if ok and result and alive then
				friends[player.UserId] = true
				schedule()
			end
		end)
	end

	local function watch(player: Player)
		checkFriend(player)
		table.insert(connections, player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(schedule))
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		watch(player)
	end
	table.insert(
		connections,
		Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
			watch(player)
			schedule()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(schedule))
	table.insert(connections, Teams.ChildAdded:Connect(schedule))
	table.insert(connections, Teams.ChildRemoved:Connect(schedule))
	refresh()

	return {
		Teams = teams,
		Self = if localPlayer then localPlayer.UserId else nil,
	}
end

return Roster
